````rust
//! Minimal std-only HTTP/1.1 client for the fts daemon's localhost REST API
//! (Plan/FTS_API.md §7: `/v1/capabilities`, `/v1/inbox`, `/v1/transfers` with
//! SSE event streams). The agent controls its local fts daemon through this
//! client; hand-rolled HTTP keeps dmt-copy-core dependency-free, and the SSE
//! NDJSON events map 1:1 onto the agent's progress channel. Unknown event
//! types and unparseable events are skipped, per the fts forward-compatibility
//! promise.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::{TcpStream, ToSocketAddrs};
use std::time::Duration;

// ---------- error-code contract (API.md §10) ----------

pub const FTS_ERROR_OK: i32 = 0;
pub const FTS_ERROR_IO: i32 = 1;
pub const FTS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG: i32 = 2;
pub const FTS_ERROR_CONNECT_FAILED: i32 = 3;
/// `INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION` shares code 3 with `CONNECT_FAILED`.
pub const FTS_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION: i32 = 3;
pub const FTS_ERROR_CHECKSUM_FAILED: i32 = 4;
pub const FTS_ERROR_INTERRUPTED: i32 = 5;
pub const FTS_ERROR_CANCELLED: i32 = 6;
pub const FTS_ERROR_AUTH_FAILED: i32 = 7;

pub fn fts_error_name(code: i32) -> &'static str {
    match code {
        FTS_ERROR_OK => "OK",
        FTS_ERROR_IO => "IO_ERROR",
        FTS_ERROR_INVALID_ARG => "INVALID_ARG",
        FTS_ERROR_CONNECT_FAILED => "CONNECT_FAILED/INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION",
        FTS_ERROR_CHECKSUM_FAILED => "CHECKSUM_FAILED",
        FTS_ERROR_INTERRUPTED => "INTERRUPTED",
        FTS_ERROR_CANCELLED => "CANCELLED",
        FTS_ERROR_AUTH_FAILED => "AUTH_FAILED",
        _ => "UNKNOWN",
    }
}

// ---------- wire types ----------

#[derive(Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Capabilities {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub protocol_version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub fts_version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub capabilities: u32,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct TransferStatus {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub task_id: String,
    pub state: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub checksum_ok: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error_code: i32,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error_message: String,
}

/// The event stream (API.md §4). Fields the doc marks nullable are Options so
/// a `null` does not invalidate the whole event; unknown types land in
/// `Unknown` and unknown fields are ignored.
#[derive(Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
#[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum FtsEvent {
    Task {
        #[serde(default)]
        task_id: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        state: String,
    },
    Progress {
        bytes_done: u64,
        bytes_total: u64,
        #[serde(default)]
        throughput_bps: Option<f64>,
        #[serde(default)]
        eta_seconds: Option<f64>,
    },
    File {
        name: String,
        index: u64,
        total: u64,
    },
    FileDone {
        name: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        checksum_ok: bool,
        #[serde(default)]
        seconds: f64,
        #[serde(default)]
        bytes: u64,
    },
    Degradation {
        from: String,
        to: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        reason: String,
    },
    Result {
        state: String,
        #[serde(default)]
        checksum_ok: bool,
        #[serde(default)]
        duration_seconds: f64,
        #[serde(default)]
        error_code: i32,
        #[serde(default)]
        error: String,
    },
    Error {
        #[serde(default)]
        message: String,
    },
    /// Any event type this client does not know yet - must be ignored.
    #[serde(other)]
    Unknown,
}

impl FtsEvent {
    pub fn is_result(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, FtsEvent::Result { .. })
    }
}

/// SMB credentials for an inbox on an authenticated UNC share; the fts daemon
/// establishes the Windows session itself (API.md §5.3). The password never
/// appears in logs or errors.
#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct UncCredential {
    pub user_name: String,
    pub password: String,
}

// ---------- HTTP plumbing ----------

const CONNECT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);
const IO_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// SSE streams stay quiet only when the transfer itself is stuck; fts emits
/// progress roughly every second while running.
const STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(60);
const MAX_LINE_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;

enum BodyMode {
    Length,
    Chunked,
    Eof,
}

struct HttpBody {
    stream: TcpStream,
    raw: Vec<u8>,
    pos: usize,
    mode: BodyMode,
    content_remaining: u64,
    chunk_remaining: u64,
    expect_chunk_crlf: bool,
    done: bool,
}

struct Response {
    status: u16,
    body: HttpBody,
}

impl HttpBody {
    /// Pull more (still encoded) bytes from the socket. Ok(false) = EOF.
    fn raw_fill(&mut self) -> Result<bool, String> {
        if self.pos > 0 {
            self.raw.drain(..self.pos);
            self.pos = 0;
        }
        let mut tmp = [0u8; 8192];
        let n = self.stream.read(&mut tmp).map_err(|error| format!("fts response read failed: {error}"))?;
        if n == 0 {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        self.raw.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);
        Ok(true)
    }

    fn raw_byte(&mut self) -> Result<Option<u8>, String> {
        loop {
            if self.pos < self.raw.len() {
                let byte = self.raw[self.pos];
                self.pos += 1;
                return Ok(Some(byte));
            }
            if !self.raw_fill()? {
                return Ok(None);
            }
        }
    }

    /// One raw line (header or chunk size), CRLF stripped.
    fn raw_line(&mut self) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
        let mut line = Vec::new();
        loop {
            match self.raw_byte()? {
                None => {
                    return if line.is_empty() {
                        Ok(None)
                    } else {
                        Ok(Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&line).to_string()))
                    };
                }
                Some(b'\n') => break,
                Some(byte) => {
                    line.push(byte);
                    if line.len() > MAX_LINE_BYTES {
                        return Err("fts response line oversized".into());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        let mut text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&line).to_string();
        if text.ends_with('\r') {
            text.pop();
        }
        Ok(Some(text))
    }

    /// Next DECODED body byte (chunked framing removed).
    fn next_byte(&mut self) -> Result<Option<u8>, String> {
        if self.done {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        match self.mode {
            BodyMode::Eof => self.raw_byte(),
            BodyMode::Length => match self.raw_byte()? {
                Some(byte) => {
                    self.content_remaining = self.content_remaining.saturating_sub(1);
                    if self.content_remaining == 0 {
                        self.done = true;
                    }
                    Ok(Some(byte))
                }
                None => {
                    self.done = true;
                    Ok(None)
                }
            },
            BodyMode::Chunked => {
                if self.chunk_remaining == 0 {
                    if self.expect_chunk_crlf {
                        let _ = self.raw_line()?;
                        self.expect_chunk_crlf = false;
                    }
                    let line = self.raw_line()?.ok_or_else(|| "fts response truncated in chunk header".to_string())?;
                    let size = line.split(';').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
                    let chunk = u64::from_str_radix(size, 16).map_err(|_| format!("fts response has a bad chunk size \"{line}\""))?;
                    if chunk == 0 {
                        // trailers up to the empty line, then the body is done
                        while let Some(line) = self.raw_line()? {
                            if line.is_empty() {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        self.done = true;
                        return Ok(None);
                    }
                    self.chunk_remaining = chunk;
                    self.expect_chunk_crlf = true;
                }
                match self.raw_byte()? {
                    Some(byte) => {
                        self.chunk_remaining -= 1;
                        Ok(Some(byte))
                    }
                    None => {
                        self.done = true;
                        Ok(None)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// One decoded body line, CRLF stripped.
    fn body_line(&mut self) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
        let mut line = Vec::new();
        loop {
            match self.next_byte()? {
                None => {
                    return if line.is_empty() {
                        Ok(None)
                    } else {
                        Ok(Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&line).to_string()))
                    };
                }
                Some(b'\n') => {
                    let mut text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&line).to_string();
                    if text.ends_with('\r') {
                        text.pop();
                    }
                    return Ok(Some(text));
                }
                Some(byte) => {
                    line.push(byte);
                    if line.len() > MAX_LINE_BYTES {
                        return Err("fts response body line oversized".into());
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn read_to_end(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        while let Some(byte) = self.next_byte()? {
            out.push(byte);
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
}

fn read_response(stream: TcpStream) -> Result<Response, String> {
    let mut stream = stream;
    let mut raw: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    let mut tmp = [0u8; 8192];
    let header_end = loop {
        if let Some(index) = raw.windows(4).position(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
            break index + 4;
        }
        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp).map_err(|error| format!("fts response read failed: {error}"))?;
        if n == 0 {
            return Err("fts closed the connection before sending a response".into());
        }
        raw.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);
        if raw.len() > MAX_LINE_BYTES {
            return Err("fts response headers oversized".into());
        }
    };
    let headers = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..header_end]).to_string();
    let mut lines = headers.split("\r\n");
    let status_line = lines.next().unwrap_or_default();
    let status = status_line
        .split_whitespace()
        .nth(1)
        .and_then(|code| code.parse::<u16>().ok())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("fts sent a bad status line \"{status_line}\""))?;
    let mut mode = BodyMode::Eof;
    let mut content_remaining = 0u64;
    for line in lines {
        let Some((name, value)) = line.split_once(':') else { continue };
        let name = name.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
        let value = value.trim();
        if name == "transfer-encoding" && value.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("chunked") {
            mode = BodyMode::Chunked;
        }
        if name == "content-length" {
            if let Ok(length) = value.parse::<u64>() {
                content_remaining = length;
                mode = BodyMode::Length;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(Response { status, body: HttpBody { stream, raw, pos: header_end, mode, content_remaining, chunk_remaining: 0, expect_chunk_crlf: false, done: false } })
}

// ---------- the client ----------

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FtsClient {
    rest_addr: String,
}

impl FtsClient {
    pub fn new(rest_addr: &str) -> FtsClient {
        FtsClient { rest_addr: rest_addr.trim().trim_start_matches("http://").trim_start_matches("https://").trim_end_matches('/').to_string() }
    }

    fn connect(&self, read_timeout: Duration) -> Result<TcpStream, String> {
        if self.rest_addr.is_empty() {
            return Err("No fts REST address configured.".into());
        }
        let addr = self
            .rest_addr
            .to_socket_addrs()
            .map_err(|error| format!("Cannot resolve fts REST address {}: {error}", self.rest_addr))?
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("No addresses resolved for fts REST address {}", self.rest_addr))?;
        let stream = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr, CONNECT_TIMEOUT).map_err(|error| format!("Cannot reach the fts daemon at {}: {error}", self.rest_addr))?;
        stream.set_nodelay(true).ok();
        stream.set_read_timeout(Some(read_timeout)).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        stream.set_write_timeout(Some(IO_TIMEOUT)).map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
        Ok(stream)
    }

    fn send_request(stream: &mut TcpStream, host: &str, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut request = format!("{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}\r\nConnection: close\r\n");
        match body {
            Some(body) => {
                request.push_str("Content-Type: application/json\r\n");
                request.push_str(&format!("Content-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len()));
            }
            None => request.push_str("\r\n"),
        }
        stream.write_all(request.as_bytes()).map_err(|error| format!("fts request write failed: {error}"))?;
        stream.flush().map_err(|error| format!("fts request write failed: {error}"))
    }

    fn request_json(&self, method: &str, path: &str, body: Option<String>) -> Result<(u16, String), String> {
        let mut stream = self.connect(IO_TIMEOUT)?;
        Self::send_request(&mut stream, &self.rest_addr, method, path, body.as_deref())?;
        let mut response = read_response(stream)?;
        let bytes = response.body.read_to_end()?;
        Ok((response.status, String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes).to_string()))
    }

    fn check_status(status: u16, body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        if (200..300).contains(&status) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let reason = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(body)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|value| value.get("error").and_then(|error| error.as_str()).map(|error| error.to_string()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| body.trim().to_string());
        Err(format!("fts REST {status}: {reason}"))
    }

    /// Probe the daemon. The integration contract says callers must do this
    /// before assuming any capability exists.
    pub fn capabilities(&self) -> Result<Capabilities, String> {
        let (status, body) = self.request_json("GET", "/v1/capabilities", None)?;
        Self::check_status(status, &body)?;
        serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|error| format!("fts capabilities malformed: {error}"))
    }

    /// Directory-mode inbox token (`file_name` stays empty) for one transfer.
    pub fn reserve_inbox(&self, out_dir: &str, credential: Option<&UncCredential>) -> Result<String, String> {
        let mut payload = serde_json::json!({ "out_dir": out_dir });
        if let Some(credential) = credential {
            if !credential.user_name.is_empty() || !credential.password.is_empty() {
                payload["credential"] = serde_json::json!({ "user_name": credential.user_name, "password": credential.password });
            }
        }
        let (status, body) = self.request_json("POST", "/v1/inbox", Some(payload.to_string()))?;
        Self::check_status(status, &body)?;
        let reply: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|error| format!("fts inbox reply malformed: {error}"))?;
        reply
            .get("token")
            .and_then(|token| token.as_str())
            .map(|token| token.to_string())
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("fts inbox reply has no token: {body}"))
    }

    /// Submit a transfer task; returns the task id immediately (async task).
    pub fn submit(&self, paths: &[&str], dst_addr: &str, fingerprint: &str, ticket: &str, transport: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        let payload = serde_json::json!({
            "paths": paths,
            "dst_addr": dst_addr,
            "fingerprint": fingerprint,
            "transport": if transport.is_empty() { "auto" } else { transport },
            "ticket": ticket,
        });
        let (status, body) = self.request_json("POST", "/v1/transfers", Some(payload.to_string()))?;
        Self::check_status(status, &body)?;
        let reply: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|error| format!("fts submit reply malformed: {error}"))?;
        reply
            .get("task_id")
            .and_then(|task_id| task_id.as_str())
            .map(|task_id| task_id.to_string())
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("fts submit reply has no task_id: {body}"))
    }

    pub fn status(&self, task_id: &str) -> Result<TransferStatus, String> {
        let (status, body) = self.request_json("GET", &format!("/v1/transfers/{task_id}"), None)?;
        Self::check_status(status, &body)?;
        serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|error| format!("fts status malformed: {error}"))
    }

    /// Idempotent cancel; a 404 (task already gone) counts as success.
    pub fn cancel(&self, task_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        let (status, body) = self.request_json("POST", &format!("/v1/transfers/{task_id}/cancel"), Some("{}".to_string()))?;
        if status == 404 {
            return Ok(());
        }
        Self::check_status(status, &body)
    }

    /// Subscribe to the task's SSE event stream. Events flow through
    /// `on_event` as they arrive; returns the terminal `result` event, or an
    /// error if the stream ends (or times out) without one - callers can then
    /// fall back to [`FtsClient::status`].
    pub fn events(&self, task_id: &str, on_event: &mut dyn FnMut(&FtsEvent)) -> Result<Option<FtsEvent>, String> {
        let mut stream = self.connect(STREAM_READ_TIMEOUT)?;
        Self::send_request(&mut stream, &self.rest_addr, "GET", &format!("/v1/transfers/{task_id}/events"), None)?;
        let mut response = read_response(stream)?;
        if !(200..300).contains(&response.status) {
            // error replies are plain JSON, not a stream
            let bytes = response.body.read_to_end()?;
            Self::check_status(response.status, &String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes))?;
        }
        loop {
            match response.body.body_line()? {
                None => return Err("fts event stream ended before a result event".into()),
                Some(line) => {
                    let Some(payload) = line.strip_prefix("data:") else { continue };
                    let payload = payload.trim();
                    if payload.is_empty() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    // unparseable events are skipped (fts contract: receivers ignore what they cannot read)
                    if let Ok(event) = serde_json::from_str::<FtsEvent>(payload) {
                        if matches!(event, FtsEvent::Unknown) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        let terminal = event.is_result();
                        on_event(&event);
                        if terminal {
                            return Ok(Some(event));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// A tiny blocking HTTP/1.1 stub: reads one request (headers + body by
    /// content-length) and answers with the given raw response bytes.
    fn serve_one(responses: Vec<&'static str>) -> (String, std::thread::JoinHandle<Vec<String>>) {
        let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();
        let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let mut seen = Vec::new();
            for response in responses {
                let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
                seen.push(read_request(&mut stream));
                stream.write_all(response.as_bytes()).unwrap();
                // SSE responses stream gradually; the client disconnects after
                // the result event, so further writes may fail - that's fine
                let _ = stream.flush();
            }
            seen
        });
        (addr, handle)
    }

    fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> String {
        stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();
        let mut raw = Vec::new();
        let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];
        loop {
            if let Some(index) = raw.windows(4).position(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                let headers = String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw[..index]).to_string();
                let length = headers
                    .lines()
                    .find_map(|line| line.to_ascii_lowercase().strip_prefix("content-length:").map(|v| v.trim().parse::<usize>().ok()))
                    .flatten()
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let body_start = index + 4;
                while raw.len() < body_start + length {
                    let n = stream.read(&mut tmp).unwrap();
                    if n == 0 {
                        break;
                    }
                    raw.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);
                }
                return String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw).to_string();
            }
            let n = stream.read(&mut tmp).unwrap();
            if n == 0 {
                break;
            }
            raw.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);
        }
        String::from_utf8_lossy(&raw).to_string()
    }

    fn sse_chunk(event: &str) -> String {
        let payload = format!("data: {event}\n\n");
        format!("{:x}\r\n{payload}\r\n", payload.len())
    }

    #[test]
    fn capabilities_round_trip() {
        let body = r#"{"protocol_version":"1","fts_version":"0.1.0","capabilities":8}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let caps = FtsClient::new(&addr).capabilities().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(caps.protocol_version, "1");
        assert_eq!(caps.capabilities, 8);
        let requests = server.join().unwrap();
        assert!(requests[0].starts_with("GET /v1/capabilities HTTP/1.1"));
        assert!(requests[0].contains("Connection: close"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn reserve_inbox_sends_credential_and_returns_token() {
        let body = r#"{"token":"abc-123","expires_in":600}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let credential = UncCredential { user_name: "svc".into(), password: "secret".into() };
        let token = FtsClient::new(&addr).reserve_inbox(r"\\nas\share\out", Some(&credential)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(token, "abc-123");
        let request = server.join().unwrap().remove(0);
        assert!(request.starts_with("POST /v1/inbox HTTP/1.1"), "{request}");
        assert!(request.contains("out_dir"), "{request}");
        assert!(request.contains(r"\\nas\\share\\out"), "backslashes are JSON-escaped: {request}");
        assert!(request.contains("\"user_name\":\"svc\""), "credential goes in the body");
    }

    #[test]
    fn error_body_becomes_a_readable_error() {
        let body = r#"{"error":"必须提供 fingerprint 或 insecure=true"}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let error = FtsClient::new(&addr).submit(&["C:\\a.bin"], "1.2.3.4:4433", "", "t", "auto").unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.contains("fts REST 400"), "{error}");
        assert!(error.contains("fingerprint"), "{error}");
        server.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn submit_returns_task_id() {
        let body = r#"{"task_id":"3f2b8c1a"}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let task_id = FtsClient::new(&addr).submit(&[r"C:\data\a.bin", r"C:\data\dirB"], "100.64.0.5:4433", "a".repeat(64).as_str(), "tok", "auto").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(task_id, "3f2b8c1a");
        let request = server.join().unwrap().remove(0);
        assert!(request.starts_with("POST /v1/transfers HTTP/1.1"), "{request}");
        assert!(request.contains("\"transport\":\"auto\""), "{request}");
        assert!(request.contains("\"ticket\":\"tok\""), "{request}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn status_parses_failure_fields() {
        let body = r#"{"task_id":"t1","state":"FAILED","checksum_ok":false,"error_code":4,"error":"CHECKSUM_FAILED","error_message":"boom"}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let status = FtsClient::new(&addr).status("t1").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(status.state, "FAILED");
        assert_eq!(status.error_code, FTS_ERROR_CHECKSUM_FAILED);
        assert_eq!(fts_error_name(status.error_code), "CHECKSUM_FAILED");
        server.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn events_stream_decodes_until_result_and_skips_unknown() {
        let head = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/event-stream\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n";
        let stream = format!(
            "{head}{}{}{}{}{}",
            sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"task","task_id":"t1","state":"RUNNING"}"#),
            sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"from_the_future","whatever":1}"#),
            sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"file","name":"a.bin","index":1,"total":2}"#),
            sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"progress","bytes_done":5,"bytes_total":10,"throughput_bps":null,"eta_seconds":null}"#),
            sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"result","state":"COMPLETED","checksum_ok":true,"duration_seconds":1.5}"#),
        );
        let trailing = sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"progress","bytes_done":7,"bytes_total":10}"#);
        let response = format!("{stream}{trailing}0\r\n\r\n");
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);

        let seen = std::sync::Mutex::new(Vec::new());
        let result = {
            let mut guard = seen.lock().unwrap();
            FtsClient::new(&addr).events("t1", &mut |event| guard.push(event.clone())).unwrap()
        };
        let FtsEvent::Result { state, checksum_ok, .. } = result.unwrap() else { panic!("expected result event") };
        assert_eq!(state, "COMPLETED");
        assert!(checksum_ok);
        let seen = seen.into_inner().unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(seen[0], FtsEvent::Task { .. }), "{seen:?}");
        assert!(seen.iter().all(|event| !matches!(event, FtsEvent::Unknown)), "unknown events are skipped before the callback");
        assert!(matches!(seen[1], FtsEvent::File { .. }), "{seen:?}");
        server.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn events_stream_ending_without_result_is_an_error() {
        let head = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n";
        let response = format!("{head}{}0\r\n\r\n", sse_chunk(r#"{"type":"task","task_id":"t1","state":"RUNNING"}"#));
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        let error = FtsClient::new(&addr).events("t1", &mut |_| {}).unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.contains("result event"), "{error}");
        server.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn cancel_treats_404_as_success() {
        let body = r#"{"error":"任务不存在"}"#;
        let response = format!("HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\n\r\n{body}", body.len());
        let (addr, server) = serve_one(vec![Box::leak(response.into_boxed_str())]);
        FtsClient::new(&addr).cancel("gone").unwrap();
        server.join().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn client_strips_url_prefixes() {
        let client = FtsClient::new("http://127.0.0.1:5050/");
        assert_eq!(client.rest_addr, "127.0.0.1:5050");
    }
}
````

````rust
//! Agent-to-agent relay data plane (QUIC over UDP): wire types for the
//! cross-site transfer. The control TCP channel stays unchanged; this module
//! only carries types and pure helpers - all async IO lives in the agent.

use crate::copier::{CopyEndpoint, CopyReport};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// ALPN id of the relay protocol.
pub const RELAY_ALPN: &[u8] = b"dmt-relay/1";
/// How many files are transferred concurrently on one QUIC connection.
pub const RELAY_STREAMS: usize = 6;
/// Content is framed as `[u32 LE chunk length][bytes]`, terminated by length 0.
pub const CHUNK_SIZE: usize = 256 * 1024;
/// Files below this size skip zstd - compression overhead beats the saving.
pub const COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD: u64 = 4096;
/// Staging directories are created under the involved share roots; anything
/// older than this is swept before a new transfer stages its files. Failed
/// transfers clean up immediately - this is only the safety net for a hard
/// process crash mid-transfer.
pub const STAGING_MAX_AGE_SECS: u64 = 2 * 60 * 60;

pub fn staging_prefix() -> &'static str {
    ".dmt_stage_"
}

/// First control-stream frame: who is calling and what will be transferred.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct RelayHandshake {
    pub auth: String,
    pub manifest: RelayManifest,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct RelayHandshakeReply {
    pub ok: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// What the receiving agent should end up with. `target` is the receiving
/// agent's own Vision PC endpoint (its site's LAN); the receiving side applies
/// the same delete guards as a single-site copy.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct RelayManifest {
    pub source_model: String,
    pub target_model: String,
    pub kinds: Vec<String>,
    /// true = skip files the target already has with identical size+mtime
    pub incremental: bool,
    pub target: CopyEndpoint,
}

/// Per-file header frame (JSON line) sent at the start of each file stream.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FileHeader {
    pub kind: String,
    /// Path relative to the model folder, '/' separators, no traversal.
    pub path: String,
    pub size: u64,
    /// nanoseconds since UNIX epoch - the receiver restores it so later
    /// incremental runs match
    pub mtime_nanos: i64,
    pub compressed: bool,
}

/// The receiver answers on the same stream before any content flows.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct FileReply {
    pub skip: bool,
}

/// Sent on the control stream after every file stream has been finished.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FilesDone {
    pub done: bool,
    pub streams: u64,
}

/// Final control-stream frame: the receiving agent's copy report.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct RelayResult {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub report: Option<CopyReport>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// Incremental rule: identical name (caller's job), size and mtime means the
/// target already has exactly this file - skip the content entirely.
pub fn should_skip_file(existing_size: u64, existing_mtime_nanos: i64, header: &FileHeader, incremental: bool) -> bool {
    incremental && existing_size == header.size && existing_mtime_nanos == header.mtime_nanos
}

/// Reject anything that could escape the staging directory.
pub fn validate_relative_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    if path.is_empty() {
        return Err("empty relative path".into());
    }
    if path.contains("..") || path.starts_with('/') || path.starts_with('\\') || path.contains(':') {
        return Err(format!("unsafe relative path \"{path}\""));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn header(path: &str, size: u64, mtime: i64) -> FileHeader {
        FileHeader { kind: "PxRepository".into(), path: path.into(), size, mtime_nanos: mtime, compressed: false }
    }

    #[test]
    fn incremental_skips_only_on_full_match() {
        let file = header("a.gbr", 100, 1_000);
        assert!(should_skip_file(100, 1_000, &file, true));
        assert!(!should_skip_file(101, 1_000, &file, true), "size differs");
        assert!(!should_skip_file(100, 1_001, &file, true), "mtime differs");
        assert!(!should_skip_file(100, 1_000, &file, false), "forced full");
    }

    #[test]
    fn relative_paths_may_not_escape() {
        assert!(validate_relative_path("sub/gerber.gbr").is_ok());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("deep/deeper/file.xml").is_ok());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("../evil").is_err());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("a\\..\\..\\evil").is_err());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("C:\\evil").is_err());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("/abs").is_err());
        assert!(validate_relative_path("").is_err());
    }
}
````

````c
/* fts.h — fts.dll C ABI(api-spec 第 5 节子集,P3 手写版;结构变化时看 fts_abi_version)
 *
 * 内存规则:
 *   - fts_version() 返回静态字符串,勿释放;
 *   - fts_last_error() 返回值在下一次任何 fts_* 调用前有效,需保留必须拷贝;
 *   - 所有传入字符串为 UTF-8,NUL 结尾。
 */
#ifndef FTS_H
#define FTS_H

#include <stdint.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

FTS_API const char* fts_version(void);
FTS_API uint32_t    fts_abi_version(void);
FTS_API const char* fts_last_error(void);

/* 阻塞式发送。
 * 返回 0 = 成功且校验通过;否则为契约退出码:
 *   1 通用 / 2 参数 / 3 连接 / 4 校验失败(数据不可信) / 5 中断 / 6 取消 / 7 认证
 */
FTS_API int32_t fts_send_file(const char* src_path,
                              const char* dst_addr,
                              const char* fingerprint_hex, /* 可为 NULL */
                              int32_t     insecure,        /* 非 0 跳过校验(仅测试) */
                              uint32_t    streams,         /* 0 = 4 */
                              uint32_t    chunk_size,      /* 0 = 8 MiB */
                              const char* transport);      /* NULL/"auto"/"quic"/"tcp" */

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#endif /* FTS_H */
````

````html
<header>
  <h1>fts 编排 server</h1>
  <span class="sub">输入两端 → 探活 → 编排传输(源端 push,字节不经过本 server)</span>
</header>
<main>
  <h2>1 · 主机</h2>
  <table>
    <thead><tr>
      <th style="width:60px">名称</th><th>gRPC 地址</th><th style="width:90px">控制面</th>
      <th style="width:90px">数据面</th><th>数据地址</th><th>证书指纹</th><th>版本</th>
    </tr></thead>

    <button id="checkBtn" class="primary">刷新探活</button>

  </div>

  <form id="taskForm">
    <label>源主机 <select id="f_src" required></select></label>

    <label>目标主机 <select id="f_dst" required></select></label>
    <label>目标目录 <input id="f_dst_path" placeholder="D:\recv" required /></label>
    <label>传输层
      <select id="f_transport"><option value="">默认(auto)</option>
        <option value="auto">auto</option><option value="quic">quic</option>
        <option value="tcp">tcp</option></select>
    </label>
    <label>并行流数(0=默认4)<input id="f_streams" type="number" min="0" value="0" /></label>
    <label>分块字节(0=默认8MiB)<input id="f_chunk" type="number" min="0" value="0" /></label>
    <label style="justify-content:flex-end">
      <span></span>
      <span style="flex-direction:row; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; color:var(--fg); font-size:13px">
        <input type="checkbox" id="f_purge" style="width:auto" />
        传输前清空目标目录(危险)
      </span>
    </label>
    <div class="actions">
      <button type="submit" class="primary" id="startBtn">开始传输</button>
      <span class="hint">可重复提交以做多任务并行测试(如 A1→B1 / A2→B2 / A3→B3)</span>
    </div>
  </form>

  <h2>3 · 任务</h2>
  <div id="tasks"><div class="empty">暂无任务</div></div>
</main>

<script>
const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
let hosts = [];

function dot(cls) { return `<span class="dot ${cls}"></span>`; }
function fmtBytes(n) {
  const u = ["B","KB","MB","GB","TB"]; let i = 0;
  while (n >= 1024 && i < u.length - 1) { n /= 1024; i++; }
  return (i === 0 ? n : n.toFixed(1)) + u[i];
}

async function loadHosts() {
  hosts = await (await fetch("/api/hosts")).json();
  const tb = $("#hosts");
  if (!hosts.length) { tb.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">config 未配置主机</td></tr>'; return; }
  tb.innerHTML = hosts.map(h => {
    const ctl = h.control_ok ? dot("ok") + "通" : dot("bad") + "断";
    const dat = h.data_ok ? dot("ok") + "通" : (h.control_ok ? dot("warn") + "未知" : dot("bad") + "断");
    return `<tr>
      <td><b>${h.name}</b></td>
      <td class="mono">${h.grpc_addr}</td>
      <td>${ctl}</td><td>${dat}</td>
      <td class="mono">${h.data_addr || "-"}</td>
      <td class="mono">${h.fingerprint_short || "-"}</td>
      <td>${h.fts_version || "-"}${h.error ? `<div class="err">${h.error}</div>` : ""}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join("");
  fillSelect("#f_src"); fillSelect("#f_dst");
}

function fillSelect(sel) {
  const cur = $(sel).value;
  $(sel).innerHTML = hosts.map(h => `<option value="${h.name}">${h.name} (${h.grpc_addr})</option>`).join("");
  if (hosts.some(h => h.name === cur)) $(sel).value = cur;
}

async function checkHosts() {
  $("#checkBtn").disabled = true; $("#checkHint").textContent = "探活中…";
  try {
    hosts = await (await fetch("/api/hosts/check", { method: "POST" })).json();
    $("#checkHint").textContent = "完成";
    renderHosts();
  } catch (e) { $("#checkHint").textContent = "失败: " + e; }
  finally { $("#checkBtn").disabled = false; }
}

function renderHosts() {
  const tb = $("#hosts");
  tb.innerHTML = hosts.map(h => {
    const ctl = h.control_ok ? dot("ok") + "通" : dot("bad") + "断";
    const dat = h.data_ok ? dot("ok") + "通" : (h.control_ok ? dot("warn") + "未知" : dot("bad") + "断");
    return `<tr>
      <td><b>${h.name}</b></td><td class="mono">${h.grpc_addr}</td>
      <td>${ctl}</td><td>${dat}</td>
      <td class="mono">${h.data_addr || "-"}</td>
      <td class="mono">${h.fingerprint_short || "-"}</td>
      <td>${h.fts_version || "-"}${h.error ? `<div class="err">${h.error}</div>` : ""}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }).join("");
}

const tasks = new Map();
function renderTask(t) {
  tasks.set(t.id, t);
  const el = document.getElementById("task-" + t.id) || (() => {
    const d = document.createElement("div"); d.id = "task-" + t.id; d.className = "task";
    $("#tasks").querySelector(".empty")?.remove(); $("#tasks").appendChild(d); return d;
  })();
  el.className = "task " + t.state;
  const eta = t.eta_seconds != null ? `ETA ${t.eta_seconds}s` : "";
  const thr = t.throughput_bps ? fmtBytes(t.throughput_bps) + "/s" : "";
  const canCancel = t.state === "RUNNING" && t.source_task_id;
  el.innerHTML = `
    <div class="top">
      <span class="name">${t.name}</span>
      <span class="route">${t.src}:${t.src_path} → ${t.dst}:${t.dst_path}</span>
      <span class="state ${t.state}">${t.state}</span>
      <button data-cancel="${t.id}" ${canCancel ? "" : "disabled"}>取消</button>
    </div>
    <div class="bar"><i style="width:${t.percent}%"></i></div>
    <div class="meta">
      <span>${t.percent.toFixed(1)}%</span>
      <span>${fmtBytes(t.bytes_done)} / ${fmtBytes(t.bytes_total)}</span>
      <span>文件 ${t.files_done}/${t.files_total}${t.current_file ? " · " + t.current_file : ""}</span>
      <span>${thr}</span><span>${eta}</span>
      <span>${t.purge ? `purge: ${t.purge_files}文件/${t.purge_dirs}文件夹` : ""}</span>
      <span>${t.state === "COMPLETED" ? "checksum_ok=" + t.checksum_ok : ""}</span>
    </div>
    ${t.error_message && ["FAILED","CANCELLED"].includes(t.state)
        ? `<div class="err">${t.error}(${t.error_code}): ${t.error_message}</div>` : ""}
    ${(t.warnings || []).map(w => `<div class="warnline">~ ${w}</div>`).join("")}
  `;
  el.querySelector("[data-cancel]")?.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
    e.target.disabled = true;
    await fetch(`/api/tasks/${t.id}/cancel`, { method: "POST" });
  });
}

$("#checkBtn").addEventListener("click", checkHosts);
$("#taskForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const body = {
    src: $("#f_src").value, src_path: $("#f_src_path").value,
    dst: $("#f_dst").value, dst_path: $("#f_dst_path").value,
    transport: $("#f_transport").value,
    streams: parseInt($("#f_streams").value) || 0,
    chunk_size: parseInt($("#f_chunk").value) || 0,
    purge: $("#f_purge").checked,
  };
  $("#startBtn").disabled = true;
  try {
    const r = await fetch("/api/tasks", {
      method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    const t = await r.json();
    if (r.ok) renderTask(t); else alert("创建失败: " + (t.error || r.status));
  } finally { $("#startBtn").disabled = false; }
});

(async function init() {
  await loadHosts();
  (await (await fetch("/api/tasks")).json()).forEach(renderTask);
  const es = new EventSource("/api/events");
  es.onmessage = (m) => {
    const ev = JSON.parse(m.data);
    if (ev.type === "task_update") renderTask(ev.task);
    else if (ev.type === "host_update") {
      const i = hosts.findIndex(h => h.name === ev.host.name);
      if (i >= 0) { hosts[i] = ev.host; renderHosts(); }
    }
  };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
````

## File: File-Transfer/orch/app.py
````python
"""fts 编排 server —— Web UI(FastAPI + SSE)。

server 自身暴露的 REST/SSE 与 daemon 的 /v1/* 无关,是专给 Web UI 用的编排接口:

    GET  /                      静态页
    GET  /api/hosts             主机列表(含探活结果)
    POST /api/hosts/check       重新探活所有主机
    GET  /api/tasks             任务列表
    POST /api/tasks             新建并启动任务
    POST /api/tasks/{id}/cancel 取消
    GET  /api/events            SSE:任务/主机增量
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import pathlib
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, JSONResponse, StreamingResponse
from pydantic import BaseModel

import core
from core import Orchestrator

STATIC = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "static"


class TaskReq(BaseModel):
    src: str
    src_path: str
    dst: str
    dst_path: str
    name: Optional[str] = None
    transport: str = ""
    streams: int = 0
    chunk_size: int = 0
    purge: bool = False


def create_app(config_path: str) -> FastAPI:
    cfg = core.load_config(config_path)
    orch = Orchestrator(cfg)
    inflight: set[asyncio.Task] = set()

    app = FastAPI(title="fts 编排 server")

    @app.get("/")
    def index() -> FileResponse:
        return FileResponse(STATIC / "index.html")

    @app.get("/api/hosts")
    def hosts() -> list:
        return [e.snapshot() for e in orch.endpoints.values()]

    @app.post("/api/hosts/check")
    async def check_hosts() -> list:
        return [e.snapshot() for e in await orch.check_all()]

    @app.get("/api/tasks")
    def tasks() -> list:
        return [t.snapshot() for t in orch.tasks.values()]

    @app.post("/api/tasks")
    async def create_task(req: TaskReq) -> JSONResponse:
        try:
            task = orch.new_task(**req.model_dump())
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            return JSONResponse({"error": str(e)}, status_code=400)
        run = asyncio.create_task(orch.run_task(task))
        inflight.add(run)
        run.add_done_callback(inflight.discard)
        return JSONResponse(task.snapshot())

    @app.post("/api/tasks/{tid}/cancel")
    async def cancel_task(tid: str) -> dict:
        return {"ok": await orch.cancel(tid)}

    @app.get("/api/events")
    async def events(request: Request) -> StreamingResponse:
        q = orch.subscribe()

        async def gen():
            try:
                while not await request.is_disconnected():
                    try:
                        ev = await asyncio.wait_for(q.get(), timeout=15)
                    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                        yield ": keepalive\n\n"
                        continue
                    yield f"data: {json.dumps(ev, ensure_ascii=False)}\n\n"
            finally:
                orch.unsubscribe(q)

        return StreamingResponse(gen(), media_type="text/event-stream")

    return app


def serve(config_path: str, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 8080) -> None:
    import uvicorn

    print(f"fts 编排 server Web UI: http://{host}:{port}  (Ctrl+C 退出)")
    uvicorn.run(create_app(config_path), host=host, port=port, log_level="warning")
````

## File: File-Transfer/orch/cli.py
````python
"""fts 编排 server 的命令行入口(headless,便于脚本/CI/文档复现)。

用法(在 orch/ 目录下):
    # 1) 探活:确认两端存在且活着
    python cli.py --config config.json --check

    # 2) 并行编排多任务:从 A1→B1 / A2→B2 / A3→B3
    python cli.py --config config.json \
        --pairs "A1:B1,A2:B2,A3:B3" \
        --src-path C:\\data\\payload.bin --dst-path D:\\recv

    # 3) 运行 config.json 里的 tasks 列表
    python cli.py --config config.json --run-config-tasks

    # 4) 启动 Web UI(浏览器操作)
    python cli.py --config config.json --serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys

import core
from core import Orchestrator, OrchestrationError, TERMINAL


def _fmt_bytes(n: int) -> str:
    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"):
        if n < 1024 or unit == "TB":
            return f"{n:.1f}{unit}" if unit != "B" else f"{n}B"
        n /= 1024.0
    return f"{n}B"


async def cmd_check(orch: Orchestrator) -> int:
    print("== 主机探活(控制面 gRPC + 数据面 TCP)==\n")
    eps = await orch.check_all()
    ok = True
    for ep in eps:
        mark = "OK " if (ep.control_ok and ep.data_ok) else ("CTL" if ep.control_ok else "XX ")
        if not (ep.control_ok and ep.data_ok):
            ok = False
        print(
            f"[{mark}] {ep.name:<4} {ep.grpc_addr:<20} "
            f"指纹={ep.fingerprint[:12] or '-':<12} "
            f"数据口={ep.data_addr or '-':<20} "
            f"protocol={ep.protocol_version or '-':<3} fts={ep.fts_version or '-'}"
        )
        if ep.error:
            print(f"        ! {ep.error}")
    print()
    return 0 if ok else 1


async def _watch(orch: Orchestrator) -> None:
    """订阅事件总线,按状态/进度变化打印紧凑行。"""
    q = orch.subscribe()
    last: dict[str, tuple] = {}
    try:
        while True:
            ev = await q.get()
            if ev.get("type") != "task_update":
                continue
            t = ev["task"]
            key = (t["state"], int(t["percent"] // 10))
            if last.get(t["id"]) == key:
                continue
            last[t["id"]] = key
            eta = f" ETA {t['eta_seconds']}s" if t["eta_seconds"] is not None else ""
            extra = ""
            if t["state"] in TERMINAL and t["state"] != "COMPLETED":
                extra = f"  [{t['error']}:{t['error_code']}] {t['error_message']}"
            print(
                f"  {t['name']:<10} {t['state']:<9} "
                f"{t['percent']:5.1f}%  {_fmt_bytes(t['bytes_done'])}/{_fmt_bytes(t['bytes_total'])}"
                f"  {t['files_done']}/{t['files_total']} 文件{eta}{extra}"
            )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        pass
    finally:
        orch.unsubscribe(q)


async def _run_tasks(orch: Orchestrator, tasks: list[core.Task]) -> int:
    print(f"== 并行编排 {len(tasks)} 个任务 ==\n")
    watcher = asyncio.create_task(_watch(orch))
    await asyncio.sleep(0)  # 让 watcher 先订阅
    results = await asyncio.gather(*(orch.run_task(t) for t in tasks))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    watcher.cancel()

    print("\n== 结果汇总 ==\n")
    all_ok = True
    for t in results:
        passed = t.state == "COMPLETED" and t.checksum_ok
        all_ok = all_ok and passed
        tag = "PASS" if passed else "FAIL"
        print(
            f"[{tag}] {t.name:<10} {t.src}->{t.dst}  {t.state:<9} "
            f"checksum_ok={t.checksum_ok}  {_fmt_bytes(t.bytes_done)}  "
            f"{t.ended_at - t.started_at:.2f}s"
        )
        if t.warnings:
            for w in t.warnings:
                print(f"        ~ {w}")
        if not passed and t.error_message:
            print(f"        ! {t.error}({t.error_code}): {t.error_message}")
    print()
    return 0 if all_ok else 1


def _build_tasks_from_pairs(orch: Orchestrator, pairs: str, src_path: str, dst_path: str,
                            transport: str, streams: int, chunk_size: int,
                            purge: bool = False) -> list[core.Task]:
    tasks: list[core.Task] = []
    for i, pair in enumerate(pairs.split(","), start=1):
        pair = pair.strip()
        if not pair:
            continue
        src, _, dst = pair.partition(":")
        if not src or not dst:
            raise OrchestrationError(f"--pairs 格式错误(应为 A1:B1,A2:B2): {pair!r}")
        task = orch.new_task(
            name=f"{src}→{dst}",
            src=src.strip(),
            src_path=src_path,
            dst=dst.strip(),
            dst_path=dst_path,
            transport=transport,
            streams=streams,
            chunk_size=chunk_size,
            purge=purge,
        )
        task.id = f"{task.id}-{i}"
        tasks.append(task)
    return tasks


async def _amain(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    cfg = core.load_config(args.config)
    orch = Orchestrator(cfg)

    if args.check:
        return await cmd_check(orch)
    if args.pairs:
        if not args.src_path or not args.dst_path:
            print("错误: --pairs 需要同时提供 --src-path 与 --dst-path", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        tasks = _build_tasks_from_pairs(
            orch, args.pairs, args.src_path, args.dst_path, args.transport, args.streams,
            args.chunk_size, args.purge,
        )
        return await _run_tasks(orch, tasks)
    if args.run_config_tasks:
        tasks = [orch.new_task(**t) for t in cfg.get("tasks", [])]
        if not tasks:
            print("config 中没有 tasks", file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        return await _run_tasks(orch, tasks)

    print("未指定动作:请用 --check / --pairs / --run-config-tasks / --serve", file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


def main() -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="fts 编排 server(命令行)")
    g = p.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="探活所有主机")
    g.add_argument("--pairs", help="并行编排,如 \"A1:B1,A2:B2,A3:B3\"")
    g.add_argument("--run-config-tasks", action="store_true", help="运行 config 里的 tasks")
    g.add_argument("--serve", action="store_true", help="启动 Web UI")
    p.add_argument("--config", default="config.json")
    p.add_argument("--src-path", default="", help="--pairs 用:源文件路径")
    p.add_argument("--dst-path", default="", help="--pairs 用:目标目录")
    p.add_argument("--transport", default="", help="auto|quic|tcp(空=config 默认)")
    p.add_argument("--streams", type=int, default=0)
    p.add_argument("--chunk-size", type=int, default=0)
    p.add_argument("--purge", action="store_true",
                   help="--pairs 用:传输前清空目标目录(危险,不可恢复)")
    p.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1", help="--serve 用")
    p.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080, help="--serve 用")
    args = p.parse_args()

    import os
    if not os.path.exists(args.config):
        print(
            f"错误: 配置文件不存在: {args.config}\n"
            f"config.json 不是自带的,请从样例复制后填入你的主机地址:\n"
            f"    copy orch\\config.example.json orch\\config.json\n"
            f"字段说明见 orch\\README.md(endpoints 只需 name + grpc_addr,指纹/端口自动发现)",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        return 2

    # --serve 不能在 asyncio.run 内调用(uvicorn.run 自带事件循环)
    if args.serve:
        from app import serve

        serve(args.config, host=args.host, port=args.port)
        return 0
    try:
        return asyncio.run(_amain(args))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        return 130


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

## File: File-Transfer/orch/core.py
````python
"""fts 编排 server —— 核心引擎。

fts 是**纯 push 模型**:数据连接永远由源端发起去连目标端,没有任何"命令接收端去拉取"的 RPC。
因此 server 不是数据中转方,而是一个 gRPC 客户端,分别指挥两端:

    Capabilities(A)  探活 + 读 A 的身份(指纹/监听端口)
    Capabilities(B)  探活 + 读 B 的身份
    ReserveInbox(B)  在 B 上预注册落盘目录 → 得到 ticket
    Submit(A)        paths=源路径, dst_addr=B:数据端口, fingerprint=B指纹, ticket=ticket → task_id
    Observe(A)       订阅 NDJSON 事件流 → 进度 / 结果
    (之后 A 自己直连 B 传数据,字节不经过 server)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import socket
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Optional

import grpc

import fts_pb2 as pb
import fts_pb2_grpc as pbg

TERMINAL = {"COMPLETED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"}

# 编排层自身的错误码(与 fts 传输错误码 0-7 区分开,负数)
ORCH_ERR_GENERIC = -1
ORCH_ERR_UNREACHABLE = -2
ORCH_ERR_BAD_DATA_ADDR = -3


class OrchestrationError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, code: int = ORCH_ERR_GENERIC, name: str = "ORCH_ERROR"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.name = name


def split_host_port(addr: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """拆分 host:port;容忍 IPv6 的 [::1]:53 形式。"""
    if addr.startswith("["):
        host, _, port = addr[1:].partition("]:")
        return host, port
    host, _, port = addr.rpartition(":")
    return host, port


def resolve_data_addr(grpc_addr: str, listen_addr: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """把 daemon 上报的 listen_addr 变成编排方可连接的数据地址。

    listen_addr 通常是 0.0.0.0:4433(通配),此时用 grpc_addr 的 host 替换,
    得到「该主机真实 IP:数据端口」。
    """
    lh, lp = split_host_port(listen_addr or "")
    if not lp:
        return None
    gh, _ = split_host_port(grpc_addr)
    host = gh if lh in ("", "0.0.0.0", "::", "[::]") else lh
    if not host:
        return None
    return f"{host}:{lp}"


def tcp_probe(host: str, port: int, timeout: float) -> bool:
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout):
            return True
    except OSError:
        return False


@dataclass
class Endpoint:
    """一台被编排的主机(客户端)。指纹/数据端口由 Capabilities 自动发现。"""

    name: str
    grpc_addr: str
    # —— 发现结果 ——
    alive: bool = False
    control_ok: bool = False
    data_ok: bool = False
    protocol_version: str = ""
    capabilities: int = 0
    fts_version: str = ""
    fingerprint: str = ""
    listen_addr: str = ""
    data_addr: str = ""
    error: str = ""
    checked_at: float = 0.0

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "name": self.name,
            "grpc_addr": self.grpc_addr,
            "alive": self.alive,
            "control_ok": self.control_ok,
            "data_ok": self.data_ok,
            "protocol_version": self.protocol_version,
            "fts_version": self.fts_version,
            "fingerprint": self.fingerprint,
            "fingerprint_short": self.fingerprint[:12] + "…" if self.fingerprint else "",
            "listen_addr": self.listen_addr,
            "data_addr": self.data_addr,
            "error": self.error,
            "checked_at": self.checked_at,
        }


@dataclass
class Task:
    """一个「从源路径传到目标路径」的编排任务。"""

    id: str
    name: str
    src: str
    src_path: str
    dst: str
    dst_path: str
    transport: str = ""
    streams: int = 0
    chunk_size: int = 0
    purge: bool = False
    # —— 运行时 ——
    source_task_id: str = ""
    state: str = "PENDING"
    checksum_ok: bool = False
    purge_files: int = 0
    purge_dirs: int = 0
    cur_bytes: int = 0
    cur_total: int = 0
    done_bytes: int = 0
    files_done: int = 0
    files_total: int = 0
    current_file: str = ""
    throughput_bps: int = 0
    eta_seconds: Optional[int] = None
    error_code: int = 0
    error: str = ""
    error_message: str = ""
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    started_at: float = 0.0
    ended_at: float = 0.0

    @property
    def bytes_done(self) -> int:
        return self.done_bytes + self.cur_bytes

    @property
    def bytes_total(self) -> int:
        return self.done_bytes + self.cur_total

    def snapshot(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        total = self.bytes_total
        done = self.bytes_done
        percent = round(100.0 * done / total, 1) if total > 0 else 0.0
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "name": self.name,
            "src": self.src,
            "src_path": self.src_path,
            "dst": self.dst,
            "dst_path": self.dst_path,
            "transport": self.transport,
            "streams": self.streams,
            "chunk_size": self.chunk_size,
            "purge": self.purge,
            "purge_files": self.purge_files,
            "purge_dirs": self.purge_dirs,
            "source_task_id": self.source_task_id,
            "state": self.state,
            "checksum_ok": self.checksum_ok,
            "percent": percent,
            "bytes_done": done,
            "bytes_total": total,
            "files_done": self.files_done,
            "files_total": self.files_total,
            "current_file": self.current_file,
            "throughput_bps": self.throughput_bps,
            "eta_seconds": self.eta_seconds,
            "error_code": self.error_code,
            "error": self.error,
            "error_message": self.error_message,
            "warnings": list(self.warnings),
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "ended_at": self.ended_at,
            "duration_seconds": round(self.ended_at - self.started_at, 2)
            if self.ended_at
            else None,
        }


class Orchestrator:
    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, Any]):
        self.rpc_timeout: float = float(config.get("timeout_sec", 3))
        self.defaults: dict[str, Any] = config.get("defaults", {}) or {}
        self.endpoints: dict[str, Endpoint] = {}
        for e in config.get("endpoints", []):
            self.endpoints[e["name"]] = Endpoint(name=e["name"], grpc_addr=e["grpc_addr"])
        self.tasks: dict[str, Task] = {}
        self._subs: set[asyncio.Queue] = set()

    # ---------- 事件总线(Web UI 的 SSE / CLI 消费) ----------

    def subscribe(self) -> asyncio.Queue:
        q: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()
        self._subs.add(q)
        return q

    def unsubscribe(self, q: asyncio.Queue) -> None:
        self._subs.discard(q)

    def _emit(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        for q in list(self._subs):
            q.put_nowait(event)

    def _emit_task(self, task: Task) -> None:
        self._emit({"type": "task_update", "task": task.snapshot()})

    def _emit_host(self, ep: Endpoint) -> None:
        self._emit({"type": "host_update", "host": ep.snapshot()})

    # ---------- 探活 ----------

    async def check_host(self, name: str) -> Endpoint:
        ep = self.endpoints[name]
        ep.control_ok = ep.alive = ep.data_ok = False
        ep.error = ""
        ep.checked_at = time.time()
        try:
            async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(ep.grpc_addr) as ch:
                rep = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    pbg.FtsStub(ch).Capabilities(pb.Empty()), timeout=self.rpc_timeout
                )
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 —— 探活要吞掉一切连接类异常
            ep.error = f"控制面不可达: {e}"
            self._emit_host(ep)
            return ep

        ep.control_ok = ep.alive = True
        ep.protocol_version = rep.protocol_version
        ep.capabilities = rep.capabilities
        ep.fts_version = rep.fts_version
        ep.fingerprint = rep.fingerprint
        ep.listen_addr = rep.listen_addr
        if not rep.fingerprint:
            ep.error = "对端未上报指纹(daemon 版本过旧,需升级后重试)"
        ep.data_addr = resolve_data_addr(ep.grpc_addr, rep.listen_addr) or ""
        if ep.data_addr:
            _, port = split_host_port(ep.data_addr)
            host, _ = split_host_port(ep.data_addr)
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
            ep.data_ok = await loop.run_in_executor(
                None, tcp_probe, host, int(port), self.rpc_timeout
            )
            if not ep.data_ok:
                ep.error = ep.error or "控制面正常,但数据端口不可达(防火墙/未监听?)"
        self._emit_host(ep)
        return ep

    async def check_all(self) -> list[Endpoint]:
        return list(await asyncio.gather(*(self.check_host(n) for n in self.endpoints)))

    # ---------- 任务编排 ----------

    def new_task(self, **kw: Any) -> Task:
        task = Task(
            id=kw.get("id") or f"t{int(time.time() * 1000) % 10**8}",
            name=kw.get("name") or f"{kw['src']}→{kw['dst']}",
            src=kw["src"],
            src_path=kw["src_path"],
            dst=kw["dst"],
            dst_path=kw["dst_path"],
            transport=kw.get("transport", self.defaults.get("transport", "auto")),
            streams=int(kw.get("streams", self.defaults.get("streams", 0)) or 0),
            chunk_size=int(kw.get("chunk_size", self.defaults.get("chunk_size", 0)) or 0),
            purge=bool(kw.get("purge", False)),
        )
        self.tasks[task.id] = task
        self._emit_task(task)
        return task

    async def run_task(self, task: Task) -> Task:
        task.state = "RUNNING"
        task.started_at = time.time()
        self._emit_task(task)
        try:
            src = self.endpoints.get(task.src)
            dst = self.endpoints.get(task.dst)
            if src is None or dst is None:
                raise OrchestrationError(f"未知主机: src={task.src} dst={task.dst}")

            # 1) 两端探活(每次运行都重新确认"存在且活着")
            await self.check_host(task.src)
            await self.check_host(task.dst)
            for ep in (src, dst):
                if not ep.alive:
                    raise OrchestrationError(
                        f"主机 {ep.name} 不存活: {ep.error}",
                        ORCH_ERR_UNREACHABLE,
                        "HOST_UNREACHABLE",
                    )
            if not dst.data_addr:
                raise OrchestrationError(
                    f"主机 {dst.name} 未上报数据监听地址,无法确定传输目标",
                    ORCH_ERR_BAD_DATA_ADDR,
                    "NO_DATA_ADDR",
                )
            if not dst.data_ok:
                task.warnings.append(f"目标数据端口探测失败({dst.data_addr}),仍尝试传输")
            if not dst.fingerprint:
                raise OrchestrationError(
                    f"主机 {dst.name} 未上报证书指纹,无法 pin",
                    ORCH_ERR_BAD_DATA_ADDR,
                    "NO_FINGERPRINT",
                )

            # 2) 在目标端预注册落盘目录 → ticket
            async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(dst.grpc_addr) as ch:
                tok = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    pbg.FtsStub(ch).ReserveInbox(
                        pb.ReserveInboxRequest(out_dir=task.dst_path, file_name="")
                    ),
                    timeout=self.rpc_timeout,
                )
            ticket = tok.token

            # 2.5) 可选:传输前清空目标目录(force-clean 部署)。
            # 仅目录模式 token 允许 purge;必须显式 force=true(fts 三重防护之一)。
            if task.purge:
                async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(dst.grpc_addr) as ch:
                    pr = await asyncio.wait_for(
                        pbg.FtsStub(ch).PurgeInbox(pb.PurgeRequest(token=ticket, force=True)),
                        timeout=self.rpc_timeout,
                    )
                task.purge_files = int(pr.files_deleted)
                task.purge_dirs = int(pr.directories_deleted)
                task.warnings.append(
                    f"已清空目标目录 {task.dst_path}:删除 {task.purge_files} 个文件 / "
                    f"{task.purge_dirs} 个文件夹"
                )
                self._emit_task(task)

            # 3) 在源端提交发送:dst_addr 指向目标数据端口,指纹 pin 目标证书
            async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(src.grpc_addr) as ch:
                handle = await asyncio.wait_for(
                    pbg.FtsStub(ch).Submit(
                        pb.TransferRequest(
                            paths=[task.src_path],
                            dst_addr=dst.data_addr,
                            fingerprint=dst.fingerprint,
                            ticket=ticket,
                            streams=task.streams,
                            chunk_size=task.chunk_size,
                            transport=task.transport or "",
                        )
                    ),
                    timeout=self.rpc_timeout,
                )
            task.source_task_id = handle.task_id
            self._emit_task(task)

            # 4) 订阅事件流(进度/结果)
            await self._observe(src.grpc_addr, task)
        except OrchestrationError as e:
            task.state = "FAILED"
            task.error_code = e.code
            task.error = e.name
            task.error_message = str(e)
        except grpc.aio.AioRpcError as e:
            task.state = "FAILED"
            task.error_code = ORCH_ERR_GENERIC
            task.error = "GRPC_ERROR"
            task.error_message = f"{e.details()} ({e.code().name})"
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            task.state = "FAILED"
            task.error_code = ORCH_ERR_GENERIC
            task.error = "ORCH_ERROR"
            task.error_message = str(e)
        finally:
            # 5) 收尾:拉一次 Status 补齐 error_message / 兜底终态(防漏事件)
            if task.source_task_id:
                await self._finalize(task)
            if task.state not in TERMINAL:
                task.state = "COMPLETED" if task.checksum_ok else "FAILED"
                if not task.checksum_ok and not task.error:
                    task.error, task.error_code = "NO_RESULT", ORCH_ERR_GENERIC
                    task.error_message = "事件流结束但未收到终态且 Status 无终态"
            task.ended_at = time.time()
            self._emit_task(task)
        return task

    async def _observe(self, grpc_addr: str, task: Task) -> None:
        """订阅 Observe 流;流不会在 result 后自动关闭,故收到终态主动断开。

        传输极快时可能订阅晚于 result → 事件全丢;因此超时轮询 Status 兜底。
        """
        async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(grpc_addr) as ch:
            call = pbg.FtsStub(ch).Observe(pb.ObserveRequest(task_id=task.source_task_id))
            q: asyncio.Queue = asyncio.Queue()

            async def pump() -> None:
                try:
                    async for ev in call:
                        q.put_nowait(("event", ev.raw_json))
                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                    q.put_nowait(("error", str(e)))
                finally:
                    q.put_nowait(("done", None))

            pump_task = asyncio.create_task(pump())
            try:
                while True:
                    try:
                        kind, val = await asyncio.wait_for(q.get(), timeout=2.0)
                    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                        st = await self._status(grpc_addr, task.source_task_id)
                        if st is None or st.state in TERMINAL:
                            break
                        continue
                    if kind == "event":
                        self._handle_event(task, val)
                        if task.state in TERMINAL:
                            break
                    elif kind == "done":
                        break
                    else:  # error
                        task.warnings.append(f"事件流中断: {val}")
                        break
            finally:
                pump_task.cancel()
                call.cancel()

    def _handle_event(self, task: Task, raw_json: str) -> None:
        try:
            ev = json.loads(raw_json)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            return
        kind = ev.get("type")
        if kind == "task":
            task.state = ev.get("state", "RUNNING")
        elif kind == "file":
            task.files_total = int(ev.get("total") or 0)
            task.current_file = ev.get("name", "")
            task.cur_bytes = 0
            task.cur_total = 0
        elif kind == "progress":
            task.cur_bytes = int(ev.get("bytes_done") or 0)
            task.cur_total = int(ev.get("bytes_total") or 0)
            task.throughput_bps = int(ev.get("throughput_bps") or 0)
            eta = ev.get("eta_seconds")
            task.eta_seconds = int(eta) if eta is not None else None
        elif kind == "file_done":
            task.done_bytes += int(ev.get("bytes") or 0)
            task.files_done += 1
            task.cur_bytes = task.cur_total = 0
        elif kind == "degradation":
            msg = f"降级 {ev.get('from')} → {ev.get('to')}: {ev.get('reason')}"
            task.warnings.append(msg)
        elif kind == "result":
            task.state = ev.get("state", task.state)
            task.checksum_ok = bool(ev.get("checksum_ok"))
            if ev.get("error"):
                task.error = ev["error"]
                task.error_code = int(ev.get("error_code") or 0)
        elif kind == "error":
            task.warnings.append(f"事件流告警: {ev.get('message')}")
        # path / 未知类型:忽略(契约:未知事件被下游忽略)
        self._emit_task(task)

    async def _status(self, grpc_addr: str, task_id: str):
        try:
            async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(grpc_addr) as ch:
                return await asyncio.wait_for(
                    pbg.FtsStub(ch).Status(pb.TaskRef(task_id=task_id)), timeout=self.rpc_timeout
                )
        except grpc.aio.AioRpcError as e:
            if e.code() == grpc.StatusCode.NOT_FOUND:
                return None
            return None
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return None

    async def _finalize(self, task: Task) -> None:
        addr = self.endpoints[task.src].grpc_addr
        st = await self._status(addr, task.source_task_id)
        if st is None:
            return
        if task.state not in TERMINAL:
            task.state = st.state or "FAILED"
        task.checksum_ok = task.checksum_ok or st.checksum_ok
        if st.error_code:
            task.error_code = st.error_code
            task.error = st.error
            task.error_message = st.error_message or task.error_message

    async def cancel(self, task_id: str) -> bool:
        task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
        if task is None or not task.source_task_id:
            return False
        if task.state in TERMINAL:
            return True
        addr = self.endpoints[task.src].grpc_addr
        try:
            async with grpc.aio.insecure_channel(addr) as ch:
                await asyncio.wait_for(
                    pbg.FtsStub(ch).Cancel(pb.TaskRef(task_id=task.source_task_id)),
                    timeout=self.rpc_timeout,
                )
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            task.warnings.append(f"取消失败: {e}")
            return False
        # Cancel 不回发 result 事件,由编排层置终态
        task.state = "CANCELLED"
        task.error_code = 6
        task.error = "CANCELLED"
        task.ended_at = time.time()
        self._emit_task(task)
        return True


def load_config(path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        return json.load(f)
````

## File: File-Transfer/orch/gen_proto.py
````python
"""从 proto/fts.proto 生成 Python gRPC stub。

用法(在 orch/ 目录下):
    python gen_proto.py

依赖: pip install grpcio-tools
生成 fts_pb2.py / fts_pb2_grpc.py 到本目录,供 core.py 直接 import。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROTO = HERE.parent / "proto" / "fts.proto"


def main() -> int:
    if not PROTO.exists():
        print(f"找不到 proto: {PROTO}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    subprocess.check_call(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "-m",
            "grpc_tools.protoc",
            f"-I{PROTO.parent}",
            f"--python_out={HERE}",
            f"--grpc_python_out={HERE}",
            str(PROTO),
        ]
    )
    print(f"生成完成: {HERE / 'fts_pb2.py'} / {HERE / 'fts_pb2_grpc.py'}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
````

## File: File-Transfer/orch/README.md
````markdown
# fts 编排 server(orch)

一个独立的 Python 编排服务:输入两端主机和路径,由它通过 **gRPC** 分别指挥两端完成传输,
带进度条、错误回报和最小化 Web UI。多任务可并行(如 A1→B1 / A2→B2 / A3→B3)。

> 完整案例(背景、部署、真多机实操、排查手册)见 [../plan/fts-server-demo.md](../plan/fts-server-demo.md)。

## 它是怎么工作的(push 模型)

fts 是**纯 push** 模型:数据连接永远由**源端**发起去连**目标端**,没有任何"命令接收端去拉取"的 RPC。
所以 server 不搬数据,它是两端的 gRPC 客户端:

```
Capabilities(A)  探活 + 读 A 的身份(指纹/监听端口)
Capabilities(B)  探活 + 读 B 的身份
ReserveInbox(B)  在 B 上预注册落盘目录 → ticket
Submit(A)        paths=源路径, dst_addr=B:数据端口, fingerprint=B指纹, ticket → task_id
Observe(A)       订阅 NDJSON 事件流 → 进度 / 结果
                 (之后 A 自己直连 B 传数据,字节不经过 server)
```

前置条件:daemon 的 `Capabilities` 需返回指纹与监听地址(见 `proto/fts.proto` 的
`CapabilitiesReply.fingerprint/listen_addr`),这样 server 只凭 gRPC 地址即可全自动编排,
无需人工抄指纹。

## 安装

```powershell
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python gen_proto.py            # 从 ../proto/fts.proto 生成 fts_pb2*.py
```

要求 Python 3.10+;daemon 侧需用支持自描述的构建(`cargo build --release`)。

## 配置

复制 `config.example.json` 为 `config.json`。每台主机只需 `name` + `grpc_addr`,
指纹与数据端口由 `Capabilities` 自动发现:

```json
{
  "timeout_sec": 3,
  "defaults": { "transport": "auto", "streams": 0, "chunk_size": 0 },
  "endpoints": [
    { "name": "A1", "grpc_addr": "10.0.0.11:50051" },
    { "name": "B1", "grpc_addr": "10.0.0.21:50051" }
  ],
  "tasks": [
    { "name": "A1->B1", "src": "A1", "src_path": "C:\\data\\payload.bin",
      "dst": "B1", "dst_path": "D:\\recv" },
    { "name": "folder", "src": "A1", "src_path": "C:\\data\\srcdir",
      "dst": "B1", "dst_path": "D:\\recv", "purge": true }
  ]
}
```

## 用法

```powershell
# 1) 探活:确认两端存在且活着(控制面 gRPC + 数据面 TCP 双重)
python cli.py --config config.json --check

# 2) 并行编排三个任务
python cli.py --config config.json --pairs "A1:B1,A2:B2,A3:B3" `
    --src-path C:\data\payload.bin --dst-path D:\recv

# 2b) 传整个文件夹(递归,保留相对路径结构)+ 传输前清空目标目录(危险,不可恢复)
python cli.py --config config.json --pairs "A1:B1" `
    --src-path D:\data\srcdir --dst-path D:\recv --purge
# 目录按相对路径落盘:D:\recv\srcdir\...(子目录结构保留;空目录不传)

# 3) 运行 config.json 里的 tasks(每任务可有不同目标目录)
python cli.py --config config.json --run-config-tasks

# 4) Web UI(浏览器操作,带实时进度条)
python cli.py --config config.json --serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

退出码:0 = 全部 COMPLETED 且校验通过;1 = 有任务失败;2 = 参数/配置错误。

## 单机复现(无需多台主机)

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File run_local_demo.ps1
```

起 6 个 daemon(各独立端口/证书目录 → 6 个不同指纹),生成测试文件,并行跑
A1→B1 / A2→B2 / A3→B3,校验落盘文件大小,然后清理。

## server 自身的 API(供 Web UI / 脚本)

| 方法/路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `GET /` | 静态页 |
| `GET /api/hosts` | 主机列表(含探活结果) |
| `POST /api/hosts/check` | 重新探活 |
| `GET /api/tasks` | 任务列表 |
| `POST /api/tasks` | 新建并启动任务 |
| `POST /api/tasks/{id}/cancel` | 取消 |
| `GET /api/events` | SSE 增量(任务/主机) |

## 文件

```
core.py              编排引擎(探活/ReserveInbox/Submit/Observe/取消/事件总线)
cli.py               命令行入口(--check / --pairs / --run-config-tasks / --serve)
app.py               FastAPI:REST + SSE(Web UI 后端)
static/index.html    Web UI(原生 JS + EventSource)
gen_proto.py         生成 gRPC stub
config.example.json  配置样例
run_local_demo.ps1   单机 6-daemon 并行演示
```
````
