````rust
//! 统一错误类型与退出码(api-spec 第 9.1 节契约的 P1 子集)。

use std::fmt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum FtsError {
    /// 3 = 连接失败
    Connect(String),
    /// 3 = 协议版本不匹配(同属连接类)
    Version(String),
    /// 4 = 校验失败,数据不可信
    Checksum(String),
    /// 7 = 认证失败(证书指纹不匹配等)
    Auth(String),
    /// 5 = 传输中断且不可续传
    Interrupted(String),
    /// 6 = 被取消(P1 预留,Ctrl+C 处理接入后启用)
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    Cancelled,
    /// 2 = 参数错误(多文件重名等;CLI 解析错误由 clap 直接处理)
    InvalidArg(String),
    /// 1 = 本地 I/O / 其他错误
    Io(String),
}

impl fmt::Display for FtsError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            FtsError::Connect(m) => write!(f, "连接失败: {m}"),
            FtsError::Version(m) => write!(f, "协议版本不匹配: {m}"),
            FtsError::Checksum(m) => write!(f, "校验失败: {m}"),
            FtsError::Auth(m) => write!(f, "认证失败: {m}"),
            FtsError::Interrupted(m) => write!(f, "传输中断: {m}"),
            FtsError::Cancelled => write!(f, "被取消"),
            FtsError::InvalidArg(m) => write!(f, "参数错误: {m}"),
            FtsError::Io(m) => write!(f, "I/O 错误: {m}"),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for FtsError {}

impl FtsError {
    pub fn io(e: std::io::Error) -> FtsError {
        FtsError::Io(e.to_string())
    }

    pub fn exit_code(&self) -> u8 {
        match self {
            FtsError::Connect(_) | FtsError::Version(_) => 3,
            FtsError::Checksum(_) => 4,
            FtsError::Interrupted(_) => 5,
            FtsError::Cancelled => 6,
            FtsError::Auth(_) => 7,
            FtsError::InvalidArg(_) => 2,
            FtsError::Io(_) => 1,
        }
    }

    /// 简短错误名(api-spec 9.1),用于 JSON error 事件。
    pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            FtsError::Connect(_) => "CONNECT_FAILED",
            FtsError::Version(_) => "INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION",
            FtsError::Checksum(_) => "CHECKSUM_FAILED",
            FtsError::Auth(_) => "AUTH_FAILED",
            FtsError::Interrupted(_) => "INTERRUPTED",
            FtsError::Cancelled => "CANCELLED",
            FtsError::InvalidArg(_) => "INVALID_ARG",
            FtsError::Io(_) => "IO_ERROR",
        }
    }

    /// I/O 错误 → 带可操作提示的 Io 错误。
    /// 重点翻译网络路径(SMB/UNC)常见错误:fts 不弹凭据框(CLI/服务程序),
    /// 凭据须由调用方预先建立(cmdkey / net use / 域环境自动)。
    pub fn io_with_hint(e: std::io::Error) -> FtsError {
        let hint = match e.raw_os_error() {
            Some(5) => Some("拒绝访问:确认共享与 NTFS 权限;若凭据缺失见 1326 的处理"),
            Some(1326) => Some(
                "登录失败(凭据无效或未提供):网络路径请先建立凭据 —— \
                 `cmdkey /add:<主机> /user:<用户> /pass:<密码>`(推荐,一次即可)或 \
                 `net use \\\\主机\\共享 /user:<用户> <密码>`",
            ),
            Some(53) | Some(67) => {
                Some("找不到网络路径/网络名:主机名或共享名错误,或网络不通;UNC 应形如 \\\\主机\\共享\\子目录")
            }
            Some(1219) => Some(
                "存在到同一网络资源的多个凭据会话:执行 `net use * /delete` 清理后重试",
            ),
            _ => None,
        };
        match hint {
            Some(h) => FtsError::Io(format!("{e} — 提示:{h}")),
            None => FtsError::Io(e.to_string()),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn io_hint_translates_smb_errors() {
        let e = std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(1326);
        let msg = FtsError::io_with_hint(e).to_string();
        assert!(msg.contains("cmdkey"), "应包含凭据建立提示: {msg}");
        let e = std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(5);
        let msg = FtsError::io_with_hint(e).to_string();
        assert!(msg.contains("权限"), "应包含权限提示: {msg}");
        let e = std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(2); // 无提示的普通错误
        let msg = FtsError::io_with_hint(e).to_string();
        assert!(!msg.contains("提示"), "无映射错误不应带提示: {msg}");
    }
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/ffi.rs
````rust
//! C ABI 最小导出(api-spec 第 5 节子集,P3)。
//! 内存策略:全部返回静态或全局托管字符串,宿主**不得释放**——从根上消除跨边界 free;
//! `fts_last_error()` 返回值在下一次调用前有效(api-spec 5.4 契约:需保留必须拷贝)。
//! 错误码 = CLI 退出码契约(0 成功 / 3 连接 / 4 校验 / 7 认证 …)。

use crate::send::SendCfg;
use crate::tls::PinMode;
use crate::ui::Output;
use std::ffi::{c_char, CStr, CString};
use std::sync::{Mutex, OnceLock};

static LAST_ERROR: Mutex<Option<CString>> = Mutex::new(None);
static EMPTY: OnceLock<CString> = OnceLock::new();

fn rt() -> &'static tokio::runtime::Runtime {
    static RT: OnceLock<tokio::runtime::Runtime> = OnceLock::new();
    RT.get_or_init(|| tokio::runtime::Runtime::new().expect("tokio runtime"))
}

fn empty() -> &'static CString {
    EMPTY.get_or_init(|| CString::new(String::new()).expect("empty is valid"))
}

fn set_err(msg: String) {
    if let Ok(mut guard) = LAST_ERROR.lock() {
        *guard = CString::new(msg.replace('\0', " ")).ok();
    }
}

unsafe fn read_str(p: *const c_char) -> Option<String> {
    if p.is_null() {
        return None;
    }
    // SAFETY:调用方(FFI 宿主)保证 p 指向有效 NUL 结尾字符串
    Some(unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(p).to_string_lossy().into_owned() })
}

/// fts 产品版本(静态字符串,勿释放)
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn fts_version() -> *const c_char {
    concat!(env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"), "\0").as_ptr() as *const c_char
}

/// C ABI 版本(结构变化时递增)
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn fts_abi_version() -> u32 {
    1
}

/// 最近一次错误的可读消息;下次任何 fts_* 调用前有效。无错误时返回空串。
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub extern "C" fn fts_last_error() -> *const c_char {
    match LAST_ERROR.lock() {
        Ok(guard) => match guard.as_ref() {
            Some(s) => s.as_ptr(),
            None => empty().as_ptr(),
        },
        Err(_) => empty().as_ptr(),
    }
}

/// 阻塞式发送文件(P3 最小集成面:提交 → 等待 → 校验退出码)。
///
/// 参数:
///   src_path         UTF-8 源文件路径(必填)
///   dst_addr         "host:port"(必填)
///   fingerprint_hex  对端证书 BLAKE3 指纹 64 hex;可为 NULL(此时必须 insecure != 0)
///   insecure         非 0 = 跳过证书校验(仅测试)
///   streams          并行流数,0 = 4
///   chunk_size       分块字节,0 = 8 MiB
///   transport        "auto"/"quic"/"tcp",NULL 视为 "auto"
///
/// 返回:0 成功;否则为契约退出码(3 连接/4 校验/7 认证/1 其他),详情见 fts_last_error。
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn fts_send_file(
    src_path: *const c_char,
    dst_addr: *const c_char,
    fingerprint_hex: *const c_char,
    insecure: i32,
    streams: u32,
    chunk_size: u32,
    transport: *const c_char,
) -> i32 {
    let src = unsafe { read_str(src_path) };
    let Some(src) = src else {
        set_err("src_path 不能为空".into());
        return 1;
    };
    let dst = unsafe { read_str(dst_addr) };
    let Some(dst) = dst else {
        set_err("dst_addr 不能为空".into());
        return 1;
    };
    let fp = unsafe { read_str(fingerprint_hex) };
    let pin = match (&fp, insecure != 0) {
        (Some(hex), false) => match crate::tls::decode_fingerprint(hex) {
            Some(bytes) => PinMode::Fingerprint(bytes),
            None => {
                set_err("fingerprint 格式无效,应为 64 位 hex".into());
                return 2;
            }
        },
        (None, true) => PinMode::Insecure,
        (Some(_), true) => {
            set_err("fingerprint 与 insecure 不能同时使用".into());
            return 2;
        }
        (None, false) => {
            set_err("必须提供 fingerprint 或 insecure".into());
            return 2;
        }
    };
    let transport = unsafe { read_str(transport) }.unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".into());

    let cfg = SendCfg {
        paths: vec![src.into()],
        to: dst,
        chunk_size: if chunk_size == 0 { crate::protocol::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE } else { chunk_size },
        streams: if streams == 0 { 4 } else { streams.clamp(1, 64) },
        pin,
        transport,
        ticket: None,
        out: Output::Silent,
        events: None,
    };

    match rt().block_on(crate::send::run_send(cfg)) {
        Ok(()) => {
            set_err(String::new());
            0
        }
        Err(e) => {
            let code = e.exit_code() as i32;
            set_err(format!("{e}"));
            code
        }
    }
}
````

````rust
//! gRPC 服务(W4):api-spec 7.2 的 P5 子集 + ReserveInbox。
//! 与 REST 共享同一 Registry(任务表)与 InboxRegistry;仅监听 localhost(契约 7.6)。
//! 事件:内部 broadcast<String>(NDJSON)→ TransferEvent{raw_json}(向前兼容)。

use crate::daemon::Registry;
use crate::send::SendCfg;
use crate::tls::PinMode;
use crate::ui::Output;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use tokio_stream::wrappers::BroadcastStream;
use tokio_stream::{StreamExt, Stream};
use tonic::{Request, Response, Status};

pub mod pb {
    include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/fts.v1.rs"));
}

/// FtsError → gRPC Status(错误名映射;消息原文保留)
fn status_from_fts(e: crate::error::FtsError) -> Status {
    match &e {
        crate::error::FtsError::InvalidArg(_) => Status::invalid_argument(format!("{e}")),
        crate::error::FtsError::Auth(_) => Status::permission_denied(format!("{e}")),
        crate::error::FtsError::Connect(_) | crate::error::FtsError::Version(_) => {
            Status::unavailable(format!("{e}"))
        }
        _ => Status::internal(format!("{e}")),
    }
}

use pb::fts_server::{Fts, FtsServer};
use pb::{
    Ack, CapabilitiesReply, Empty, InboxToken, ObserveRequest, PurgeReply, PurgeRequest,
    ReserveInboxRequest, TaskRef, TransferEvent, TransferHandle, TransferRequest, TransferStatus,
    UpdateRequest,
};

pub struct GrpcService {
    reg: Registry,
}

#[tonic::async_trait]
impl Fts for GrpcService {
    async fn capabilities(
        &self,
        _req: Request<Empty>,
    ) -> Result<Response<CapabilitiesReply>, Status> {
        Ok(Response::new(CapabilitiesReply {
            protocol_version: crate::protocol::PROTOCOL_VERSION.to_string(),
            capabilities: 1 << 3, // bit3 = resume(对齐 REST)
            fts_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
            fingerprint: self.reg.fingerprint.clone(),
            listen_addr: self.reg.listen_addr.clone(),
            started_at: self.reg.started_at,
        }))
    }

    async fn reserve_inbox(
        &self,
        req: Request<ReserveInboxRequest>,
    ) -> Result<Response<InboxToken>, Status> {
        let r = req.into_inner();
        if r.out_dir.is_empty() {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument("out_dir 不能为空"));
        }
        // W6:凭据会话先建立(密码不进任何错误/日志)
        if let Some(cred) = &r.credential {
            let local = crate::netcred::NetworkCredential {
                user_name: cred.user_name.clone(),
                password: cred.password.clone(),
                domain: cred.domain.clone(),
            };
            crate::netcred::establish_connection(&r.out_dir, &local).map_err(status_from_fts)?;
            eprintln!(
                "[info] inbox 凭据会话已建立: {} ({})",
                r.out_dir,
                crate::netcred::describe(&local)
            );
        }
        let file_name = if r.file_name.is_empty() { None } else { Some(r.file_name) };
        let token = self.reg.inbox.reserve(PathBuf::from(&r.out_dir), file_name);
        Ok(Response::new(InboxToken {
            token,
            expires_in: crate::inbox::TICKET_TTL.as_secs(),
        }))
    }

    /// W6:危险操作 —— 清空目录模式 token 绑定目录的全部内容
    async fn purge_inbox(
        &self,
        req: Request<PurgeRequest>,
    ) -> Result<Response<PurgeReply>, Status> {
        let r = req.into_inner();
        if !r.force {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument(
                "purge 是危险操作,必须显式 force=true",
            ));
        }
        let dir = self.reg.inbox.peek_purgeable(&r.token).map_err(|(reason, invalid)| {
            if invalid {
                Status::not_found(reason)
            } else {
                Status::permission_denied(reason)
            }
        })?;
        let (files, directories) = crate::daemon::purge_dir_contents(&dir)
            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(format!("{e}")))?;
        eprintln!(
            "[warn] PURGE 目录已清空: {} (删除 {files} 个文件 / {directories} 个文件夹) token={}",
            dir.display(),
            r.token
        );
        Ok(Response::new(PurgeReply {
            files_deleted: files,
            directories_deleted: directories,
        }))
    }

    async fn submit(
        &self,
        req: Request<TransferRequest>,
    ) -> Result<Response<TransferHandle>, Status> {
        let r = req.into_inner();
        let pin = match (!r.fingerprint.is_empty(), r.insecure) {
            (true, false) => match crate::tls::decode_fingerprint(&r.fingerprint) {
                Some(b) => PinMode::Fingerprint(b),
                None => {
                    return Err(Status::invalid_argument("fingerprint 格式无效,应为 64 位 hex"))
                }
            },
            (false, true) => PinMode::Insecure,
            (true, true) => return Err(Status::invalid_argument("fingerprint 与 insecure 互斥")),
            (false, false) => {
                return Err(Status::invalid_argument("必须提供 fingerprint 或 insecure=true"))
            }
        };
        if r.paths.is_empty() {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument("paths 不能为空"));
        }

        let (events_tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(256);
        let task_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let state = Arc::new(Mutex::new("RUNNING".to_string()));
        let error: Arc<Mutex<Option<(u8, String, String)>>> = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
        let checksum_ok = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false));

        let send_cfg = SendCfg {
            paths: r.paths.iter().map(PathBuf::from).collect(),
            to: r.dst_addr.clone(),
            chunk_size: if r.chunk_size == 0 {
                crate::protocol::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
            } else {
                u32::try_from(r.chunk_size).unwrap_or(crate::protocol::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE)
            },
            streams: if r.streams == 0 { 4 } else { r.streams.clamp(1, 64) },
            pin,
            transport: if r.transport.is_empty() { "auto".into() } else { r.transport.clone() },
            ticket: if r.ticket.is_empty() { None } else { Some(r.ticket.clone()) },
            out: Output::Silent,
            events: Some(events_tx.clone()),
        };

        let st = state.clone();
        let er = error.clone();
        let cko = checksum_ok.clone();
        let handle = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let result = crate::send::run_send(send_cfg).await;
            match result {
                Ok(()) => {
                    *st.lock().unwrap() = "COMPLETED".into();
                    cko.store(true, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    let cancelled = matches!(e, crate::error::FtsError::Cancelled);
                    *st.lock().unwrap() =
                        if cancelled { "CANCELLED".into() } else { "FAILED".into() };
                    *er.lock().unwrap() =
                        Some((e.exit_code(), e.name().to_string(), format!("{e}")));
                }
            }
        });

        self.reg.inner.lock().unwrap().insert(
            task_id.clone(),
            crate::daemon::TaskEntry {
                state,
                error,
                checksum_ok,
                abort: Arc::new(handle.abort_handle()),
                events: events_tx,
            },
        );
        Ok(Response::new(TransferHandle { task_id }))
    }

    type ObserveStream =
        std::pin::Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<TransferEvent, Status>> + Send>>;

    async fn observe(
        &self,
        req: Request<ObserveRequest>,
    ) -> Result<Response<Self::ObserveStream>, Status> {
        let id = req.into_inner().task_id;
        let entry = self.reg.inner.lock().unwrap().get(&id).cloned();
        match entry {
            Some(e) => {
                let rx = e.events.subscribe();
                let stream = BroadcastStream::new(rx).map(|item| {
                    Ok(TransferEvent {
                        raw_json: item.unwrap_or_else(|_| {
                            r#"{"type":"error","message":"lagged"}"#.to_string()
                        }),
                    })
                });
                Ok(Response::new(Box::pin(stream)))
            }
            None => Err(Status::not_found("任务不存在")),
        }
    }

    async fn status(&self, req: Request<TaskRef>) -> Result<Response<TransferStatus>, Status> {
        let id = req.into_inner().task_id;
        let entry = self.reg.inner.lock().unwrap().get(&id).cloned();
        match entry {
            Some(e) => {
                let state = e.state.lock().unwrap().clone();
                let mut body = TransferStatus {
                    task_id: id,
                    state,
                    checksum_ok: e.checksum_ok.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed),
                    error_code: 0,
                    error: String::new(),
                    error_message: String::new(),
                };
                if let Some((code, name, msg)) = e.error.lock().unwrap().clone() {
                    body.error_code = code as i32;
                    body.error = name;
                    body.error_message = msg;
                }
                Ok(Response::new(body))
            }
            None => Err(Status::not_found("任务不存在")),
        }
    }

    async fn cancel(&self, req: Request<TaskRef>) -> Result<Response<Ack>, Status> {
        let id = req.into_inner().task_id;
        let entry = self.reg.inner.lock().unwrap().get(&id).cloned();
        match entry {
            Some(e) => {
                let running = *e.state.lock().unwrap() == "RUNNING";
                if running {
                    e.abort.abort();
                    *e.state.lock().unwrap() = "CANCELLED".into();
                }
                Ok(Response::new(Ack { ok: true }))
            }
            None => Err(Status::not_found("任务不存在")),
        }
    }

    /// W9:远程更新 —— 校验暂存区后拉起新版 fts.exe apply-update,随后本进程自退。
    /// Ack 返回即代表已受理;调用方之后轮询 Capabilities 等待新 fts_version。
    async fn begin_update(&self, req: Request<UpdateRequest>) -> Result<Response<Ack>, Status> {
        let r = req.into_inner();
        if r.staging_dir.trim().is_empty() {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument("staging_dir 不能为空"));
        }
        let staging = PathBuf::from(&r.staging_dir);
        if !staging.is_dir() {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument(format!("暂存目录不存在: {}", staging.display())));
        }
        if !r.files.iter().any(|f| f.eq_ignore_ascii_case("fts.exe")) {
            return Err(Status::invalid_argument("files 必须包含 fts.exe"));
        }
        for f in &r.files {
            // 纯文件名:拒绝路径分隔符/穿越(直接落在安装目录)
            if f.contains('/') || f.contains('\\') || f.contains("..") {
                return Err(Status::invalid_argument(format!("文件名不允许包含路径分隔符: {f}")));
            }
            if !staging.join(f).is_file() {
                return Err(Status::invalid_argument(format!("暂存区缺少文件: {f}")));
            }
        }
        let running = self
            .reg
            .inner
            .lock()
            .unwrap()
            .values()
            .any(|e| *e.state.lock().unwrap() == "RUNNING");
        if running && !r.force {
            return Err(Status::failed_precondition(
                "存在 RUNNING 传输任务,更新会中断传输;确认无影响后传 force=true",
            ));
        }

        let exe = std::env::current_exe()
            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(format!("current_exe 失败: {e}")))?;
        let install = exe
            .parent()
            .ok_or_else(|| Status::internal("current_exe 无父目录"))?
            .to_path_buf();

        // 以 DETACHED 拉起暂存区里的新版 exe(自己负责等旧进程退出/强杀/换文件/重启)
        let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(staging.join("fts.exe"));
        cmd.arg("apply-update")
            .arg("--pid").arg(std::process::id().to_string())
            .arg("--install").arg(&install)
            .arg("--staging").arg(&staging)
            .arg("--from").arg(env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
        for f in &r.files {
            cmd.arg("--files").arg(f);
        }
        if !self.reg.config_path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            cmd.arg("--config").arg(&self.reg.config_path);
        }
        cmd.current_dir(
            std::env::current_dir().map_err(|e| Status::internal(format!("current_dir 失败: {e}")))?,
        )
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null());
        #[cfg(windows)]
        {
            use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
            // DETACHED_PROCESS | CREATE_NO_WINDOW:更新器无窗口,输出走 apply.log
            cmd.creation_flags(0x0000_0008 | 0x0800_0000);
        }
        cmd.spawn()
            .map_err(|e| Status::internal(format!("拉起 apply-update 失败: {e}")))?;

        eprintln!(
            "[warn] UPDATE:apply-update 已拉起(install={}, files={:?}),daemon 即将退出以应用更新",
            install.display(),
            r.files
        );
        // 给 tonic 留出把 Ack 发回的时间,然后自退;pid 文件残留由 fts start 清理
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(800)).await;
            std::process::exit(0);
        });
        Ok(Response::new(Ack { ok: true }))
    }
}

/// 启动 gRPC 服务(阻塞当前任务直到服务退出)
pub async fn serve(
    addr: std::net::SocketAddr,
    reg: Registry,
) -> Result<(), crate::error::FtsError> {
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(addr)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| crate::error::FtsError::Io(format!("gRPC 监听失败 {addr}: {e}")))?;
    eprintln!("fts daemon gRPC 监听 http://{addr}");
    tonic::transport::Server::builder()
        .add_service(FtsServer::new(GrpcService { reg }))
        .serve_with_incoming(tokio_stream::wrappers::TcpListenerStream::new(listener))
        .await
        .map_err(|e| crate::error::FtsError::Io(format!("gRPC 服务失败: {e}")))
}
````

````rust
//! inbox 预注册(P5 W1):接收目录 per-task 分配。
//! 调用方(REST/gRPC)注册 {out_dir, file_name?} 拿一次性 token;
//! 发送端把 token 放进 Manifest.ticket;接收端查表决定落盘目录。
//! 语义(见 plan/fts-p5-integration-design.md 第 2 节):
//!   - 一次性:匹配成功即焚;
//!   - 有效期 10 分钟;
//!   - file_name = Some → 绑定精确文件名(防挪用);None → 目录模式,任意文件名;
//!   - 无 ticket → 落 daemon 默认 --out(完全向后兼容)。

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use uuid::Uuid;

pub const TICKET_TTL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(600);

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct InboxEntry {
    pub out_dir: PathBuf,
    /// None = 目录模式(任意文件名)
    pub file_name: Option<String>,
    pub expires_at: Instant,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct InboxRegistry {
    inner: Mutex<HashMap<String, InboxEntry>>,
}

impl InboxRegistry {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        InboxRegistry { inner: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()) }
    }

    /// 注册;返回 token。file_name=None 为目录模式。
    pub fn reserve(&self, out_dir: PathBuf, file_name: Option<String>) -> String {
        let token = Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().insert(
            token.clone(),
            InboxEntry { out_dir, file_name, expires_at: Instant::now() + TICKET_TTL },
        );
        token
    }

    /// 撤销(REST DELETE /v1/inbox/{token})
    pub fn revoke(&self, token: &str) -> bool {
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().remove(token).is_some()
    }

    /// W6:purge 授权检查 —— 只允许**目录模式** token(文件绑定 token 的授权范围
    /// 只是一个文件,不得触发整目录删除);不焚毁(传输还要用)。
    /// 返回 Err(("授权原因", 是否因 token 无效/过期 —— 无效时顺手焚毁防枚举))
    pub fn peek_purgeable(&self, token: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, (&'static str, bool)> {
        let mut map = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
        let Some(entry) = map.get(token) else {
            return Err(("ticket 无效或已使用", true));
        };
        if Instant::now() > entry.expires_at {
            map.remove(token);
            return Err(("ticket 已过期", true));
        }
        if entry.file_name.is_some() {
            return Err(("文件绑定 token 不允许 purge(授权范围仅为单个文件)", false));
        }
        Ok(entry.out_dir.clone())
    }

    /// 兑换:校验 token 有效性(存在、未过期、文件名匹配)→ 返回落盘目录。
    /// 文件绑定模式(file_name=Some):一次性,兑换即焚毁;
    /// 目录模式(file_name=None):TTL 内可复用(批量多文件走同一 token)。
    pub fn redeem(&self, token: &str, file_name: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, &'static str> {
        let mut map = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
        let Some(entry) = map.get(token) else {
            return Err("ticket 无效或已使用");
        };
        if Instant::now() > entry.expires_at {
            map.remove(token);
            return Err("ticket 已过期");
        }
        match &entry.file_name {
            Some(expect) if expect != file_name => {
                map.remove(token); // 错误使用也焚毁,防枚举
                Err("ticket 与文件名不匹配")
            }
            Some(_) => {
                let out_dir = entry.out_dir.clone();
                map.remove(token); // 文件绑定:一次性
                Ok(out_dir)
            }
            None => Ok(entry.out_dir.clone()), // 目录模式:可复用
        }
    }

    /// 清理过期项(定期调用;不调也只会缓慢泄漏,量级极小)
    pub fn gc(&self) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        self.inner.lock().unwrap().retain(|_, e| e.expires_at > now);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn redeem_once_then_gone() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), Some("a.bin".into()));
        assert_eq!(reg.redeem(&t, "a.bin").unwrap(), PathBuf::from("D:\\x"));
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "a.bin").is_err()); // 文件绑定模式:一次性
    }

    #[test]
    fn dir_token_reusable() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), None);
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "a.bin").is_ok());
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "b.bin").is_ok()); // 目录模式:TTL 内可复用(批量)
    }

    #[test]
    fn filename_binding_rejects_mismatch() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), Some("a.bin".into()));
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "b.bin").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn dir_mode_accepts_any_name() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), None);
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "whatever.bin").is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn revoke_works() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), None);
        assert!(reg.revoke(&t));
        assert!(reg.redeem(&t, "a.bin").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn purge_authorized_only_for_dir_mode() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let dir_token = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), None);
        let file_token = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\y"), Some("a.bin".into()));
        // 目录模式:允许,且不焚毁(redeem 仍可用)
        assert_eq!(reg.peek_purgeable(&dir_token).unwrap(), PathBuf::from("D:\\x"));
        assert!(reg.redeem(&dir_token, "a.bin").is_ok());
        // 文件绑定:拒绝且不焚毁
        let (msg, burned) = reg.peek_purgeable(&file_token).unwrap_err();
        assert!(msg.contains("不允许 purge"));
        assert!(!burned);
        assert!(reg.redeem(&file_token, "a.bin").is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn purge_invalid_token_reports_invalid() {
        let reg = InboxRegistry::new();
        let t = reg.reserve(PathBuf::from("D:\\x"), Some("a.bin".into()));
        // 陌生 token:invalid=true(HTTP 404 语义;"焚毁防枚举"只针对错误使用的已知 token)
        let (_, invalid) = reg.peek_purgeable("nonexistent").unwrap_err();
        assert!(invalid);
        let _ = t;
    }
}
````

````rust
//! fts — 高速文件传输(Windows + QUIC)。
//! bin 目标:CLI 与退出码映射;全部逻辑在 lib(fts)中,与 cdylib(DLL)共享。

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use fts::protocol::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE;
use fts::{daemon, recv, send, tls, ui, update};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::ExitCode;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "fts", version, about = "高速文件传输(QUIC + BLAKE3)")]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    cmd: Cmd,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Cmd {
    /// 发送文件(多路径/目录;目录展开为其中直接文件,不递归,展开后不得重名)
    Send {
        #[arg(required = true)]
        paths: Vec<PathBuf>,
        #[arg(long)]
        to: String,
        /// 对端证书指纹(recv 启动时打印的 BLAKE3 hex)
        #[arg(long)]
        fingerprint: Option<String>,
        /// 跳过证书校验(仅测试用,有指纹必填则不用此参数)
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
        insecure: bool,
        /// 分块大小(字节)
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE)]
        chunk_size: u32,
        /// 并行流数
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = 4)]
        streams: u32,
        /// inbox 预注册票据(daemon REST/gRPC 获取;决定对端落盘目录)
        #[arg(long)]
        ticket: Option<String>,
        /// NDJSON 事件输出到 stdout(集成用)
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
        json: bool,
        /// 传输层:auto=QUIC 失败回退 TCP;quic / tcp 强制
        #[arg(long, default_value = "auto")]
        transport: String,
        #[arg(short = 'v', long, default_value_t = false)]
        verbose: bool,
    },
    /// 接收文件
    Recv {
        #[arg(long)]
        listen: String,
        #[arg(long, default_value = ".")]
        out: PathBuf,
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
        json: bool,
        /// 传输层:auto=QUIC 与 TCP 同端口双监听;quic / tcp 只启用其一
        #[arg(long, default_value = "auto")]
        transport: String,
        /// 证书缓存目录(指纹跨运行稳定)
        #[arg(long, default_value = ".fts")]
        cert_cache: PathBuf,
        #[arg(short = 'v', long, default_value_t = false)]
        verbose: bool,
    },
    /// 后台启动 daemon(自动读 cwd 的 config.json;自后台化 + 健康检查)
    Start {
        #[arg(short = 'c')]
        config: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// 停止后台 daemon(按 pid 文件)
    Stop {
        #[arg(short = 'c')]
        config: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// 查看 daemon 状态
    Status {
        #[arg(short = 'c')]
        config: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// 启动常驻服务:接收循环 + 本地 REST/gRPC API(前台;后台用 fts start)
    Daemon {
        /// 配置文件(JSON;CLI 显式参数优先于它,它优先于内置默认)
        #[arg(long, short = 'c')]
        config: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// REST 监听地址(仅本地)
        #[arg(long)]
        rest: Option<String>,
        /// 传输监听地址(QUIC+TCP 双栈)
        #[arg(long)]
        listen: Option<String>,
        /// 默认接收目录(无 ticket 的传输落这里)
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<PathBuf>,
        #[arg(long)]
        cert_cache: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// 最大并发接收会话(QUIC 并发;TCP 会话天然互斥)
        #[arg(long)]
        max_sessions: Option<usize>,
        /// gRPC 监听地址(空串禁用)
        #[arg(long)]
        grpc: Option<String>,
    },
    /// W9(内部):由 BeginUpdate 从暂存区新版 exe 拉起,执行自替换 + 重启;勿手动调用
    #[command(hide = true)]
    ApplyUpdate {
        /// 旧 daemon 进程 pid
        #[arg(long)]
        pid: u32,
        /// 安装目录(覆盖目标)
        #[arg(long)]
        install: PathBuf,
        /// 暂存目录(新版文件来源)
        #[arg(long)]
        staging: PathBuf,
        /// 要应用的文件名(可重复;必须已在暂存区)
        #[arg(long)]
        files: Vec<String>,
        /// daemon 启动配置(透传给 fts start;缺省按 cwd 解析)
        #[arg(long)]
        config: Option<PathBuf>,
        /// 更新前版本(仅记录)
        #[arg(long)]
        from: String,
    },
    /// 远程推送新版 dist 并触发目标 daemon 自替换重启(W9;目标需已支持 BeginUpdate)
    PushUpdate {
        /// 目标 daemon gRPC 地址(host 或 host:50051)
        #[arg(long)]
        to: String,
        /// 本机新版 dist 目录
        #[arg(long)]
        dist: PathBuf,
        /// 连 config.json 一起覆盖(默认保留目标机配置)
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
        overwrite_config: bool,
        /// 目标有进行中传输任务时仍强制更新
        #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
        force: bool,
    },
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> ExitCode {
    // 控制台默认 GBK,Rust 输出 UTF-8 → 切 65001 防中文乱码
    #[cfg(windows)]
    unsafe {
        windows_sys::Win32::System::Console::SetConsoleOutputCP(65001);
    }
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    let result = match cli.cmd {
        Cmd::Send {
            paths,
            to,
            fingerprint,
            insecure,
            chunk_size,
            streams,
            ticket,
            json,
            transport,
            verbose: _,
        } => {
            let out = if json { ui::Output::Json } else { ui::Output::Human };
            let pin = match (&fingerprint, insecure) {
                (Some(fp), false) => match tls::decode_fingerprint(fp) {
                    Some(bytes) => tls::PinMode::Fingerprint(bytes),
                    None => {
                        eprintln!("错误: --fingerprint 格式无效,应为 64 位 hex");
                        return ExitCode::from(2);
                    }
                },
                (None, true) => tls::PinMode::Insecure,
                (Some(_), true) => {
                    eprintln!("错误: --fingerprint 与 --insecure 不能同时使用");
                    return ExitCode::from(2);
                }
                (None, false) => {
                    eprintln!("错误: 必须提供 --fingerprint <对端指纹>(recv 启动时打印)或 --insecure");
                    return ExitCode::from(2);
                }
            };
            send::run_send(send::SendCfg {
                paths,
                to,
                chunk_size,
                streams,
                pin,
                transport,
                ticket,
                out,
                events: None,
            })
            .await
        }
        Cmd::Recv { listen, out: out_dir, json, transport, cert_cache, verbose: _ } => {
            let out = if json { ui::Output::Json } else { ui::Output::Human };
            recv::run_recv(recv::RecvCfg {
                listen,
                out_dir,
                out,
                transport,
                cert_cache,
                events: None,
                inbox: None,
            })
            .await
        }
        Cmd::Start { config } => daemon::ctl_start(config).map(|_| ()),
        Cmd::Stop { config } => daemon::ctl_stop(config).map(|_| ()),
        Cmd::Status { config } => daemon::ctl_status(config).map(|_| ()),
        Cmd::Daemon { config, rest, listen, out, cert_cache, max_sessions, grpc } => {
            match build_daemon_cfg(config, rest, listen, out, cert_cache, max_sessions, grpc) {
                Ok(cfg) => daemon::run(cfg).await,
                Err(e) => Err(e),
            }
        }
        Cmd::ApplyUpdate { pid, install, staging, files, config, from } => {
            update::apply_update(update::ApplyUpdateCfg {
                pid,
                install_dir: install,
                staging_dir: staging,
                files,
                config,
                from_version: from,
            })
            .map(|_| ())
        }
        Cmd::PushUpdate { to, dist, overwrite_config, force } => {
            let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<String>(256);
            let printer = tokio::spawn(async move {
                while let Some(line) = rx.recv().await {
                    println!("{line}");
                }
            });
            let report = update::push_update(update::PushUpdateCfg {
                grpc_addr: to,
                dist_dir: dist,
                overwrite_config,
                force,
                on_event: Some(tx),
            })
            .await;
            let _ = printer.await;
            if report.ok {
                println!("更新成功: {} → {}", report.old_version, report.new_version);
                Ok(())
            } else {
                Err(fts::error::FtsError::Io(report.detail))
            }
        }
    };

    match result {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("错误: {e}");
            ExitCode::from(e.exit_code())
        }
    }
}

/// daemon 参数合并:CLI 显式参数 > 配置文件 > 内置默认
fn build_daemon_cfg(
    config: Option<PathBuf>,
    rest: Option<String>,
    listen: Option<String>,
    out: Option<PathBuf>,
    cert_cache: Option<PathBuf>,
    max_sessions: Option<usize>,
    grpc: Option<String>,
) -> Result<fts::daemon::DaemonCfg, fts::error::FtsError> {
    let fc = match &config {
        Some(p) => fts::daemon::load_file_config(p)?,
        None => fts::daemon::FileConfig::default(),
    };
    let rest_addr = rest.or(fc.rest_addr).unwrap_or_else(|| "127.0.0.1:5050".into());
    let listen_addr = listen.or(fc.listen_addr).unwrap_or_else(|| "0.0.0.0:4433".into());
    let out_dir = out.or(fc.out_dir).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
    let cert_cache = cert_cache.or(fc.cert_cache).unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(".fts"));
    let max_sessions = max_sessions.or(fc.max_sessions).unwrap_or(3);
    let grpc_raw = grpc.or(fc.grpc_addr).unwrap_or_else(|| "127.0.0.1:50051".into());
    let grpc_addr = if grpc_raw.trim().is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(grpc_raw.parse().map_err(|e| {
            fts::error::FtsError::InvalidArg(format!("gRPC 地址无效 {grpc_raw}: {e}"))
        })?)
    };
    Ok(fts::daemon::DaemonCfg {
        rest: rest_addr,
        listen: listen_addr,
        out_dir,
        cert_cache,
        max_sessions,
        grpc: grpc_addr,
        // W9:记录启动配置路径,BeginUpdate 拉起 apply-update 时透传给 fts start
        config_path: config.unwrap_or_default(),
    })
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/netcred.rs
````rust
//! 网络凭据会话(W6):目标为需要认证的 SMB/UNC 路径时,fts 代为建立 Windows 会话
//! (WNetAddConnection2W,会话级 —— 进程生命周期内有效,不持久化、不写入任何日志)。
//!
//! 安全边界:
//! - 凭据仅经 localhost 的 gRPC/REST 传输(gRPC 明文 —— 不要暴露端口);
//! - 密码不进入任何错误消息、日志、事件;
//! - fts 不存储凭据;OS 会话随进程结束失效;
//! - 凭据管理主渠道仍是 Windows 凭据管理器(cmdkey),本接口是集成方代建立会话的通道。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use std::os::windows::ffi::OsStrExt;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, serde::Deserialize, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct NetworkCredential {
    pub user_name: String,
    pub password: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub domain: String,
}

/// 从 UNC 路径提取 `\\host\share` 根(忽略大小写比较由 OS 完成)。
/// 非 UNC(不以 \\ 开头)返回 None。
pub fn parse_unc_root(path: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let p = path.trim_start_matches('?'); // \\?\UNC\ 前缀形态不管,只处理裸 UNC
    let p = p.trim();
    let rest = p.strip_prefix(r"\\")?;
    let mut it = rest.splitn(3, '\\');
    let host = it.next()?;
    let share = it.next()?;
    if host.is_empty() || share.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(format!(r"\\{host}\{share}"))
}

fn to_wide(s: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
    std::ffi::OsStr::new(s).encode_wide().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
}

/// 建立到 UNC 根的网络会话。已存在会话且凭据不同时 OS 返回 1219(冲突),
/// 此时不动已有会话,报错并提示(会话可能被其他进程使用,不得代为断开)。
pub fn establish_connection(out_dir: &str, cred: &NetworkCredential) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    let remote = parse_unc_root(out_dir).ok_or_else(|| {
        FtsError::InvalidArg(
            "credential 仅支持 UNC 网络路径(形如 \\\\主机\\共享\\...);本地路径无需凭据".into(),
        )
    })?;

    let mut remote_w = to_wide(&remote);
    // 用户名可带域:域字段非空时拼 "domain\user";不覆盖 user_name 内已带的写法
    let user_full = if cred.domain.is_empty() || cred.user_name.contains('\\') {
        cred.user_name.clone()
    } else {
        format!("{}\\{}", cred.domain, cred.user_name)
    };
    let user_w = to_wide(&user_full);
    let pass_w = to_wide(&cred.password);

    let mut nr = windows_sys::Win32::NetworkManagement::WNet::NETRESOURCEW {
        dwScope: 0,
        dwType: windows_sys::Win32::NetworkManagement::WNet::RESOURCETYPE_DISK,
        dwDisplayType: 0,
        dwUsage: 0,
        lpLocalName: std::ptr::null_mut(), // 不映射盘符
        lpRemoteName: remote_w.as_mut_ptr(),
        lpComment: std::ptr::null_mut(),
        lpProvider: std::ptr::null_mut(),
    };
    let rc = unsafe {
        windows_sys::Win32::NetworkManagement::WNet::WNetAddConnection2W(
            &mut nr,
            pass_w.as_ptr(),
            user_w.as_ptr(),
            windows_sys::Win32::NetworkManagement::WNet::CONNECT_TEMPORARY, // 会话级,不写 profile
        )
    };
    match rc {
        0 => Ok(()),
        1219 => Err(FtsError::Auth(format!(
            "网络会话冲突(1219):到 {remote} 已存在其他凭据的连接;先 `net use \\\\{remote} /delete` 或改用该会话已有的凭据"
        ))),
        1326 => Err(FtsError::Auth(
            "网络登录失败(1326):用户名/密码/域不正确".into(),
        )),
        5 => Err(FtsError::Auth("网络访问被拒绝(5):账号无该共享权限".into())),
        53 | 67 => Err(FtsError::Connect(format!(
            "找不到网络路径({rc}):主机或共享名错误,或网络不通({remote})"
        ))),
        other => Err(FtsError::Auth(format!(
            "建立网络会话失败(WNet 错误 {other})"
        ))),
    }
}

/// 脱敏显示凭据(日志/事件用):绝不含密码
pub fn describe(cred: &NetworkCredential) -> String {
    let who = if cred.domain.is_empty() {
        cred.user_name.clone()
    } else {
        format!("{}\\{}", cred.domain, cred.user_name)
    };
    format!("user={who} password=***")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn unc_root_extraction() {
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"\\nas01\share\fts"), Some(r"\\nas01\share".to_string()));
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"\\nas01\share"), Some(r"\\nas01\share".to_string()));
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"\\nas01\share\a\b\c.bin"), Some(r"\\nas01\share".to_string()));
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"C:\local\path"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"relative\path"), None);
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"\\host\"), None); // 缺 share
        assert_eq!(parse_unc_root(r"\\\share"), None); // 缺 host
    }

    #[test]
    fn describe_never_contains_password() {
        let c = NetworkCredential {
            user_name: "svc".into(),
            password: "SECRET-PW".into(),
            domain: "CORP".into(),
        };
        let d = describe(&c);
        assert!(!d.contains("SECRET-PW"));
        assert!(d.contains("CORP\\svc"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn establish_rejects_local_path() {
        let c = NetworkCredential {
            user_name: "u".into(),
            password: "p".into(),
            domain: String::new(),
        };
        let err = establish_connection(r"C:\local", &c).unwrap_err();
        assert!(matches!(err, FtsError::InvalidArg(_)));
        assert!(!err.to_string().contains('p')); // 密码不泄漏
    }
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/probe.rs
````rust
//! 路径探测:观测当前链路类型(design 第 4 节,Tailscale 感知)。
//! P2 范围:仅观测 + 事件记录,不参与切换决策;Tailscale 缺失/超时返回 Unknown。

use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::process::Command;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum LinkType {
    Direct,
    PeerRelay,
    Derp,
    Unknown,
}

impl LinkType {
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            LinkType::Direct => "direct",
            LinkType::PeerRelay => "peer_relay",
            LinkType::Derp => "derp",
            LinkType::Unknown => "unknown",
        }
    }
}

/// 探测对端路径。输出 (链路类型, RTT ms)。
/// 命令:`tailscale ping --c 1 --timeout 2s <ip>`;探测不得干扰传输,限时 3 秒。
pub async fn probe_peer(ip: &str) -> (LinkType, Option<u32>) {
    let probe = async {
        let out = Command::new("tailscale")
            .args(["ping", "--c", "1", "--timeout", "2s", ip])
            .output()
            .await?;
        Ok::<_, std::io::Error>(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).into_owned())
    };
    match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), probe).await {
        Ok(Ok(text)) => parse_ping(&text),
        _ => (LinkType::Unknown, None),
    }
}

/// 解析 `tailscale ping` 输出。示例:
///   pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via 1.2.3.4:41641 in 12ms     → 直连
///   pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via DERP(den) in 150ms        → DERP 中继
///   pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via peer-relay(...) in 42ms   → Peer Relay
///   ping failed / 空输出                                      → Unknown
pub fn parse_ping(text: &str) -> (LinkType, Option<u32>) {
    let mut link = LinkType::Unknown;
    let mut rtt = None;
    for line in text.lines() {
        let line = line.trim();
        if !line.starts_with("pong") {
            continue;
        }
        if line.contains("via DERP") {
            link = LinkType::Derp;
        } else if line.contains("peer-relay") {
            link = LinkType::PeerRelay;
        } else if line.contains(" via ") {
            link = LinkType::Direct;
        }
        // "in 12ms" → 12
        if let Some(idx) = line.find(" in ") {
            let tail = &line[idx + 4..];
            let num: String = tail.chars().take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).collect();
            if let Ok(ms) = num.parse::<u32>() {
                rtt = Some(ms);
            }
        }
        if link != LinkType::Unknown {
            break; // 首个 pong 即判;Tailscale 会持续升级路径,多轮探测可观测升级过程
        }
    }
    (link, rtt)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn parse_direct() {
        let (link, rtt) = parse_ping("pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via 1.2.3.4:41641 in 12ms");
        assert_eq!(link, LinkType::Direct);
        assert_eq!(rtt, Some(12));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_derp() {
        let (link, rtt) = parse_ping("pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via DERP(den) in 150ms");
        assert_eq!(link, LinkType::Derp);
        assert_eq!(rtt, Some(150));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_peer_relay() {
        let (link, rtt) = parse_ping("pong from 100.64.0.1:41641 via peer-relay(ts-pr-1) in 42ms");
        assert_eq!(link, LinkType::PeerRelay);
        assert_eq!(rtt, Some(42));
    }

    #[test]
    fn parse_failure() {
        let (link, rtt) = parse_ping("ping failed: no matching peer");
        assert_eq!(link, LinkType::Unknown);
        assert_eq!(rtt, None);
        let (link, rtt) = parse_ping("");
        assert_eq!(link, LinkType::Unknown);
        assert_eq!(rtt, None);
    }
}
````

````rust
//! 线协议 fts-protocol v1 的 P1 子集(api-spec 第 8 节)。
//! 帧 = u32 LE 长度前缀 + 载荷;控制帧载荷为 JSON,分块帧为裸字节。
//! P1 新增:Hello 能力协商、分块哈希表 + 单层 Merkle 根、续传位图。

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use tokio::io::{AsyncRead, AsyncReadExt, AsyncWrite, AsyncWriteExt};

pub const ALPN: &[u8] = b"fts/1";
pub const PROTOCOL_VERSION: u32 = 1;
pub const DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: u32 = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
/// 控制帧上限(manifest 含分块哈希表,按 10GB 文件 ≈ 1MB 量级留余量)
pub const MAX_CTRL_FRAME: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
/// 分块帧头:[chunk_id: u32 LE][offset: u64 LE][len: u32 LE]
pub const CHUNK_HEADER: usize = 4 + 8 + 4;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Hello {
    pub protocol_version: u32,
    pub fts_version: String,
    pub role: String, // "source" | "dest"
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct Manifest {
    pub file_name: String,
    pub file_size: u64,
    pub chunk_size: u32,
    pub checksum_algo: String, // 固定 "blake3"
    /// 每块 BLAKE3 hex;单层 Merkle:root = blake3(全部分块哈希拼接)
    pub chunk_hashes: Vec<String>,
    pub merkle_root: String,
    /// inbox 预注册票据(P5):接收端查表决定落盘目录;None = 落默认 --out
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub ticket: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ManifestAck {
    pub ok: bool,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub reason: Option<String>,
    /// 续传:接收端已校验通过的分块位图,hex(每 bit 一个分块,低位在前)。None = 从头传。
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub resume_bitmap_hex: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Finish {}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct FinishAck {
    pub checksum_ok: bool,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

pub async fn write_frame<W: AsyncWrite + Unpin>(w: &mut W, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
    w.write_all(&(data.len() as u32).to_le_bytes()).await?;
    w.write_all(data).await?;
    w.flush().await?;
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn read_frame<R: AsyncRead + Unpin>(r: &mut R, cap: usize) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut hdr = [0u8; 4];
    r.read_exact(&mut hdr).await?;
    let len = u32::from_le_bytes(hdr) as usize;
    if len > cap {
        bail!("帧超长: {len} > {cap}");
    }
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; len];
    r.read_exact(&mut buf).await?;
    Ok(buf)
}

/// (分块帧头在 recv_stream 内联解析,便于统一 QUIC/TCP 的 EOF 语义)

/// 校验通过的分块位图(每 bit 一个分块)。
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct Bitmap {
    pub bits: Vec<bool>,
}

impl Bitmap {
    pub fn new(chunks: usize) -> Self {
        Bitmap { bits: vec![false; chunks] }
    }

    pub fn set(&mut self, id: usize) {
        if id < self.bits.len() && !self.bits[id] {
            self.bits[id] = true;
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, id: usize) -> bool {
        self.bits.get(id).copied().unwrap_or(false)
    }

    pub fn count(&self) -> u64 {
        self.bits.iter().filter(|b| **b).count() as u64
    }

    pub fn is_complete(&self) -> bool {
        self.bits.iter().all(|b| *b)
    }

    pub fn to_hex(&self) -> String {
        let mut bytes = vec![0u8; self.bits.len().div_ceil(8)];
        for (i, b) in self.bits.iter().enumerate() {
            if *b {
                bytes[i / 8] |= 1 << (i % 8);
            }
        }
        bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
    }

    pub fn from_hex(hex: &str, chunks: usize) -> Self {
        let mut bits = vec![false; chunks];
        let bytes = hex.as_bytes();
        for i in 0..chunks {
            if let (Some(hi), Some(lo)) = (bytes.get((i / 8) * 2), bytes.get((i / 8) * 2 + 1)) {
                let byte = u8::from_str_radix(
                    std::str::from_utf8(&[*hi, *lo]).unwrap_or("00"),
                    16,
                )
                .unwrap_or(0);
                bits[i] = (byte >> (i % 8)) & 1 == 1;
            }
        }
        Bitmap { bits }
    }
}

/// 单层 Merkle:root = blake3(所有分块哈希的原字节顺序拼接)
pub fn merkle_root(chunk_hashes: &[[u8; 32]]) -> String {
    let mut hasher = blake3::Hasher::new();
    for h in chunk_hashes {
        hasher.update(h);
    }
    hasher.finalize().to_hex().to_string()
}

/// 校验对端 Hello;不匹配时返回错误信息
pub fn check_hello(hello: &Hello) -> Result<()> {
    if hello.protocol_version != PROTOCOL_VERSION {
        bail!(
            "对端协议版本 {}, 本端 {}, 需升级",
            hello.protocol_version,
            PROTOCOL_VERSION
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// W8:校验 manifest.file_name 的相对路径(递归传输)并转为落盘 PathBuf。
/// 信任边界:file_name 来自网络,必须拒绝路径穿越与平台逃逸:
///   禁止:空、'..'、'.'、空组件、反斜杠、盘符/冒号、绝对路径形态。
/// 组件间只接受 '/'(协议约定,见 W8);返回的 PathBuf 直接 join 到接收根目录之下。
pub fn sanitize_rel_path(name: &str) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf> {
    if name.is_empty() {
        bail!("文件名为空");
    }
    let mut pb = std::path::PathBuf::new();
    for comp in name.split('/') {
        if comp.is_empty() || comp == "." || comp == ".." {
            bail!("非法路径组件: {name:?}");
        }
        if comp.contains('\\') || comp.contains(':') {
            bail!("路径组件含非法字符(\\ 或 :): {name:?}");
        }
        pb.push(comp);
    }
    Ok(pb)
}

pub fn parse_json<T: for<'de> Deserialize<'de>>(bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<T> {
    serde_json::from_slice(bytes).context("JSON 帧解析失败")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// 帧编解码往返:长度前缀 + JSON 载荷,在内存 buffer 上模拟流
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn frame_roundtrip() {
        let mut buf = std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new());
        let hello = Hello {
            protocol_version: 1,
            fts_version: "0.1.0".into(),
            role: "source".into(),
        };
        write_frame(&mut buf, &serde_json::to_vec(&hello).unwrap()).await.unwrap();
        buf.set_position(0);
        let bytes = read_frame(&mut buf, 4096).await.unwrap();
        let back: Hello = parse_json(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.protocol_version, 1);
        assert_eq!(back.role, "source");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn frame_cap_enforced() {
        let mut buf = std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new());
        write_frame(&mut buf, &vec![0u8; 100]).await.unwrap();
        buf.set_position(0);
        let err = read_frame(&mut buf, 16).await;
        assert!(err.is_err());
        assert!(err.unwrap_err().to_string().contains("帧超长"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn bitmap_roundtrip() {
        let mut bm = Bitmap::new(70); // 跨多个字节
        bm.set(0);
        bm.set(8);
        bm.set(63);
        bm.set(64);
        bm.set(69);
        let hex = bm.to_hex();
        let mut back = Bitmap::from_hex(&hex, 70);
        assert!(back.get(0) && back.get(8) && back.get(63) && back.get(64) && back.get(69));
        assert!(!back.get(1) && !back.get(62) && !back.get(68));
        assert_eq!(back.count(), 5);
        assert!(!back.is_complete());
        for i in 0..70 {
            back.set(i);
        }
        let full = Bitmap::from_hex(&back.to_hex(), 70);
        assert!(full.is_complete());
        assert_eq!(full.count(), 70);
    }

    #[test]
    fn bitmap_from_hex_short_input() {
        // 位图截断/损坏时不 panic,缺省为未收到
        let bm = Bitmap::from_hex("ff", 70);
        assert_eq!(bm.count(), 8);
        assert!(!bm.get(69));
    }

    #[test]
    fn merkle_root_matches_chunk_hashes() {
        let h1 = *blake3::hash(b"chunk1").as_bytes();
        let h2 = *blake3::hash(b"chunk2").as_bytes();
        let root = merkle_root(&[h1, h2]);
        let mut hasher = blake3::Hasher::new();
        hasher.update(&h1);
        hasher.update(&h2);
        assert_eq!(root, hasher.finalize().to_hex().to_string());
        // 顺序敏感
        assert_ne!(merkle_root(&[h2, h1]), root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn hello_version_rejected() {
        let bad = Hello { protocol_version: 2, fts_version: "x".into(), role: "source".into() };
        assert!(check_hello(&bad).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn rel_path_sanitizing() {
        // 合法:多层相对路径
        let p = sanitize_rel_path("sub/dir/file.bin").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p, std::path::PathBuf::from("sub").join("dir").join("file.bin"));
        assert_eq!(sanitize_rel_path("a.bin").unwrap(), std::path::PathBuf::from("a.bin"));
        // 穿越/逃逸:全部拒绝
        for bad in [
            "../evil.bin",
            "a/../../evil.bin",
            "..",
            "a/../b.bin",
            "a\\b.bin",        // 反斜杠(Windows 分隔符混入)
            "C:/x.bin",        // 盘符
            "a:/x.bin",        // 伪盘符
            "",                // 空
            "a//b.bin",        // 空组件
            "/abs/path",       // 绝对形态
            "a/./b.bin",       // 当前目录组件
        ] {
            assert!(sanitize_rel_path(bad).is_err(), "应拒绝: {bad:?}");
        }
    }
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/recv.rs
````rust
//! 接收端(P5):QUIC 与 TCP 监听同一端口;W1 ticket 决定落盘目录;W2 多文件会话;W3 并发会话。
//! 会话 = Hello ↔ Hello → N × (Manifest → 并行收流逐块校验落盘 → Finish → 校验 → 原子落盘 → FinishAck)。
//! 续传:checkpoint(<name>.fts-part.meta)每秒落盘,重发同 manifest 自动只补缺失块。
//!
//! 并发说明(规划 W3):QUIC 会话天然可并发;**TCP 会话全局互斥** —— TCP 回退模式下
//! 数据流与新控制连接共享同一 listener,无法区分,故同一时间只允许一个 TCP 会话
//! (其余排队)。这是刻意简化,见 plan/fts-p5-integration-design.md 第 4 节。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use crate::protocol::*;
use crate::send::{BoxRead, BoxWrite};
use crate::ui::{Output, Progress, SessionOut};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncSeekExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::sync::{Mutex, OwnedMutexGuard, Semaphore};
use tokio::task::JoinSet;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
struct Checkpoint {
    file_name: String,
    file_size: u64,
    chunk_size: u32,
    merkle_root: String,
    bitmap_hex: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct RecvCfg {
    pub listen: String,
    pub out_dir: PathBuf,
    pub out: Output,
    pub transport: String, // auto | quic | tcp
    /// 证书缓存目录(指纹跨运行稳定;daemon 必需)
    pub cert_cache: PathBuf,
    /// daemon 模式事件通道(REST SSE)
    pub events: Option<tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>>,
    /// W1 inbox 预注册表;None = 不支持 ticket(收到带 ticket 的传输即拒绝)
    pub inbox: Option<Arc<crate::inbox::InboxRegistry>>,
}

/// 监听器集合(绑定一次,反复 accept)
pub struct Listeners {
    endpoint: Option<quinn::Endpoint>,
    /// TCP listener 用互斥锁保护:TCP 会话独占(见模块注释)
    tcp: Option<Arc<Mutex<tokio::net::TcpListener>>>,
}

pub enum Incoming {
    Quic(quinn::Connection),
    Tcp(tokio::net::TcpStream),
}

/// 数据流来源:QUIC 连接上继续 accept_uni;TCP 会话独占 listener 接收数据流连接。
pub enum DataInSource {
    Quic(quinn::Connection),
    Tcp(OwnedMutexGuard<tokio::net::TcpListener>),
}

impl DataInSource {
    async fn next_stream(&self) -> std::io::Result<BoxRead> {
        match self {
            DataInSource::Quic(conn) => {
                let s = conn.accept_uni().await?;
                Ok(Box::new(s))
            }
            DataInSource::Tcp(l) => {
                let (s, _) = l.accept().await?;
                let (r, w) = s.into_split();
                drop(w); // 写端立即丢弃:发送端持有对应写半部
                Ok(Box::new(r))
            }
        }
    }
}

/// CLI 入口:绑定 → 处理一个会话 → 退出(面向人)
pub async fn run_recv(cfg: RecvCfg) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    run_recv_inner(cfg)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| match e.downcast::<FtsError>() {
            Ok(fts_err) => fts_err,
            Err(other) => FtsError::Io(format!("{other:#}")),
        })
}

async fn run_recv_inner(cfg: RecvCfg) -> Result<()> {
    let mut out = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
    if let Some(tx) = &cfg.events {
        out = out.with_events(tx.clone());
    }
    out.task_created();
    let listeners = bind(&cfg, &out).await.map_err(downcast_fts)?;
    let incoming = accept_one(&listeners).await?;
    handle_incoming(&cfg, &mut out, incoming, listeners.tcp.clone()).await
}

fn downcast_fts(e: anyhow::Error) -> FtsError {
    match e.downcast::<FtsError>() {
        Ok(fts_err) => fts_err,
        Err(other) => FtsError::Io(format!("{other:#}")),
    }
}

/// daemon 入口(W3):循环 accept,最多 max_sessions 个并发会话;单个会话失败不影响服务。
pub async fn serve(cfg: RecvCfg, max_sessions: usize) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    let out = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
    let listeners = bind(&cfg, &out).await.map_err(downcast_fts)?;
    let sem = Arc::new(Semaphore::new(max_sessions.max(1)));
    eprintln!("fts recv 服务循环启动(最大并发会话 {max_sessions})");
    loop {
        let permit = sem.clone().acquire_owned().await.expect("semaphore");
        let incoming = match accept_one(&listeners).await {
            Ok(i) => i,
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("[warn] accept 失败: {e:#}");
                drop(permit);
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200)).await;
                continue;
            }
        };
        let cfg = cfg.clone();
        let tcp_listener = listeners.tcp.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut out = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
            if let Err(e) = handle_incoming(&cfg, &mut out, incoming, tcp_listener).await {
                eprintln!("[warn] 接收会话失败: {e}");
            }
            drop(permit);
        });
    }
}

/// 绑定监听(按 transport 配置:QUIC(UDP) 与/或 TCP,同一端口号)
/// 运维信息直接走 stderr(SessionOut 可能是 Silent —— daemon 模式也要能看到指纹)
async fn bind(cfg: &RecvCfg, _out: &SessionOut) -> Result<Listeners> {
    let addr: SocketAddr = cfg
        .listen
        .parse()
        .map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(format!("监听地址无效 {}: {e}", cfg.listen)))?;

    let cert = crate::tls::load_or_generate_cert(&cfg.cert_cache)?;
    eprintln!("fts recv 证书指纹(blake3): {}", cert.fingerprint);
    eprintln!("      发送端请用 --fingerprint <上述指纹> 连接(或 --insecure,仅测试)");

    let mut endpoint: Option<quinn::Endpoint> = None;
    let mut tcp: Option<Arc<Mutex<tokio::net::TcpListener>>> = None;
    if cfg.transport != "tcp" {
        let mut server_cfg = crate::tls::server_config(&cert)?;
        server_cfg.transport_config(Arc::new({
            let mut tc = quinn::TransportConfig::default();
            let win = quinn::VarInt::from_u32(32 * 1024 * 1024);
            tc.stream_receive_window(win);
            tc.receive_window(win);
            tc
        }));
        let ep = quinn::Endpoint::server(server_cfg, addr)
            .map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(format!("QUIC 监听失败: {e}")))?;
        eprintln!("fts recv QUIC(UDP)监听 {}", ep.local_addr()?);
        endpoint = Some(ep);
    }
    if cfg.transport != "quic" {
        let l = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(addr)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(format!("TCP 监听失败: {e}")))?;
        eprintln!("fts recv TCP 监听 {}", l.local_addr()?);
        tcp = Some(Arc::new(Mutex::new(l)));
    }
    Ok(Listeners { endpoint, tcp })
}

async fn accept_one(l: &Listeners) -> Result<Incoming> {
    match (&l.endpoint, &l.tcp) {
        (Some(ep), Some(tcp)) => {
            tokio::select! {
                inc = ep.accept() => {
                    let conn = inc.context("endpoint 已关闭")?.await
                        .map_err(|e| FtsError::Connect(format!("QUIC 连接失败: {e}")))?;
                    Ok(Incoming::Quic(conn))
                }
                acc = async { tcp.lock().await.accept().await } => {
                    Ok(Incoming::Tcp(acc.map_err(FtsError::io)?.0))
                }
            }
        }
        (Some(ep), None) => {
            let conn = ep.accept().await.context("endpoint 已关闭")?.await
                .map_err(|e| FtsError::Connect(format!("QUIC 连接失败: {e}")))?;
            Ok(Incoming::Quic(conn))
        }
        (None, Some(tcp)) => {
            let (s, _) = tcp.lock().await.accept().await.map_err(FtsError::io)?;
            Ok(Incoming::Tcp(s))
        }
        (None, None) => unreachable!("transport 配置至少启用一种传输"),
    }
}

/// 处理一个会话(QUIC 或 TCP)。
/// `tcp_listener`:TCP 会话需独占 listener(OwnedMutexGuard 锁到会话结束);
/// QUIC 会话不使用它。listener 本体保留在 Listeners 里供后续会话复用。
async fn handle_incoming(
    cfg: &RecvCfg,
    out: &mut SessionOut,
    incoming: Incoming,
    tcp_listener: Option<Arc<Mutex<tokio::net::TcpListener>>>,
) -> Result<()> {
    // 统一会话句柄;gate = QUIC 连接句柄,会话成功后等发送端读走最后一个 FinishAck 再关
    let (ctrl_tx, ctrl_rx, data_src, gate): (BoxWrite, BoxRead, DataInSource, Option<quinn::Connection>) =
        match incoming {
            Incoming::Quic(conn) => {
                let (tx, rx) = conn.accept_bi().await.map_err(|e| {
                    FtsError::Connect(format!("接受控制流失败: {e}"))
                })?;
                (Box::new(tx), Box::new(rx), DataInSource::Quic(conn.clone()), Some(conn))
            }
            Incoming::Tcp(stream) => {
                let listener = tcp_listener.expect("TCP 会话必有监听器");
                // 独占整个 TCP 会话期间(锁到 guard drop):数据流与新会话共用 listener
                let guard = listener.lock_owned().await;
                let (r, w) = stream.into_split();
                (Box::new(w), Box::new(r), DataInSource::Tcp(guard), None)
            }
        };

    let result = session_logic(cfg, out, ctrl_tx, ctrl_rx, &data_src).await;
    match (&result, gate) {
        // QUIC:close 会丢弃未 ACK 的流数据。
        // 成功路径:等发送端读完 FinishAck 后由它关闭;
        // 错误路径:session 可能刚发完 deny/错误 Ack(如 ticket 拒绝)——给对端
        // 2s 读走最后一条消息的机会,超时才强断(否则退出码语义丢失,只剩 connection lost)。
        (Ok(()), Some(conn)) => {
            conn.closed().await;
        }
        (Err(_), Some(conn)) => {
            let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), conn.closed()).await;
            conn.close(1u32.into(), b"error");
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    result
}

async fn session_logic(
    cfg: &RecvCfg,
    out: &mut SessionOut,
    mut ctrl_tx: BoxWrite,
    mut ctrl_rx: BoxRead,
    data_src: &DataInSource,
) -> Result<()> {
    let peer: Hello = parse_json(&read_frame(&mut ctrl_rx, 4096).await?)?;
    check_hello(&peer)?;
    write_frame(
        &mut ctrl_tx,
        &serde_json::to_vec(&Hello {
            protocol_version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            fts_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
            role: "dest".into(),
        })?,
    )
    .await?;

    // 常驻控制流读取任务:按帧类型分发(Manifest → manifest 通道;Finish → finish 通道)。
    // read_exact 取消不安全,不能直接放进 select!(否则帧被撕碎 —— P1 教训);
    // 也不能 per-file abort —— abort 会 drop 掉任务内的 RecvStream,向发送端发
    // STOP_SENDING,打断多文件会话的后续控制流(W2 教训)。
    let (manifest_tx, mut manifest_rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<Manifest>(1);
    let (finish_tx, mut finish_rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<Result<Finish>>(1);
    let ctl_reader = tokio::spawn(async move {
        loop {
            match read_frame(&mut ctrl_rx, MAX_CTRL_FRAME).await {
                Ok(bytes) => {
                    if let Ok(m) = serde_json::from_slice::<Manifest>(&bytes) {
                        if manifest_tx.send(m).await.is_err() {
                            break; // 接收端已离开会话循环
                        }
                    } else {
                        match serde_json::from_slice::<Finish>(&bytes) {
                            Ok(f) => {
                                if finish_tx.send(Ok(f)).await.is_err() {
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            Err(e) => {
                                let _ = finish_tx.send(Err(e.into())).await;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    // EOF(发送端全部传完并关闭)或错误 → 通道关闭 → 会话循环自然退出
                    let _ = finish_tx
                        .send(Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!(
                            "控制流中断: {e}"
                        )))))
                        .await;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // W2:多文件循环;任一文件失败即中止会话(与发送端快失败对齐)
    let mut files_done = 0u32;
    let result = loop {
        let Some(manifest) = manifest_rx.recv().await else {
            break Ok(()); // 控制流结束 = 会话正常结束
        };
        match handle_one_file(cfg, out, manifest, data_src, &mut ctrl_tx, &mut finish_rx).await {
            Ok(()) => files_done += 1,
            Err(e) => break Err(e),
        }
    };
    ctl_reader.abort();
    if result.is_ok() && files_done == 0 {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(
            "会话未传输任何文件".into()
        )));
    }
    result
}

/// 单文件:manifest 自检 → ticket → 续传 → Ack → 并行收流 → Finish → 校验 → 原子落盘 → FinishAck
async fn handle_one_file(
    cfg: &RecvCfg,
    out: &mut SessionOut,
    manifest: Manifest,
    data_src: &DataInSource,
    ctrl_tx: &mut BoxWrite,
    finish_rx: &mut tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<Result<Finish>>,
) -> Result<()> {
    if manifest.checksum_algo != "blake3" {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Version(format!(
            "不支持的校验算法: {}",
            manifest.checksum_algo
        ))));
    }
    let chunk_count = manifest.chunk_hashes.len();

    // 自检:manifest 自带的 root 必须与其分块哈希表一致(防篡改/截断)
    let hashes: Vec<[u8; 32]> = manifest
        .chunk_hashes
        .iter()
        .map(|h| blake3::Hash::from_hex(h).map(|x| *x.as_bytes()))
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!("manifest 分块哈希解析失败: {e}"))))?;
    if merkle_root(&hashes) != manifest.merkle_root {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(
            "manifest merkle_root 与分块哈希表不一致".into()
        )));
    }

    // W1:ticket → 落盘目录;拒绝时回 ManifestAck{ok:false, reason="AUTH: ..."}(发送端转退出码 7)
    async fn deny_ack(ctrl_tx: &mut BoxWrite, reason: String) -> anyhow::Error {
        // 尽力通知对端(发送失败不影响本端错误上报)
        let payload = serde_json::to_vec(&ManifestAck {
            ok: false,
            reason: Some(format!("AUTH: {reason}")),
            resume_bitmap_hex: None,
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
        let _ = write_frame(ctrl_tx, &payload).await;
        anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Auth(reason))
    }
    let base_dir: PathBuf = match &manifest.ticket {
        Some(ticket) => {
            let Some(reg) = &cfg.inbox else {
                return Err(deny_ack(ctrl_tx, "本端未启用 inbox,ticket 无法兑换".into()).await);
            };
            match reg.redeem(ticket, &manifest.file_name) {
                Ok(dir) => dir,
                Err(r) => {
                    return Err(deny_ack(ctrl_tx, format!("ticket 拒绝: {r}")).await);
                }
            }
        }
        None => cfg.out_dir.clone(),
    };

    // W8:file_name 现在是 '/' 分隔的相对路径(递归传输);校验(信任边界:防路径穿越)
    // 并重建父目录。file_name 同时用作 checkpoint 匹配键与文件事件名。
    let rel = sanitize_rel_path(&manifest.file_name)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!("manifest 路径非法: {e}"))))?;
    let final_path = base_dir.join(&rel);
    let parent = final_path
        .parent()
        .context("落盘路径缺少父目录")?
        .to_path_buf();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&parent).map_err(crate::error::FtsError::io_with_hint)?;

    // 续传:检查已有 checkpoint 与 manifest 是否匹配
    let tmp_path = {
        let mut os = final_path.clone().into_os_string();
        os.push(".fts-part");
        PathBuf::from(os)
    };
    let meta_path = {
        let mut os = tmp_path.clone().into_os_string();
        os.push(".meta");
        PathBuf::from(os)
    };
    let mut bitmap = Bitmap::new(chunk_count);
    let mut resumed = false;
    if tmp_path.exists() {
        if let Some(cp) = std::fs::read(&meta_path)
            .ok()
            .and_then(|b| serde_json::from_slice::<Checkpoint>(&b).ok())
        {
            if cp.file_name == manifest.file_name
                && cp.file_size == manifest.file_size
                && cp.chunk_size == manifest.chunk_size
                && cp.merkle_root == manifest.merkle_root
            {
                bitmap = Bitmap::from_hex(&cp.bitmap_hex, chunk_count);
                resumed = true;
            }
        }
        if !resumed {
            let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&tmp_path).await; // manifest 变了,旧半成品作废
        }
    }
    tokio::fs::File::create(&tmp_path)
        .await?
        .set_len(manifest.file_size)
        .await?; // 预分配,块可乱序写
    let ack = ManifestAck {
        ok: true,
        reason: None,
        resume_bitmap_hex: if resumed { Some(bitmap.to_hex()) } else { None },
    };
    out.log(&format!(
        "recv: {} ({} 字节, {} 块 × {}){}",
        manifest.file_name,
        manifest.file_size,
        chunk_count,
        manifest.chunk_size,
        if resumed { " [续传]" } else { "" }
    ));
    write_frame(ctrl_tx, &serde_json::to_vec(&ack)?).await?;
    out.reset_started();

    let shared = Arc::new(Shared {
        manifest: manifest.clone(),
        bitmap: Mutex::new(bitmap),
        verified_bytes: AtomicU64::new(0),
        tmp_path: tmp_path.clone(),
        meta_path: meta_path.clone(),
    });
    let mut tasks: JoinSet<Result<()>> = JoinSet::new();
    let done_flag = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0));

    // 进度 + checkpoint 线程:每秒报验证进度并落盘 checkpoint
    // (checkpoint 周期性写而非仅失败时写 —— 崩溃/断电/被杀都能续传)
    {
        let shared = shared.clone();
        let done_flag = done_flag.clone();
        let total = shared.manifest.file_size;
        let mut out2 = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
        if let Some(tx) = &cfg.events {
            out2 = out2.with_events(tx.clone());
        }
        out2.task_id = out.task_id.clone();
        out2.started = out.started;
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut last: u64 = 0;
            while done_flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 {
                let now = shared.verified_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                if now != last {
                    out2.progress(Progress { bytes_done: now, bytes_total: total });
                    let bitmap = shared.bitmap.lock().await.clone();
                    let cp = Checkpoint {
                        file_name: shared.manifest.file_name.clone(),
                        file_size: shared.manifest.file_size,
                        chunk_size: shared.manifest.chunk_size,
                        merkle_root: shared.manifest.merkle_root.clone(),
                        bitmap_hex: bitmap.to_hex(),
                    };
                    let _ = tokio::fs::write(&shared.meta_path, serde_json::to_vec(&cp).unwrap_or_default())
                        .await;
                }
                last = now;
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1000)).await;
            }
            let now = shared.verified_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if now != last {
                out2.progress(Progress { bytes_done: now, bytes_total: total });
            }
        });
    }

    let finish_received = loop {
        tokio::select! {
            stream = data_src.next_stream() => {
                match stream {
                    Ok(s) => {
                        let shared = shared.clone();
                        tasks.spawn(async move { recv_stream(s, shared).await });
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        done_flag.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        let _ = tasks.join_next().await;
                        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!(
                            "数据流接受失败: {e}"
                        ))));
                    }
                }
            }
            msg = finish_rx.recv() => {
                match msg {
                    Some(Ok(_)) => break true,
                    Some(Err(e)) => {
                        done_flag.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        return Err(e);
                    }
                    None => {
                        done_flag.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
                        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(
                            "控制流任务意外结束".into()
                        )));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    };
    done_flag.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

    // Finish 后补收:发送端先开满 N 条流、写完才发 Finish,但跨流无到达顺序保证,
    // 上面的 select 可能先命中 Finish,把 accept 队列里尚未 accept 的流遗弃
    // (实测:极小文件整个传输微秒级完成时触发"Finish 后仍有 1 块未收到")。
    // 以"立即就绪"为准补收队列中的流,零延迟;真正在途的流本就等不到,交给下方位图校验兜底。
    while let Ok(stream) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::ZERO, data_src.next_stream()).await {
        match stream {
            Ok(s) => {
                let shared = shared.clone();
                tasks.spawn(async move { recv_stream(s, shared).await });
            }
            Err(_) => break, // 连接已关闭:不再有新流
        }
    }

    // 等所有流任务收尾
    let mut first_err: Option<anyhow::Error> = None;
    while let Some(r) = tasks.join_next().await {
        match r.context("接收任务 panic")? {
            Ok(()) => {}
            Err(e) if first_err.is_none() => first_err = Some(e),
            Err(_) => {}
        }
    }

    let bitmap = shared.bitmap.lock().await.clone();
    let verified = shared.verified_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);

    if !finish_received || first_err.is_some() {
        // 中断:保存 checkpoint 供续传
        let cp = Checkpoint {
            file_name: shared.manifest.file_name.clone(),
            file_size: shared.manifest.file_size,
            chunk_size: shared.manifest.chunk_size,
            merkle_root: shared.manifest.merkle_root.clone(),
            bitmap_hex: bitmap.to_hex(),
        };
        tokio::fs::write(&shared.meta_path, serde_json::to_vec(&cp)?).await?;
        if let Some(e) = first_err {
            return Err(e);
        }
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!(
            "连接中断:已验证 {verified}/{} 字节;重发同一文件将自动续传",
            shared.manifest.file_size
        ))));
    }

    if !bitmap.is_complete() {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!(
            "Finish 后仍有 {} 块未收到",
            chunk_count as u64 - bitmap.count()
        ))));
    }

    // 文件级校验:所有块哈希已在到达时逐一验证(含续传前已验证的块),
    // 文件级完整性 = manifest root 与分块哈希表的一致性(前面已自检)。
    let elapsed = out.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    tokio::fs::rename(&tmp_path, &final_path).await?;
    let _ = tokio::fs::remove_file(&meta_path).await;
    out.log(&format!(
        "recv: 完成 {} — BLAKE3 逐块校验通过(root={}),耗时 {elapsed:.2}s,平均 {:.1} MB/s",
        shared.manifest.file_name,
        &shared.manifest.merkle_root[..16],
        shared.manifest.file_size as f64 / elapsed / 1_048_576.0
    ));

    write_frame(
        ctrl_tx,
        &serde_json::to_vec(&FinishAck {
            checksum_ok: true,
            error: None,
        })?,
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(())
}

struct Shared {
    manifest: Manifest,
    bitmap: Mutex<Bitmap>,
    verified_bytes: AtomicU64,
    tmp_path: PathBuf,
    meta_path: PathBuf,
}

async fn recv_stream(mut s: BoxRead, shared: Arc<Shared>) -> Result<()> {
    let mut file = tokio::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .write(true)
        .open(&shared.tmp_path)
        .await?;
    let chunk_size = shared.manifest.chunk_size as u64;
    let total_chunks = shared.manifest.chunk_hashes.len();
    loop {
        // 帧头 [chunk_id:u32][offset:u64][len:u32];读到 EOF(FIN)= 本流正常结束
        let mut hdr = [0u8; CHUNK_HEADER];
        if let Err(e) = s.read_exact(&mut hdr).await {
            if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof {
                return Ok(());
            }
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!(
                "读分块帧头失败: {e}"
            ))));
        }
        let chunk_id = u32::from_le_bytes(hdr[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
        let offset = u64::from_le_bytes(hdr[4..12].try_into().unwrap());
        let len = u32::from_le_bytes(hdr[12..16].try_into().unwrap());

        if len as u64 > chunk_size {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!(
                "块 {chunk_id} 长度 {len} 超过协商块大小"
            ))));
        }
        if chunk_id as usize >= total_chunks {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!(
                "块编号 {chunk_id} 超出 manifest"
            ))));
        }
        let mut payload = vec![0u8; len as usize];
        if let Err(e) = s.read_exact(&mut payload).await {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!(
                "读分块载荷失败: {e}"
            ))));
        }

        // 逐块校验(不可关闭 —— 硬约束)
        let expect = &shared.manifest.chunk_hashes[chunk_id as usize];
        let actual = blake3::hash(&payload).to_hex();
        if actual.as_str() != expect {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(format!(
                "块 {chunk_id} 哈希不匹配 expect={} actual={actual}",
                &expect[..16]
            ))));
        }

        file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(offset)).await?;
        file.write_all(&payload).await?;
        {
            let mut bm = shared.bitmap.lock().await;
            if !bm.get(chunk_id as usize) {
                bm.set(chunk_id as usize);
                shared
                    .verified_bytes
                    .fetch_add(len as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
    }
}
````
