````rust
//! 发送端(P5 W2):多文件单连接 —— 握手一次,逐文件 Manifest→chunks→Finish→FinishAck。
//! QUIC 优先,UDP 不可达自动降级 TCP(方案 A,design 9.5;`--transport` 可强制)。
//! W1:每个 Manifest 携带可选 ticket(inbox 预注册)。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use crate::protocol::*;
use crate::tls::PinMode;
use crate::ui::{Output, Progress, SessionOut};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::net::{SocketAddr, ToSocketAddrs};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncRead, AsyncReadExt, AsyncSeekExt, AsyncWrite, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

pub type BoxWrite = Box<dyn AsyncWrite + Unpin + Send>;
pub type BoxRead = Box<dyn AsyncRead + Unpin + Send>;

pub struct SendCfg {
    pub paths: Vec<PathBuf>,
    pub to: String,
    pub chunk_size: u32,
    pub streams: u32,
    pub pin: PinMode,
    pub transport: String, // auto | quic | tcp
    /// W1 inbox 票据(目录模式或单文件绑定)
    pub ticket: Option<String>,
    pub out: Output,
    /// daemon 模式事件通道(REST/gRPC SSE)
    pub events: Option<tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>>,
}

/// 数据流来源:QUIC 端点上再开流,或 TCP 新连接(与控制连接同地址)。
pub enum DataOpener {
    Quic(quinn::Connection),
    Tcp(SocketAddr),
}

impl DataOpener {
    async fn open(&self) -> Result<BoxWrite> {
        match self {
            DataOpener::Quic(conn) => {
                let s = conn.open_uni().await.map_err(|e| {
                    anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!("打开数据流失败: {e}")))
                })?;
                Ok(Box::new(s))
            }
            DataOpener::Tcp(addr) => {
                let s = tokio::time::timeout(
                    Duration::from_secs(10),
                    tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(*addr),
                )
                .await
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Connect("TCP 数据流连接超时".into())))?
                .map_err(FtsError::io)?;
                let (_, w) = s.into_split();
                Ok(Box::new(w))
            }
        }
    }
}

fn clone_opener(opener: &DataOpener) -> DataOpener {
    match opener {
        DataOpener::Quic(c) => DataOpener::Quic(c.clone()),
        DataOpener::Tcp(a) => DataOpener::Tcp(*a),
    }
}

/// 建立会话;返回 (数据流来源, 控制流读写端, 是否走了 TCP 回退)
async fn connect_session(
    cfg: &SendCfg,
    addr: SocketAddr,
    out: &SessionOut,
) -> Result<(DataOpener, BoxWrite, BoxRead, bool)> {
    let want_tcp = cfg.transport == "tcp";
    if !want_tcp {
        let mut endpoint = quinn::Endpoint::client("0.0.0.0:0".parse()?)?;
        endpoint.set_default_client_config(crate::tls::client_config(cfg.pin.clone())?);
        let connect = async {
            let conn = endpoint
                .connect(addr, "fts.local")
                .map_err(|e| FtsError::Connect(e.to_string()))?
                .await
                .map_err(crate::tls::map_conn_err)?;
            Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(conn)
        };
        match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(4), connect).await {
            Ok(Ok(conn)) => {
                let (tx, rx) = conn.open_bi().await.map_err(|e| {
                    anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Connect(format!("打开控制流失败: {e}")))
                })?;
                return Ok((DataOpener::Quic(conn), Box::new(tx), Box::new(rx), false));
            }
            Ok(Err(e))
                if matches!(
                    e.downcast_ref::<FtsError>(),
                    Some(FtsError::Auth(_)) | Some(FtsError::Version(_))
                ) =>
            {
                // 认证/版本错误降级无意义,直接失败
                return Err(e);
            }
            Ok(Err(_)) | Err(_) => {
                if cfg.transport == "quic" {
                    return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Connect(
                        "QUIC 连接失败(transport=quic,不回退)".into()
                    )));
                }
                out.out.log_degradation("L0", "L4", "quic_unreachable_tcp_fallback");
                // 继续走 TCP
            }
        }
    }
    let s = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), tokio::net::TcpStream::connect(addr))
        .await
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Connect("TCP 连接超时".into())))?
        .map_err(FtsError::io)?;
    let (rx, tx) = s.into_split();
    Ok((DataOpener::Tcp(addr), Box::new(tx), Box::new(rx), true))
}

/// 多路径展开(W8):目录**递归**展开,保留相对路径结构('/' 分隔,协议内统一用 '/');
/// 目录参数的相对前缀 = 其 basename(即"整个文件夹"作为一棵子树落盘)。
/// 重复的相对路径即错;空目录不产生条目(接收端不会重建空目录);目录符号链接不递归(防环)。
fn expand_paths(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<Vec<(PathBuf, String)>> {
    let mut files: Vec<(PathBuf, String)> = Vec::new();
    for p in paths {
        if p.is_dir() {
            let root_name = p
                .file_name()
                .context("目录路径缺少末段名(不能是盘根)")?
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string();
            walk_dir(p, &root_name, &mut files)
                .with_context(|| format!("遍历目录失败: {}", p.display()))?;
        } else {
            let name = p
                .file_name()
                .context("路径缺少文件名")?
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string();
            files.push((p.clone(), name));
        }
    }
    let mut seen = HashSet::new();
    for (_, n) in &files {
        if !seen.insert(n.clone()) {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::InvalidArg(format!(
                "重名文件: {n}(多路径展开后相对路径不得重复,接收端将按此路径落盘)"
            ))));
        }
    }
    if files.is_empty() {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::InvalidArg(
            "没有可发送的文件(目录为空,或只含空子目录;空目录不会被传输)".into()
        )));
    }
    Ok(files)
}

fn walk_dir(dir: &Path, rel_prefix: &str, out: &mut Vec<(PathBuf, String)>) -> Result<()> {
    for e in std::fs::read_dir(dir)? {
        let e = e?;
        let ft = e.file_type()?;
        let name = e.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        let child_rel = format!("{rel_prefix}/{name}");
        if ft.is_dir() {
            walk_dir(&e.path(), &child_rel, out)?;
        } else if ft.is_file() {
            out.push((e.path(), child_rel));
        }
        // 符号链接(is_dir/is_file 均为 false):跳过,防环
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub async fn run_send(cfg: SendCfg) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    run_send_inner(cfg)
        .await
        .map_err(|e| match e.downcast::<FtsError>() {
            Ok(fts_err) => fts_err,
            Err(other) => FtsError::Io(format!("{other:#}")),
        })
}

async fn run_send_inner(cfg: SendCfg) -> Result<()> {
    let out = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
    let mut out = if let Some(tx) = &cfg.events {
        out.clone_with_events(tx.clone())
    } else {
        out
    };
    out.task_created();

    let result = send_all(&cfg, &mut out).await;
    match &result {
        Ok(()) => out.result("COMPLETED", true, None),
        Err(e) => {
            let fts_err = e
                .downcast_ref::<FtsError>()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| FtsError::Io(format!("{e:#}")));
            out.result("FAILED", false, Some(&fts_err));
        }
    }
    result
}

async fn send_all(cfg: &SendCfg, out: &mut SessionOut) -> Result<()> {
    let files = expand_paths(&cfg.paths)?;
    let total = files.len();

    let addr: SocketAddr = cfg
        .to
        .to_socket_addrs()
        .map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(e.to_string()))?
        .next()
        .ok_or_else(|| FtsError::Io("目标地址解析失败".into()))?;

    let (opener, mut ctl_tx, mut ctl_rx, degraded) = connect_session(cfg, addr, out).await?;
    out.log(&format!(
        "send: 已连接 {addr},{} 个文件{}",
        total,
        if degraded { " [TCP 回退]" } else { "" }
    ));

    // 路径探测(观测):异步执行不阻塞传输
    {
        let out_probe = cfg.out;
        let ip = addr.ip().to_string();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (link, rtt) = crate::probe::probe_peer(&ip).await;
            if link != crate::probe::LinkType::Unknown {
                out_probe.path(link.as_str(), rtt);
            }
        });
    }

    // 控制流握手一次
    write_frame(
        &mut ctl_tx,
        &serde_json::to_vec(&Hello {
            protocol_version: PROTOCOL_VERSION,
            fts_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").into(),
            role: "source".into(),
        })?,
    )
    .await?;
    let peer: Hello = parse_json(&read_frame(&mut ctl_rx, 4096).await?)?;
    check_hello(&peer)?;

    // 逐文件传输;任一文件失败即中止(快失败)
    for (i, (path, name)) in files.iter().enumerate() {
        out.file(name, i + 1, total);
        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
        match transfer_one_file(cfg, &opener, &mut ctl_tx, &mut ctl_rx, path, name, out).await {
            Ok(bytes) => {
                out.file_done(name, true, started.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), bytes);
            }
            Err(e) => {
                out.file_done(name, false, started.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), 0);
                return Err(e.context(format!("文件 {name} 传输失败")));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 单文件:哈希预计算 → Manifest(含 ticket)→ Ack(可含续传位图)→ N 流并行 → Finish → FinishAck。
/// 返回文件字节数。
async fn transfer_one_file(
    cfg: &SendCfg,
    opener: &DataOpener,
    ctl_tx: &mut BoxWrite,
    ctl_rx: &mut BoxRead,
    path: &Path,
    file_name: &str,
    out: &mut SessionOut,
) -> Result<u64> {
    let file_size = tokio::fs::metadata(path)
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("读取文件失败: {}", path.display()))?
        .len();
    let chunk_size = cfg.chunk_size as u64;
    let chunk_count = file_size.div_ceil(chunk_size) as usize;

    // 哈希预计算:必须读满一块(或 EOF)才切一个分块 —— tokio read() 允许短读
    let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(chunk_count);
    {
        let mut f = tokio::fs::File::open(path).await?;
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; cfg.chunk_size as usize];
        loop {
            let mut filled = 0usize;
            loop {
                match f.read(&mut buf[filled..]).await? {
                    0 => break,
                    n => filled += n,
                }
                if filled == buf.len() {
                    break;
                }
            }
            if filled == 0 {
                break;
            }
            hashes.push(*blake3::hash(&buf[..filled]).as_bytes());
            if filled < buf.len() {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    hashes.truncate(chunk_count);
    let root = merkle_root(&hashes);
    let manifest = Manifest {
        file_name: file_name.to_string(),
        file_size,
        chunk_size: cfg.chunk_size,
        checksum_algo: "blake3".into(),
        chunk_hashes: hashes
            .iter()
            .map(|h| blake3::Hash::from(*h).to_hex().to_string())
            .collect(),
        merkle_root: root,
        ticket: cfg.ticket.clone(),
    };

    write_frame(ctl_tx, &serde_json::to_vec(&manifest.clone())?).await?;
    let ack: ManifestAck = parse_json(&read_frame(ctl_rx, 1024 * 1024).await?)?;
    if !ack.ok {
        let reason = ack.reason.unwrap_or_else(|| "对端拒绝 manifest".into());
        // 接收端以 "AUTH: " 前缀标记授权类拒绝(ticket 无效等)→ 退出码 7
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(if let Some(r) = reason.strip_prefix("AUTH: ") {
            FtsError::Auth(r.to_string())
        } else {
            FtsError::Connect(reason)
        }));
    }
    out.reset_started();

    let resume: Vec<bool> = ack
        .resume_bitmap_hex
        .map(|hex| Bitmap::from_hex(&hex, chunk_count).bits)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| vec![false; chunk_count]);
    let todo: Vec<usize> = (0..chunk_count).filter(|&i| !resume[i]).collect();
    let todo_count = todo.len();
    if resume.iter().any(|b| *b) {
        out.log(&format!(
            "send: {file_name} 续传,已完成 {} 块,需传 {} 块",
            chunk_count - todo_count,
            todo_count
        ));
    }
    if todo_count == 0 {
        // 文件已完整(零字节文件天然无块 / 续传时全部块已验证):
        // 仍必须走 Finish→FinishAck 握手 —— 接收端在等 Finish 才会做落盘收尾,
        // 跳过会让对端永远卡在 finish_rx.recv()(死锁)。
        out.log(&format!("send: {file_name} 已完整(无需传输数据块)"));
    }

    // N 条流并行发送,共享待传块栈
    let todo = Arc::new(Mutex::new(todo));
    let sent_bytes = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0));
    let done_flag = Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0));
    let mut tasks = Vec::new();
    let n_streams = cfg.streams.clamp(1, 64);
    for _ in 0..n_streams {
        let opener = clone_opener(opener);
        let todo = todo.clone();
        let path = path.to_path_buf();
        let chunk_size = cfg.chunk_size;
        let sent_bytes = sent_bytes.clone();
        tasks.push(tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut stream: BoxWrite = opener.open().await?;
            let mut file = tokio::fs::File::open(&path).await?;
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; chunk_size as usize];
            loop {
                let idx = { todo.lock().await.pop() };
                let Some(idx) = idx else { break };
                let offset = idx as u64 * chunk_size as u64;
                let expect = (file_size - offset).min(chunk_size as u64) as usize;
                file.seek(std::io::SeekFrom::Start(offset)).await?;
                file.read_exact(&mut buf[..expect]).await?;
                stream.write_all(&(idx as u32).to_le_bytes()).await?;
                stream.write_all(&offset.to_le_bytes()).await?;
                stream.write_all(&(expect as u32).to_le_bytes()).await?;
                stream.write_all(&buf[..expect]).await?;
                sent_bytes.fetch_add(expect as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
            stream.shutdown().await?;
            Ok::<(), anyhow::Error>(())
        }));
    }

    // 进度线程:每秒报当前文件进度
    {
        let sent_bytes = sent_bytes.clone();
        let done_flag = done_flag.clone();
        let total = file_size;
        let mut out2 = SessionOut::new(cfg.out);
        if let Some(tx) = &cfg.events {
            out2 = out2.with_events(tx.clone());
        }
        out2.task_id = out.task_id.clone();
        out2.started = out.started;
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut last: u64 = 0;
            while done_flag.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 0 {
                let now = sent_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                if now != last {
                    out2.progress(Progress { bytes_done: now, bytes_total: total });
                }
                last = now;
                tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1000)).await;
            }
            let now = sent_bytes.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            if now != last {
                out2.progress(Progress { bytes_done: now, bytes_total: total });
            }
        });
    }

    let mut first_err: Option<anyhow::Error> = None;
    for t in tasks {
        if let Err(e) = t.await.context("发送任务 panic")? {
            if first_err.is_none() {
                first_err = Some(e);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(e) = first_err {
        return Err(e);
    }

    // Finish → FinishAck
    write_frame(ctl_tx, &serde_json::to_vec(&Finish {})?).await?;
    let finish_ack: FinishAck = parse_json(&read_frame(ctl_rx, 4096).await?).map_err(|e| {
        anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Interrupted(format!("等待对端校验结果失败: {e:#}")))
    })?;
    done_flag.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

    if !finish_ack.checksum_ok {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(FtsError::Checksum(
            finish_ack.error.unwrap_or_else(|| "对端校验失败".into())
        )));
    }

    let elapsed = out.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    out.log(&format!(
        "send: {file_name} 完成,{} 块,耗时 {elapsed:.2}s,平均 {:.1} MB/s",
        chunk_count,
        file_size as f64 / elapsed / 1_048_576.0
    ));
    Ok(file_size)
}
````

````rust
//! TLS 配置:自签证书(rcgen)+ 客户端证书固定(cert pinning)。
//! 安全模型:接收端生成自签证书并打印 BLAKE3 指纹;发送端用 `--fingerprint` 固定。
//! `--insecure` 仅用于测试/调试,跳过校验。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use anyhow::Result;
use quinn::crypto::rustls::{QuicClientConfig, QuicServerConfig};
use rustls::pki_types::{CertificateDer, PrivatePkcs8KeyDer};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum PinMode {
    /// 跳过校验(仅测试用)
    Insecure,
    /// 固定对端证书的 BLAKE3 指纹
    Fingerprint([u8; 32]),
}

pub struct ServerCert {
    pub cert: Vec<CertificateDer<'static>>,
    pub key: PrivatePkcs8KeyDer<'static>,
    /// 证书 DER 的 BLAKE3 hex(发送端 --fingerprint 用)
    pub fingerprint: String,
}

pub fn generate_self_signed() -> Result<ServerCert> {
    let ck = rcgen::generate_simple_self_signed(vec!["fts.local".into()])?;
    let cert = CertificateDer::from(ck.cert);
    let fingerprint = blake3::hash(cert.as_ref()).to_hex().to_string();
    let key = PrivatePkcs8KeyDer::from(ck.signing_key.serialize_der());
    Ok(ServerCert { cert: vec![cert], key, fingerprint })
}

/// 从缓存目录加载证书(首次生成并落盘)。
/// 好处:指纹跨运行稳定,发送端可长期固定同一指纹(daemon 模式必需)。
pub fn load_or_generate_cert(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Result<ServerCert> {
    let cert_path = dir.join("fts-cert.der");
    let key_path = dir.join("fts-key.der");
    if let (Ok(cert_der), Ok(key_der)) = (std::fs::read(&cert_path), std::fs::read(&key_path)) {
        let fingerprint = blake3::hash(&cert_der).to_hex().to_string();
        return Ok(ServerCert {
            cert: vec![CertificateDer::from(cert_der)],
            key: PrivatePkcs8KeyDer::from(key_der),
            fingerprint,
        });
    }
    let sc = generate_self_signed()?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir)?;
    std::fs::write(&cert_path, sc.cert[0].as_ref())?;
    std::fs::write(&key_path, sc.key.secret_pkcs8_der())?;
    Ok(sc)
}

fn provider() -> Arc<rustls::crypto::CryptoProvider> {
    Arc::new(rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider())
}

pub fn server_config(cert: &ServerCert) -> Result<quinn::ServerConfig> {
    let mut crypto = rustls::ServerConfig::builder_with_provider(provider())
        .with_protocol_versions(&[&rustls::version::TLS13])?
        .with_no_client_auth()
        .with_single_cert(
            cert.cert.clone(),
            rustls::pki_types::PrivateKeyDer::Pkcs8(cert.key.clone_key()),
        )?;
    crypto.alpn_protocols = vec![crate::protocol::ALPN.to_vec()];
    let qc = QuicServerConfig::try_from(crypto)?;
    Ok(quinn::ServerConfig::with_crypto(Arc::new(qc)))
}

pub fn client_config(mode: PinMode) -> Result<quinn::ClientConfig> {
    let mut crypto = rustls::ClientConfig::builder_with_provider(provider())
        .with_protocol_versions(&[&rustls::version::TLS13])?
        .dangerous()
        .with_custom_certificate_verifier(Arc::new(ClientVerifier { mode }))
        .with_no_client_auth();
    crypto.alpn_protocols = vec![crate::protocol::ALPN.to_vec()];
    let qc = QuicClientConfig::try_from(crypto)?;
    Ok(quinn::ClientConfig::new(Arc::new(qc)))
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct ClientVerifier {
    mode: PinMode,
}

impl rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerifier for ClientVerifier {
    fn verify_server_cert(
        &self,
        end_entity: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        _intermediates: &[CertificateDer<'_>],
        _server_name: &rustls::pki_types::ServerName<'_>,
        _ocsp: &[u8],
        _now: rustls::pki_types::UnixTime,
    ) -> Result<rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerified, rustls::Error> {
        match &self.mode {
            PinMode::Insecure => Ok(rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerified::assertion()),
            PinMode::Fingerprint(fp) => {
                if blake3::hash(end_entity.as_ref()).as_bytes() == fp {
                    Ok(rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerified::assertion())
                } else {
                    Err(rustls::Error::General(
                        "cert fingerprint mismatch".into(),
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn verify_tls12_signature(
        &self,
        _message: &[u8],
        _cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        _dss: &rustls::DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        Ok(rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid::assertion())
    }

    fn verify_tls13_signature(
        &self,
        _message: &[u8],
        _cert: &CertificateDer<'_>,
        _dss: &rustls::DigitallySignedStruct,
    ) -> Result<rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid, rustls::Error> {
        Ok(rustls::client::danger::HandshakeSignatureValid::assertion())
    }

    fn supported_verify_schemes(&self) -> Vec<rustls::SignatureScheme> {
        rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider()
            .signature_verification_algorithms
            .supported_schemes()
    }
}

/// 把连接类错误分类成 FtsError(退出码契约)
pub fn map_conn_err(e: quinn::ConnectionError) -> FtsError {
    let s = e.to_string();
    if s.contains("fingerprint") {
        FtsError::Auth("对端证书指纹不匹配(是否用对了 --fingerprint?)".into())
    } else {
        FtsError::Connect(s)
    }
}

/// 解析 64 位 hex 指纹
pub fn decode_fingerprint(hex: &str) -> Option<[u8; 32]> {
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = (0..hex.len() / 2)
        .filter_map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&hex[i * 2..i * 2 + 2], 16).ok())
        .collect();
    bytes.try_into().ok()
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/ui.rs
````rust
//! 输出层:人类可读(默认)、NDJSON(api-spec 3.4 契约)或 Silent(daemon,事件走 channel)。
//! 契约:JSON 模式下 stdout 只输出事件,人类日志走 stderr;未知事件类型应被下游忽略。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use std::time::Instant;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub enum Output {
    Human,
    Json,
    /// 不打印(daemon 模式);事件走 events channel
    Silent,
}

impl Output {
    /// 降级事件(契约:永远 warn 级别,不得被默认日志过滤)
    pub fn log_degradation(&self, from: &str, to: &str, reason: &str) {
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"degradation","from":"{from}","to":"{to}","reason":"{reason}"}}"#
        );
        match self {
            Output::Human => eprintln!("[warn] 降级 {from} → {to}: {reason}"),
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
    }

    /// 路径事件(探测观测,P2)
    pub fn path(&self, link: &str, rtt_ms: Option<u32>) {
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"path","link":"{link}","rtt_ms":{}}}"#,
            rtt_ms.map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| "null".into())
        );
        match self {
            Output::Human => match rtt_ms {
                Some(ms) => eprintln!("[info] 链路 {link} rtt={ms}ms"),
                None => eprintln!("[info] 链路 {link}"),
            },
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
    }
}

pub struct Progress {
    pub bytes_done: u64,
    pub bytes_total: u64,
}

pub struct SessionOut {
    pub out: Output,
    pub task_id: String,
    pub started: Instant,
    last_bytes: u64,
    last_instant: Instant,
    /// daemon 模式:所有事件(json 字符串)同步给 REST SSE 订阅者
    events: Option<broadcast::Sender<String>>,
}

impl SessionOut {
    pub fn new(out: Output) -> Self {
        SessionOut {
            out,
            task_id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            started: Instant::now(),
            last_bytes: 0,
            last_instant: Instant::now(),
            events: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_events(mut self, tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Self {
        self.events = Some(tx);
        self
    }

    /// 无 mut 借位克隆(事件通道 Arc 共享)
    pub fn clone_with_events(&self, tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Self {
        SessionOut {
            out: self.out,
            task_id: self.task_id.clone(),
            started: self.started,
            last_bytes: self.last_bytes,
            last_instant: self.last_instant,
            events: Some(tx),
        }
    }

    fn emit(&self, json: &str) {
        if let Some(tx) = &self.events {
            let _ = tx.send(json.to_string());
        }
    }

    pub fn task_created(&self) {
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"task","task_id":"{}","state":"RUNNING"}}"#,
            self.task_id
        );
        match self.out {
            Output::Human => {}
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
        self.emit(&json);
    }

    /// 周期性进度;JSON 模式带吞吐与 ETA
    pub fn progress(&mut self, p: Progress) {
        let now = Instant::now();
        let dt = now.duration_since(self.last_instant).as_secs_f64();
        let throughput = if dt > 0.05 {
            ((p.bytes_done - self.last_bytes) as f64 / dt) as u64
        } else {
            0
        };
        if throughput > 0 {
            self.last_bytes = p.bytes_done;
            self.last_instant = now;
        }
        let eta = if throughput > 0 && p.bytes_total > p.bytes_done {
            Some(((p.bytes_total - p.bytes_done) / throughput.max(1)) as u32)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"progress","bytes_done":{},"bytes_total":{},"throughput_bps":{},"eta_seconds":{}}}"#,
            p.bytes_done,
            p.bytes_total,
            throughput,
            eta.map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_else(|| "null".into())
        );
        match self.out {
            Output::Human => {}
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
        self.emit(&json);
    }

    /// W2:多文件任务内的文件开始事件
    pub fn file(&self, name: &str, index: usize, total: usize) {
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"file","name":"{name}","index":{index},"total":{total}}}"#
        );
        match self.out {
            Output::Human => eprintln!("send: [{index}/{total}] {name}"),
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
        self.emit(&json);
    }

    /// W2:多文件任务内的文件完成事件
    pub fn file_done(&self, name: &str, checksum_ok: bool, seconds: f64, bytes: u64) {
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"file_done","name":"{name}","checksum_ok":{},"seconds":{seconds:.2},"bytes":{bytes}}}"#,
            checksum_ok
        );
        match self.out {
            Output::Human => {}
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
        self.emit(&json);
    }

    pub fn result(&self, state: &str, checksum_ok: bool, error: Option<&FtsError>) {
        let err = error
            .map(|e| {
                format!(
                    r#","error_code":{},"error":"{}""#,
                    e.exit_code(),
                    e.name()
                )
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let json = format!(
            r#"{{"type":"result","state":"{}","checksum_ok":{},"duration_seconds":{:.2}{}}}"#,
            state,
            checksum_ok,
            self.started.elapsed().as_secs_f64(),
            err
        );
        match self.out {
            Output::Human => {}
            Output::Json => println!("{json}"),
            Output::Silent => {}
        }
        self.emit(&json);
    }

    /// 人类可读日志(stderr;JSON/Silent 模式下也走 stderr 保持 stdout 纯净)
    pub fn log(&self, msg: &str) {
        if !matches!(self.out, Output::Silent) {
            eprintln!("{msg}");
        }
    }

    /// 重置计时起点(收到 manifest / 真正开始传数据时调用,避免把对端准备时间计入吞吐)
    pub fn reset_started(&mut self) {
        self.started = Instant::now();
    }
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/src/update.rs
````rust
//! W9:远程自更新(apply-update)。
//!
//! 流程:BeginUpdate(gRPC)校验暂存区后,以 DETACHED 拉起暂存区里的新版 fts.exe
//! 执行 `apply-update`;本模块只实现 apply-update 侧逻辑(它自己就是暂存区副本):
//!   1. 等待旧 daemon(pid)退出(轮询,超时 taskkill /F 兜底)
//!   2. 备份安装目录中将被覆盖的文件 → cert_dir/update/backup-<ts>/
//!   3. 复制暂存文件覆盖安装目录
//!   4. 拉起安装目录下的 `fts.exe start` —— ctl_start 内部用 current_exe,必须让
//!      新装 exe 自己拉起 daemon;绝不能用暂存副本(暂存区随时可能被清理)
//!   5. 失败回滚(恢复备份后重试启动);结果写 cert_dir/update/result.json
//!
//! apply-update 无控制台(DETACHED),所有输出走 apply.log 文件。

use crate::error::FtsError;
use crate::grpc::pb;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;

// ---------- 客户端侧:推送新版并触发远程自替换(push_update,GUI/CLI 共用) ----------

/// dist 里的标准文件集(存在才推;config.json 默认不覆盖,各机配置不同)
pub const DEFAULT_FILE_SET: &[&str] = &[
    "fts.exe",
    "fts.dll",
    "fts.h",
    "fts-daemon.ps1",
    "fts-daemon.cmd",
    "DEPLOY.txt",
    "VERSION",
];

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PushUpdateCfg {
    /// 目标 daemon gRPC 地址(host[:50051])
    pub grpc_addr: String,
    /// 本机新版 dist 目录
    pub dist_dir: PathBuf,
    /// true = 连 config.json 也覆盖(默认保留目标机配置)
    pub overwrite_config: bool,
    /// 透传 BeginUpdate(存在 RUNNING 任务时需 true)
    pub force: bool,
    /// 进度行接收端(文本行/NDJSON;None = 静默)
    pub on_event: Option<tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<String>>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct UpdateReport {
    pub ok: bool,
    pub old_version: String,
    pub new_version: String,
    pub detail: String,
}

/// 完整更新流程:探测 → ReserveInbox(暂存) → fts 传输推送 → BeginUpdate → 轮询确认。
pub async fn push_update(cfg: PushUpdateCfg) -> UpdateReport {
    let say = |m: String| {
        if let Some(tx) = &cfg.on_event {
            let _ = tx.try_send(m);
        }
    };
    let mut report = UpdateReport {
        ok: false,
        old_version: String::new(),
        new_version: String::new(),
        detail: String::new(),
    };

    // dist 校验:fts.exe 必须,预期版本取 VERSION(若有)
    if !cfg.dist_dir.join("fts.exe").is_file() {
        report.detail = format!("dist 目录缺少 fts.exe: {}", cfg.dist_dir.display());
        return report;
    }
    let expected_version = std::fs::read_to_string(cfg.dist_dir.join("VERSION"))
        .ok()
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());

    let mut files: Vec<String> = DEFAULT_FILE_SET
        .iter()
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .collect();
    if cfg.overwrite_config {
        files.push("config.json".into());
    }
    files.retain(|f| cfg.dist_dir.join(f).is_file());
    if !files.iter().any(|f| f == "fts.exe") {
        report.detail = "文件集校验失败".into();
        return report;
    }

    say(format!("[push] 连接 {}/v1 (gRPC) ...", cfg.grpc_addr));
    let mut client = match connect_client(&cfg.grpc_addr).await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            report.detail = format!("gRPC 连接失败: {e}");
            return report;
        }
    };
    let caps = match capabilities(&mut client).await {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => {
            report.detail = format!("Capabilities 失败: {e}");
            return report;
        }
    };
    report.old_version = caps.fts_version.clone();
    let old_started_at = caps.started_at;
    say(format!(
        "[push] 目标在线 version={} started_at={} fingerprint={} listen={}",
        caps.fts_version, caps.started_at, caps.fingerprint, caps.listen_addr
    ));

    // 数据面地址:gRPC host + 数据监听端口(listen_addr 可能为 0.0.0.0,host 部分替换)
    let grpc_host = cfg
        .grpc_addr
        .rsplit_once(':')
        .map(|(h, _)| h.to_string())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| cfg.grpc_addr.clone());
    let data_port = caps
        .listen_addr
        .rsplit_once(':')
        .map(|(_, p)| p.to_string())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "4433".into());
    let data_addr = format!("{grpc_host}:{data_port}");

    // 暂存目录(daemon cwd 相对路径;ReserveInbox 会创建并预检)
    let ts = unix_secs();
    let staging = PathBuf::from(".fts").join("update").join(format!("stage-{ts}"));
    say(format!("[push] 预注册暂存目录 {} ...", staging.display()));
    let token = match client
        .reserve_inbox(pb::ReserveInboxRequest {
            out_dir: staging.display().to_string(),
            file_name: String::new(),
            credential: None,
        })
        .await
    {
        Ok(r) => r.into_inner().token,
        Err(e) => {
            report.detail = format!("ReserveInbox 失败: {e}");
            return report;
        }
    };

    // 推送(fts 自有传输,QUIC 优先;事件行直通)
    let paths: Vec<PathBuf> = files.iter().map(|f| cfg.dist_dir.join(f)).collect();
    say(format!("[push] 推送 {} 个文件 → {data_addr} ...", paths.len()));
    let (tx, mut rx) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel::<String>(256);
    let fwd = cfg.on_event.clone();
    let forwarder = tokio::spawn(async move {
        while let Ok(line) = rx.recv().await {
            if let Some(out) = &fwd {
                let _ = out.try_send(line);
            }
        }
    });
    let send_result = crate::send::run_send(crate::send::SendCfg {
        paths,
        to: data_addr,
        chunk_size: crate::protocol::DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
        streams: 4,
        pin: match crate::tls::decode_fingerprint(&caps.fingerprint) {
            Some(b) => crate::tls::PinMode::Fingerprint(b),
            None => crate::tls::PinMode::Insecure,
        },
        transport: "auto".into(),
        ticket: Some(token),
        out: crate::ui::Output::Silent,
        events: Some(tx.clone()),
    })
    .await;
    drop(tx);
    let _ = forwarder.await;
    if let Err(e) = send_result {
        report.detail = format!("推送失败: {e}");
        return report;
    }

    // 触发自替换
    say("[push] BeginUpdate(目标 daemon 即将自替换重启)...".into());
    match client
        .begin_update(pb::UpdateRequest {
            staging_dir: staging.display().to_string(),
            files: files.clone(),
            force: cfg.force,
        })
        .await
    {
        Ok(ack) if ack.get_ref().ok => {}
        Err(status) if status.code() == tonic::Code::Unimplemented => {
            report.detail =
                "目标 daemon 版本过旧(无 BeginUpdate RPC):请按老方式手工部署一次新版 dist,之后即可远程更新"
                    .into();
            return report;
        }
        Err(e) => {
            report.detail = format!("BeginUpdate 失败: {e}");
            return report;
        }
        _ => {
            report.detail = "BeginUpdate 返回异常".into();
            return report;
        }
    }

    // 轮询确认:凭 Capabilities.started_at 变化判定目标已重启(本地回环更新全程
    // 可能 <2s,靠连接空窗判断是竞态,不可靠 —— 已实测踩坑)。
    // 版本规则:dist 声明了不同版本 → 必须看到新版本;同版本重部署/无 VERSION → 重启即成功。
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(120);
    let t0 = std::time::Instant::now();
    loop {
        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)).await;
        if tokio::time::Instant::now() >= deadline {
            report.detail =
                "120s 内未确认到新版本(目标可能仍在重启或已回滚;查目标机 .fts/update/apply.log)".into();
            return report;
        }
        let at = t0.elapsed().as_millis();
        let mut probe = match connect_client(&cfg.grpc_addr).await {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) => {
                say(format!("[poll {at}ms] 连接失败(重启窗口): {e}"));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let c = match capabilities(&mut probe).await {
            Ok(c) => c,
            Err(e) => {
                say(format!("[poll {at}ms] capabilities 失败(重启窗口): {e}"));
                continue;
            }
        };
        let v = c.fts_version.clone();
        let restarted = c.started_at != old_started_at;
        say(format!(
            "[poll {at}ms] 在线 version={v} started_at={} restarted={restarted}",
            c.started_at
        ));
        let success = match &expected_version {
            // dist 声明了不同版本:必须看到新版本才算成功(重启后仍是旧版本 = 已回滚)
            Some(ev) if ev != &report.old_version => v == *ev,
            // 同版本重部署或 dist 无 VERSION:确认重启即成功
            Some(ev) => restarted && v == *ev,
            None => restarted,
        };
        if success {
            report.ok = true;
            report.new_version = v;
            say(format!(
                "[push] 更新成功: {} → {}(重启确认)",
                report.old_version, report.new_version
            ));
            return report;
        }
    }
}

/// 连接目标 gRPC(供 push_update 与 GUI 更新器共用);地址 host[:50051]
pub async fn connect_client(
    addr: &str,
) -> Result<pb::fts_client::FtsClient<tonic::transport::Channel>, String> {
    let ep = tonic::transport::Channel::from_shared(format!("http://{addr}"))
        .map_err(|e| format!("地址无效 {addr}: {e}"))?
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(15));
    let ch = ep
        .connect()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| format!("连接 {addr} 失败: {e}"))?;
    Ok(pb::fts_client::FtsClient::new(ch))
}

pub async fn capabilities(
    client: &mut pb::fts_client::FtsClient<tonic::transport::Channel>,
) -> Result<pb::CapabilitiesReply, String> {
    client
        .capabilities(pb::Empty {})
        .await
        .map(|r| r.into_inner())
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}


#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ApplyUpdateCfg {
    /// 旧 daemon 进程 pid(BeginUpdate 传入)
    pub pid: u32,
    /// 安装目录(覆盖目标;current_exe 所在目录)
    pub install_dir: PathBuf,
    /// 暂存目录(新版文件来源)
    pub staging_dir: PathBuf,
    /// 要应用的文件名(已在暂存区就位)
    pub files: Vec<String>,
    /// daemon 启动配置(透传给 fts start;None/空则按 cwd 解析)
    pub config: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// 更新前版本(仅记录)
    pub from_version: String,
}

/// apply-update 入口:等旧进程退出 → 备份+覆盖 → 重启 → 失败回滚。
pub fn apply_update(cfg: ApplyUpdateCfg) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    let to_version = env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string();
    // 结果/日志目录:与 daemon 相同的配置解析规则(cwd 从 daemon 继承)
    let (fc, _) = crate::daemon::resolve_config(cfg.config.clone())
        .map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(format!("apply-update 解析配置失败: {e}")))?;
    let update_dir = crate::daemon::cert_dir(&fc).join("update");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&update_dir).map_err(FtsError::io_with_hint)?;
    let log_path = update_dir.join("apply.log");

    log_line(
        &log_path,
        &format!(
            "apply-update 开始: pid={} install={} from={to_version}",
            cfg.pid,
            cfg.install_dir.display(),
        ),
    );

    // 1. 等待旧 daemon 退出(它收到 Ack 后 ~0.8s 自退;apply-update 兜底强杀)
    if !wait_pid_exit(cfg.pid, Duration::from_secs(15)) {
        let msg = format!("旧进程(pid={}) 15s 内未退出,放弃更新(文件未动)", cfg.pid);
        log_line(&log_path, &msg);
        write_result(&update_dir, false, &cfg.from_version, &to_version, &cfg.files, &msg);
        return Err(FtsError::Io(msg));
    }
    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(300)); // 句柄释放缓冲

    // 2+3. 备份 + 覆盖
    let ts = unix_secs();
    let backup_dir = update_dir.join(format!("backup-{ts}"));
    if let Err(e) = swap_files(&cfg.install_dir, &cfg.staging_dir, &cfg.files, &backup_dir) {
        let msg = format!("文件替换失败: {e}(文件未动或部分覆盖,见备份)");
        log_line(&log_path, &msg);
        write_result(&update_dir, false, &cfg.from_version, &to_version, &cfg.files, &msg);
        return Err(e);
    }
    log_line(
        &log_path,
        &format!("文件替换完成({} 个),备份: {}", cfg.files.len(), backup_dir.display()),
    );

    // 4. 用安装目录的新 exe 重启(见模块注释:不能 current_exe —— 那是暂存副本)
    let start_exe = cfg.install_dir.join("fts.exe");
    match start_installed(&start_exe, &cfg.config, &log_path) {
        Ok(()) => {
            let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&backup_dir); // 成功清备份
            log_line(&log_path, &format!("更新成功: {to_version}(daemon 健康检查通过)"));
            write_result(&update_dir, true, &cfg.from_version, &to_version, &cfg.files, "");
            Ok(())
        }
        Err(e) => {
            log_line(&log_path, &format!("重启失败: {e};回滚备份并重试启动"));
            let restore = restore_backup(&cfg.install_dir, &backup_dir, &cfg.files);
            log_line(&log_path, &format!("回滚结果: {:?}", restore.as_ref().map(|_| "ok")));
            let _ = start_installed(&start_exe, &cfg.config, &log_path);
            write_result(
                &update_dir,
                false,
                &cfg.from_version,
                &to_version,
                &cfg.files,
                &format!("{e}(已回滚)"),
            );
            Err(e)
        }
    }
}

/// 等待 pid 退出:轮询 process_alive;超时后 taskkill /F 兜底再等 1s。
/// 返回 true = 已确认退出。非 Windows 无 taskkill,超时即放弃。
pub fn wait_pid_exit(pid: u32, timeout: Duration) -> bool {
    let deadline = std::time::Instant::now() + timeout;
    while std::time::Instant::now() < deadline {
        if !crate::daemon::process_alive(pid) {
            return true;
        }
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
    }
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        let _ = std::process::Command::new("taskkill")
            .args(["/F", "/PID", &pid.to_string()])
            .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
            .status();
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
        !crate::daemon::process_alive(pid)
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    {
        false
    }
}

/// 备份 + 覆盖:先统一校验暂存源齐全,再备份安装目录现存文件,最后整体覆盖。
/// backup_dir 会被创建;返回后安装目录 = 暂存内容。
pub(crate) fn swap_files(
    install_dir: &Path,
    staging_dir: &Path,
    files: &[String],
    backup_dir: &Path,
) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    for f in files {
        let src = staging_dir.join(f);
        if !src.is_file() {
            return Err(FtsError::InvalidArg(format!("暂存区缺少文件: {}", src.display())));
        }
        // 拒绝路径穿越/子目录:files 必须是纯文件名,直接落在安装目录
        if f.contains('/') || f.contains('\\') || f.contains("..") {
            return Err(FtsError::InvalidArg(format!("文件名不允许包含路径分隔符: {f}")));
        }
    }
    std::fs::create_dir_all(backup_dir).map_err(FtsError::io_with_hint)?;
    for f in files {
        let dst = install_dir.join(f);
        if dst.is_file() {
            let bdst = backup_dir.join(f);
            if let Some(parent) = bdst.parent() {
                std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(FtsError::io_with_hint)?;
            }
            std::fs::copy(&dst, &bdst).map_err(FtsError::io)?;
        }
    }
    for f in files {
        let src = staging_dir.join(f);
        let dst = install_dir.join(f);
        std::fs::copy(&src, &dst).map_err(FtsError::io)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 回滚:备份里有的恢复原样;备份里没有的(本次新增)删除。
pub(crate) fn restore_backup(
    install_dir: &Path,
    backup_dir: &Path,
    files: &[String],
) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    for f in files {
        let dst = install_dir.join(f);
        let src = backup_dir.join(f);
        if src.is_file() {
            if dst.is_file() {
                std::fs::remove_file(&dst).map_err(FtsError::io)?;
            }
            std::fs::copy(&src, &dst).map_err(FtsError::io)?;
        } else if dst.is_file() {
            std::fs::remove_file(&dst).map_err(FtsError::io)?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// 拉起安装目录的 `fts start`(自后台化 + pid 文件 + REST 健康检查)。
///
/// 两个坑(都已实测踩过):
///   * 必须 CREATE_NO_WINDOW —— 本进程无控制台,不加会闪窗;
///   * stdio 必须直写 apply.log 而非用 output() 捕获 —— daemon 孙进程经
///     bInheritHandles=TRUE 继承管道写句柄,output() 将永远等不到 EOF,apply-update 卡死。
fn start_installed(exe: &Path, config: &Option<PathBuf>, log_path: &Path) -> Result<(), FtsError> {
    let log = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .create(true)
        .append(true)
        .open(log_path)
        .map_err(FtsError::io)?;
    let mut cmd = std::process::Command::new(exe);
    cmd.arg("start");
    if let Some(c) = config {
        // Start 子命令的 config 是短参 -c(与 CLI 定义一致)
        if !c.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            cmd.arg("-c").arg(c);
        }
    }
    cmd.stdin(std::process::Stdio::null())
        .stdout(std::process::Stdio::from(log.try_clone().map_err(FtsError::io)?))
        .stderr(std::process::Stdio::from(log));
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use std::os::windows::process::CommandExt;
        cmd.creation_flags(0x0800_0000); // CREATE_NO_WINDOW
    }
    let status =
        cmd.status().map_err(|e| FtsError::Io(format!("spawn {} 失败: {e}", exe.display())))?;
    if !status.success() {
        let msg = format!("fts start 失败({status}),详见 {}", log_path.display());
        log_line(log_path, &msg);
        return Err(FtsError::Io(msg));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn log_line(path: &Path, msg: &str) {
    use std::io::Write;
    if let Ok(mut f) = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().create(true).append(true).open(path) {
        let _ = writeln!(f, "[{}] {}", unix_secs(), msg);
    }
}

fn write_result(update_dir: &Path, ok: bool, from: &str, to: &str, files: &[String], error: &str) {
    let body = serde_json::json!({
        "ok": ok,
        "from": from,
        "to": to,
        "time": unix_secs(),
        "files": files,
        "error": error,
    });
    let _ = std::fs::write(update_dir.join("result.json"), body.to_string());
}

fn unix_secs() -> u64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_secs())
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn temp_dir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {
        let d = std::env::temp_dir()
            .join(format!("fts-update-test-{}-{}", tag, uuid::Uuid::new_v4()));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();
        d
    }

    fn put(dir: &Path, name: &str, content: &[u8]) {
        let p = dir.join(name);
        std::fs::create_dir_all(p.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(p, content).unwrap();
    }

    fn get(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
        std::fs::read(dir.join(name)).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn swap_replaces_and_keeps_backup() {
        let install = temp_dir("swap-install");
        let staging = temp_dir("swap-staging");
        let backup = temp_dir("swap-backup");
        put(&install, "fts.exe", b"old");
        put(&install, "fts.dll", b"old-dll");
        put(&staging, "fts.exe", b"new");
        put(&staging, "fts.dll", b"new-dll");
        put(&staging, "fts.h", b"new-header");

        swap_files(
            &install,
            &staging,
            &["fts.exe".into(), "fts.dll".into(), "fts.h".into()],
            &backup,
        )
        .unwrap();

        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.exe"), b"new");
        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.dll"), b"new-dll");
        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.h"), b"new-header");
        // 备份只含原有文件
        assert_eq!(get(&backup, "fts.exe"), b"old");
        assert_eq!(get(&backup, "fts.dll"), b"old-dll");
        assert!(!backup.join("fts.h").exists());
    }

    #[test]
    fn swap_fails_cleanly_when_staging_incomplete() {
        let install = temp_dir("swapf-install");
        let staging = temp_dir("swapf-staging");
        let backup = temp_dir("swapf-backup");
        put(&install, "fts.exe", b"old");
        put(&staging, "fts.exe", b"new");
        // fts.dll 缺失 → 整体拒绝,安装目录不动
        let err = swap_files(&install, &staging, &["fts.exe".into(), "fts.dll".into()], &backup);
        assert!(err.is_err());
        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.exe"), b"old");
        assert!(!install.join("fts.dll").exists());
    }

    #[test]
    fn swap_rejects_path_traversal() {
        let install = temp_dir("trav-install");
        let staging = temp_dir("trav-staging");
        let backup = temp_dir("trav-backup");
        put(&staging, "evil", b"x");
        let err = swap_files(&install, &staging, &["..\\evil".into()], &backup);
        assert!(err.is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn restore_recovers_old_and_removes_new() {
        let install = temp_dir("rest-install");
        let staging = temp_dir("rest-staging");
        let backup = temp_dir("rest-backup");
        put(&install, "fts.exe", b"old");
        put(&staging, "fts.exe", b"new");
        put(&staging, "extra.dll", b"new-extra");
        let files = vec!["fts.exe".to_string(), "extra.dll".to_string()];
        swap_files(&install, &staging, &files, &backup).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.exe"), b"new");
        assert!(install.join("extra.dll").exists());

        restore_backup(&install, &backup, &files).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(get(&install, "fts.exe"), b"old");
        assert!(!install.join("extra.dll").exists());
    }
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/tests/ffi_smoke.py
````python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""fts.dll C ABI 冒烟测试(P3 验收:Python ctypes 调用 → 传输 → 校验退出码)。

前置:接收端在 127.0.0.1:4433 监听(如 `fts daemon --listen 0.0.0.0:4433`),
     证书指纹经 FTS_FP 环境变量传入或用第一行参数。

运行:python tests\\ffi_smoke.py <fingerprint_hex> [src_file]
"""
import ctypes
import os
import sys

DLL = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "target", "release", "fts.dll")
lib = ctypes.CDLL(os.path.abspath(DLL))

lib.fts_version.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
lib.fts_abi_version.restype = ctypes.c_uint32
lib.fts_last_error.restype = ctypes.c_char_p
lib.fts_send_file.restype = ctypes.c_int32
lib.fts_send_file.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p,
    ctypes.c_int32, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_uint32, ctypes.c_char_p,
]

print("fts_version    =", lib.fts_version().decode())
print("fts_abi_version=", lib.fts_abi_version())

fp = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.environ.get("FTS_FP")
src = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "testsrc.bin"
dst = "127.0.0.1:4433"

rc = lib.fts_send_file(
    src.encode("utf-8"),
    dst.encode("utf-8"),
    fp.encode("utf-8") if fp else None,
    0 if fp else 1,
    4,          # streams
    0,          # chunk_size = 默认
    b"auto",    # transport
)
err = lib.fts_last_error().decode("utf-8", "replace")
print("rc =", rc, "err =", repr(err))

# 参数错误路径:指纹与 insecure 互斥 → rc=2
rc2 = lib.fts_send_file(
    src.encode("utf-8"), dst.encode("utf-8"),
    b"00" * 32, 1, 0, 0, None,
)
print("mutual-exclusive rc =", rc2, "(expect 2)")

sys.exit(0 if rc == 0 else 1)
````

````python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""fts gRPC W6 smoke: PurgeInbox (force guard, dir-mode only) + credential rejection.

Run: python tests\\grpc_purge_smoke.py
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
GEN = os.path.join(HERE, "_gen")
os.makedirs(GEN, exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "grpc_tools.protoc", "-I", os.path.join(ROOT, "proto"),
                "--python_out", GEN, "--grpc_python_out", GEN,
                os.path.join(ROOT, "proto", "fts.proto")], check=True)
sys.path.insert(0, GEN)

import grpc
import fts_pb2, fts_pb2_grpc  # noqa: E402

ch = grpc.insecure_channel("127.0.0.1:50051")
stub = fts_pb2_grpc.FtsStub(ch)
fails = []

# 1. credential on local path -> INVALID_ARGUMENT(且错误不含密码)
try:
    stub.ReserveInbox(fts_pb2.ReserveInboxRequest(
        out_dir=r"C:\Windows\Temp",
        credential=fts_pb2.NetworkCredential(user_name="u", password="SECRET-PW")))
    fails.append("local+credential should fail")
except grpc.RpcError as e:
    ok = e.code() == grpc.StatusCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT and "SECRET-PW" not in e.details()
    print("1. local+credential:", e.code(), "| pw leaked:", "SECRET-PW" in e.details())
    if not ok:
        fails.append("local+credential wrong error")

# 2. reserve dir token -> purge force=false -> INVALID_ARGUMENT
tk = stub.ReserveInbox(fts_pb2.ReserveInboxRequest(out_dir=os.path.join(ROOT, "downloads")))
try:
    stub.PurgeInbox(fts_pb2.PurgeRequest(token=tk.token, force=False))
    fails.append("force=false should fail")
except grpc.RpcError as e:
    print("2. force=false:", e.code())
    if e.code() != grpc.StatusCode.INVALID_ARGUMENT:
        fails.append("force=false wrong code")

# 3. file-bound token + force=true -> PERMISSION_DENIED
ftk = stub.ReserveInbox(fts_pb2.ReserveInboxRequest(
    out_dir=os.path.join(ROOT, "downloads"), file_name="x.bin"))
try:
    stub.PurgeInbox(fts_pb2.PurgeRequest(token=ftk.token, force=True))
    fails.append("file-bound purge should fail")
except grpc.RpcError as e:
    print("3. file-bound purge:", e.code(), "|", e.details())
    if e.code() != grpc.StatusCode.PERMISSION_DENIED:
        fails.append("file-bound purge wrong code")

# 4. dir token + force=true -> OK(统计);目录本身保留
probe = os.path.join(ROOT, "downloads", "purge_probe.txt")
open(probe, "w").write("x")
rep = stub.PurgeInbox(fts_pb2.PurgeRequest(token=tk.token, force=True))
print(f"4. purge ok: files={rep.files_deleted} dirs={rep.directories_deleted}")
if not (os.path.isdir(os.path.join(ROOT, "downloads")) and not os.path.exists(probe)):
    fails.append("purge did not clean dir")

# 5. nonexistent token -> NOT_FOUND
try:
    stub.PurgeInbox(fts_pb2.PurgeRequest(token="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", force=True))
    fails.append("bad token should fail")
except grpc.RpcError as e:
    print("5. bad token:", e.code())
    if e.code() != grpc.StatusCode.NOT_FOUND:
        fails.append("bad token wrong code")

print("T10:", "PASS" if not fails else "FAIL " + "; ".join(fails))
sys.exit(0 if not fails else 1)
````

````python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""fts gRPC end-to-end smoke test (P5 W4 acceptance: T9).

Flow: Capabilities -> ReserveInbox -> Submit(2 files) -> Observe(stream) -> Status.

Run: python tests\\grpc_smoke.py <fingerprint_hex>
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

import grpc

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)

# generate pb2 from proto/
GEN = os.path.join(HERE, "_gen")
os.makedirs(GEN, exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "-m", "grpc_tools.protoc", "-I", os.path.join(ROOT, "proto"),
     "--python_out", GEN, "--grpc_python_out", GEN,
     os.path.join(ROOT, "proto", "fts.proto")],
    check=True,
)
sys.path.insert(0, GEN)

import fts_pb2, fts_pb2_grpc  # noqa: E402

FP = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.environ.get("FTS_FP", "")
SRC = sys.argv[2:] or ["f1.bin", "f2.bin"]

ch = grpc.insecure_channel("127.0.0.1:50051")
stub = fts_pb2_grpc.FtsStub(ch)

caps = stub.Capabilities(fts_pb2.Empty())
print("capabilities:", caps.protocol_version, caps.fts_version, hex(caps.capabilities))

tk = stub.ReserveInbox(fts_pb2.ReserveInboxRequest(out_dir=os.path.join(ROOT, "inbox_g")))
print("inbox token:", tk.token[:8], "expires_in", tk.expires_in, "s")

h = stub.Submit(fts_pb2.TransferRequest(
    paths=SRC,
    dst_addr="127.0.0.1:4433",
    fingerprint=FP,
    ticket=tk.token,
    streams=4,
))
print("task:", h.task_id)

progress_seen = False
final = None
for ev in stub.Observe(fts_pb2.ObserveRequest(task_id=h.task_id)):
    import json
    e = json.loads(ev.raw_json)
    t = e.get("type")
    if t == "progress":
        progress_seen = True
    elif t in ("file_done", "result"):
        print(" ", ev.raw_json)
    if t == "result":
        final = e
        break

st = stub.Status(fts_pb2.TaskRef(task_id=h.task_id))
print("status:", st.state, "checksum_ok =", st.checksum_ok)
print("progress events seen:", progress_seen)

ok = (final and final.get("state") == "COMPLETED" and final.get("checksum_ok")
      and st.state == "COMPLETED" and st.checksum_ok and progress_seen)
print("T9:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
````

## File: File-Transfer/tests/update_e2e.py
````python
"""W9 远程更新端到端冒烟:本机模拟 BeginUpdate → 自替换 → 重启。

用法(任意目录):
    python tests\\update_e2e.py

前置: target\\release\\fts.exe 已构建;python 环境有 grpcio(orch 同款)。
流程:
  1. 临时目录搭一个"安装目录"(fts.exe + config.json),fts start 启动 daemon
  2. 直接到暂存目录放"新版"文件(fts.exe + VERSION 标记),模拟更新器推送完成
  3. gRPC BeginUpdate → 轮询等待 → 校验 VERSION 落地 / result.json ok=true
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

import grpc

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "orch"))
import fts_pb2 as pb          # noqa: E402
import fts_pb2_grpc as pbg    # noqa: E402

EXE = ROOT / "target" / "release" / "fts.exe"
REST = "127.0.0.1:5060"
GRPC_PORT = 50061


def http_json(method: str, url: str, body=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, method=method,
        data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=2) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())


def rest_alive() -> bool:
    try:
        http_json("GET", f"http://{REST}/v1/capabilities")
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False


def main() -> int:
    assert EXE.exists(), f"先构建: cargo build --release({EXE} 不存在)"
    if rest_alive():
        print(f"FAIL: {REST} 已被占用(上次测试残留 daemon?),先清理再跑", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    work = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="fts-update-e2e-"))
    node = work / "nodeA"
    ok = False
    try:
        _run(work, node)
        ok = True
    finally:
        # 兜底清理:按 pid 文件强杀测试 daemon;失败时保留现场供排查
        pid_file = node / ".fts" / "daemon.pid"
        if pid_file.exists():
            pid = pid_file.read_text().strip()
            subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/F", "/PID", pid],
                           stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        if ok:
            shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
        else:
            print(f"!! 失败现场保留: {work}", file=sys.stderr)
    print("PASS: 远程自更新端到端通过")
    return 0


def _run(work: Path, node: Path) -> None:
    (node / "downloads").mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(EXE, node / "fts.exe")
    (node / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "rest_addr": REST,
        "grpc_addr": f"0.0.0.0:{GRPC_PORT}",
        "listen_addr": "0.0.0.0:4434",
        "out_dir": "downloads",
        "cert_cache": ".fts",
        "max_sessions": 2,
    }))

    # 注意:不能用 capture_output —— daemon 孙进程会经 bInheritHandles=TRUE 继承
    # 管道写句柄,导致本进程等 EOF 永久挂起;DEVNULL + daemon 自有日志文件即可。
    subprocess.run([str(node / "fts.exe"), "start", "-c", "config.json"],
                   cwd=node, check=True,
                   stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    assert rest_alive(), "daemon 未就绪"
    caps0 = http_json("GET", f"http://{REST}/v1/capabilities")
    print(f"[1] daemon 就绪 version={caps0['fts_version']} work={work}")

    # "新版 dist":fts.exe + fts.dll(nodeA 原本没有 dll,落地即可证明换文件成功)。
    # 不放 VERSION:严格规则要求 dist VERSION 与二进制 fts_version 一致,否则判失败。
    newdist = work / "newdist"
    newdist.mkdir()
    shutil.copy2(EXE, newdist / "fts.exe")
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "target" / "release" / "fts.dll", newdist / "fts.dll")
    print("[2] 新版 dist 就绪;执行 push-update ...")
    r = subprocess.run([str(EXE), "push-update", "--to", f"127.0.0.1:{GRPC_PORT}",
                        "--dist", str(newdist)],
                       stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stdout, r.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
        raise AssertionError(f"push-update 失败(exit {r.returncode})")

    deadline = time.time() + 40
    marker = node / "fts.dll"
    while time.time() < deadline and not marker.exists():
        time.sleep(0.5)
    assert marker.exists(), "更新超时:新文件未落地"
    while time.time() < deadline and not rest_alive():
        time.sleep(0.5)
    assert rest_alive(), "更新后 REST 未恢复"
    caps1 = http_json("GET", f"http://{REST}/v1/capabilities")
    result_path = node / ".fts" / "update" / "result.json"
    while time.time() < deadline and not result_path.exists():
        time.sleep(0.5)
    result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
    print(f"[3] version={caps1['fts_version']} dll={'ok'} result={result}")

    assert result["ok"] is True, f"result.json 报失败: {result}"
    assert result["from"] == caps0["fts_version"], "from 版本记录不符"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

````markdown
# fts 接口文档(Interface Specification)

> **文档版本**:v1.0
> **发布日期**:2026-10-05
> **适用产品**:fts v0.1.0(线协议 fts-protocol v1 / C ABI v1 / REST v1 / gRPC fts.v1)
> **文档性质**:描述**当前实际交付**的对外接口,与实现同步维护;设计愿景与契约演进规则见 `plan/fts-api-spec.md`(设计文档),两者冲突时以本文档为准。
> **目标读者**:集成方开发者(任何语言)、运维、测试工程师。

---

## 目录

1. [概述与接口选型](#1-概述与接口选型)
2. [通用约定](#2-通用约定)
3. [任务模型(所有接口共享)](#3-任务模型所有接口共享)
4. [事件模型(NDJSON)](#4-事件模型ndjson)
5. [inbox 预注册(接收目录分配)](#5-inbox-预注册接收目录分配)
6. [gRPC 接口(fts.v1)](#6-grpc-接口ftsv1)
7. [REST 接口(HTTP/JSON + SSE)](#7-rest-接口httpjson--sse)
8. [CLI 参考](#8-cli-参考)
9. [C ABI(fts.dll)](#9-c-abi-ftsdll)
10. [错误码总表](#10-错误码总表)
11. [安全模型](#11-安全模型)
12. [版本与兼容性承诺](#12-版本与兼容性承诺)
13. [附录 A:典型集成流程](#附录-a典型集成流程)
14. [附录 B:已知限制](#附录-b已知限制)

---

## 1. 概述与接口选型

`fts` 是 Windows 平台的高速文件传输工具(QUIC 多流 + BLAKE3 校验 + 断点续传 + TCP 自动回退)。所有对外接口共享同一套任务语义与传输引擎:

| 接口 | 技术 | 默认地址 | 适用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **gRPC** | tonic(proto: `proto/fts.proto`,包 `fts.v1`) | `127.0.0.1:50051`(明文) | 程序集成主路径;需要事件流 |
| **REST** | axum(HTTP/1.1 JSON + SSE) | `127.0.0.1:5050` | 脚本 / curl / 无 gRPC 栈的语言 |
| **CLI** | `fts.exe` 子命令 | — | 人 / PowerShell / CI |
| **C ABI** | `fts.dll` + `include/fts.h` | — | C/C++/C#/Python ctypes 原生嵌入 |

选择决策:程序化集成首选 **gRPC**;同机原生进程选 **C ABI**;脚本用 **CLI `--json`** 或 REST。

> daemon 启动示例:`fts daemon --rest 127.0.0.1:5050 --listen 0.0.0.0:4433 --grpc 127.0.0.1:50051 --out D:\downloads`
> 运维脚本:`.\fts-daemon.ps1 start|stop|restart|status`。

---

## 2. 通用约定

| 约定 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 字符编码 | UTF-8(所有 JSON、路径、字符串字段) |
| REST 数据格式 | 请求/响应 `application/json`;事件流为 `text/event-stream`(SSE) |
| gRPC 明文 | 默认无 TLS,仅 localhost;**不得**暴露到非本机网络 |
| 时间 | 秒(`uint64`/`double`);预估时间字段命名 `*_seconds`/`expires_in` |
| 空字符串语义 | gRPC proto3 无 Option:可空字段用空串表示未提供(如 `fingerprint=""`) |
| 未知字段/事件 | 接收方**必须忽略**(前向兼容承诺) |
| 幂等性 | 提交类接口(Submit/ReserveInbox)**不幂等**(每次调用产生新资源);Cancel 幂等(重复取消返回 ok) |
| 并发 | 同一 task_id 的事件流可多路订阅;任务表无上限(受内存限制) |

**认证模型**(三层,均非用户账号体系):

1. **传输身份**:自签证书 + 指纹固定(TOFU)。接收端启动时打印证书 BLAKE3 指纹,发送端以 `fingerprint` 字段固定;不匹配 → 认证失败(退出码 7 / gRPC `UNKNOWN`+error_code 7)。
2. **落盘授权**:`ticket`(inbox token)决定文件落到哪个目录;无 token → 落 daemon 默认 `--out`。
3. **无用户鉴权**:REST/gRPC 仅监听 localhost;任何本机进程均可调用(含 Cancel)。见[安全模型](#11-安全模型)。

---

## 3. 任务模型(所有接口共享)

### 3.1 状态机

```
RUNNING ──► COMPLETED     (全部文件传输完成且 BLAKE3 校验通过)
   │  └──► FAILED         (任一文件失败/校验失败;快失败,后续文件不再传输)
   └─────► CANCELLED      (调用方取消)
```

- **COMPLETED 的语义是"传输完成且校验通过"**;校验失败一律 FAILED(`error_code=4`),不存在"传完了但内容不确定"的中间态。
- 终态不可逆;任务记录保留在内存(daemon 重启即清空;持久化审计走日志)。

### 3.2 传输语义

| 语义 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 多文件 | 单连接逐文件传输;**任一文件失败即中止整个任务**(快失败,无 keep-going) |
| 目录递归 | 路径为目录时**递归展开全部子目录**,保留相对路径结构在接收端重建(`fts send dir` → 接收端出现 `<ticket目录>/dir/...` 整棵子树)。协议内路径分隔符统一 `/`;空目录不会被重建;目录符号链接不递归(防环) |
| 路径安全 | manifest 中的相对路径在接收端强制校验:拒绝 `..`/`.`/空组件/反斜杠/盘符(防路径穿越);非法即 CHECKSUM 类失败 |
| 重名 | 多路径展开后**相对路径**重复 → 提交即拒绝(退出码 2 / gRPC INVALID_ARGUMENT) |
| 断点续传 | 接收端每秒落 checkpoint(per-file,含子目录内文件);同 manifest 重发自动只补缺失块;**无需调用方干预**(提交同一任务即续传) |
| 传输层 | `auto`(默认)= QUIC 失败 4s 内自动回退 TCP;`quic`/`tcp` 强制单栈 |
| 校验 | BLAKE3 逐块 + Merkle 根,**不可关闭**(硬约束) |

---

## 4. 事件模型(NDJSON)

Observe(gRPC stream)与 REST SSE 推送同一事件流:每行一个 JSON 对象(SSE 场景包在 `data:` 中)。

| type | 载荷字段 | 级别 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | `task_id`, `state` | info | 任务创建(始终第一条) |
| `progress` | `bytes_done`, `bytes_total`, `throughput_bps`, `eta_seconds`(可为 null) | debug | 每秒;当前**文件**的字节进度 |
| `file` | `name`, `index`(1 起), `total` | info | 多文件任务中某文件开始 |
| `file_done` | `name`, `checksum_ok`, `seconds`, `bytes` | info | 某文件完成 |
| `path` | `link`(`direct`/`peer_relay`/`derp`/`unknown`), `rtt_ms`(可 null) | info | Tailscale 链路探测结果(仅发送端) |
| `degradation` | `from`, `to`(如 `L0`→`L4`), `reason`(如 `quic_unreachable_tcp_fallback`) | **warn** | 降级事件,永不被过滤 |
| `result` | `state`, `checksum_ok`, `duration_seconds`,失败时附 `error_code`, `error` | info | 终态(始终最后一条) |
| `error` | `message` | error | 流内部异常(如订阅滞后 `lagged`) |

```jsonc
{"type":"task","task_id":"3f2b8c1a-...","state":"RUNNING"}
{"type":"file","name":"a.bin","index":1,"total":12}
{"type":"progress","bytes_done":1048576,"bytes_total":1073741824,"throughput_bps":94371840,"eta_seconds":11}
{"type":"file_done","name":"a.bin","checksum_ok":true,"seconds":3.2,"bytes":1073741824}
{"type":"degradation","from":"L0","to":"L4","reason":"quic_unreachable_tcp_fallback"}
{"type":"result","state":"COMPLETED","checksum_ok":true,"duration_seconds":42.5}
```

**订阅注意**:事件通道为环形广播(容量 256)。订阅晚于提交将丢失早期事件;`result` 可改由 Status 轮询兜底。

---

## 5. inbox 预注册(接收目录分配)

daemon 的接收目录默认是启动参数 `--out`;集成方通过 **inbox token** 把某个(批)传输指到任意目录。

### 5.1 两种 token 模式

| 模式 | 注册方式 | 有效语义 |
|---|---|---|
| **目录模式** | `file_name` 为空 | TTL(600s)内**可复用**;匹配任意文件名 → 全部落 `out_dir`。批量场景用这个。 |
| **文件绑定模式** | `file_name` 给定 | **一次性**:该文件名兑换成功即焚毁;其他文件名兑换**失败且焚毁**(防枚举) |

通用规则:

- TTL 600 秒,自创建起算(过期兑换失败,失败信息 `ticket 已过期`)。
- 兑换失败统一报 `AUTH_FAILED`(退出码 7),接收端不会把文件落到错误目录。
- 无 ticket 的传输 → 落 daemon 默认 `--out`(完全向后兼容)。
- daemon 重启后 token 全部失效(内存表)。

### 5.2 流程

```
集成方(Z 侧)                    发送方(A 侧调度)
   │ POST /v1/inbox                 │
   │◄── {token}                     │
   │──── token 传给 A 的调度 ──────►│
   │                                │ Submit{ticket: token, paths:[...]}
```

### 5.3 网络凭据(代建立 SMB 会话)

接收目录为需要认证的 SMB/UNC 路径时,注册时可携带凭据,fts 调 Windows `WNetAddConnection2` **代为建立会话**:

```jsonc
// POST /v1/inbox
{
  "out_dir": "\\\\nas01\\share\\deploy",
  "credential": { "user_name": "svc_fts", "password": "***", "domain": "CORP" }  // domain 可省
}
```

语义与边界:

| 项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 会话生命周期 | 进程级(临时连接),daemon 退出即失效;**不写入凭据管理器、不持久化** |
| 日志 | 密码**绝不**进入日志/错误消息/事件;日志只出现 `user=... password=***` |
| 作用 | 建立 `\\host\share` 会话后,该 daemon 的所有后续该主机文件操作走此凭据 |
| 失败 | 400 + 可读原因(1326 凭据无效 / 5 无权限 / 1219 会话冲突(附 `net use … /delete` 提示)/ 53/67 路径不存在) |
| 限制 | 仅 UNC 路径;本地路径带 credential → INVALID_ARGUMENT |
| 替代 | 更推荐 `cmdkey` 预存凭据(见 §11.1),credential 接口用于集成方动态持有凭据的场景 |

凭据建立**成功后**才做目录可写预检与发 token —— token 的发放即代表"该目录此刻可写"。

### 5.4 清空目录(PurgeInbox,危险操作)

配合 force 级"干净复制":传输前把 token 绑定目录**内部**清空(目录本身保留),使后续传输落入干净目录。

```
POST /v1/inbox/{token}/purge        {"force": true}
rpc PurgeInbox(PurgeRequest{token, force}) returns (PurgeReply)
```

```jsonc
// 200
{"ok": true, "files_deleted": 2, "directories_deleted": 1, "dir": "D:\\fromA"}
```

**三重安全保障**(fts 侧只负责准确执行,"是否允许删"由集成端决策):

1. **仅目录模式 token**:文件绑定 token 的授权范围只是一个文件,调用 purge → `403`(gRPC `PERMISSION_DENIED`)—— 授权范围与破坏范围严格对齐;
2. **必须显式 `force: true`**:缺省/false → `400`(gRPC `INVALID_ARGUMENT`);
3. **范围严格受限**:只删除 token 绑定目录的**直接内容**(子目录整删、文件删),不触碰目录本身与目录外任何路径;每次操作打 `[warn] PURGE` 日志(含统计与 token,可审计)。

| 错误 | HTTP | gRPC |
|---|---|---|
| force 未显式 true | 400 | INVALID_ARGUMENT |
| 文件绑定 token | 403 | PERMISSION_DENIED |
| token 无效/过期 | 404 | NOT_FOUND |

标准顺序:**ReserveInbox → PurgeInbox(force=true) → Submit → Observe**。

---

## 6. gRPC 接口(fts.v1)

- 端点:`127.0.0.1:50051`(明文 h2c)
- proto:`proto/fts.proto`;生成方式见 README(protoc 或参考 tests/grpc_smoke.py 的 grpc_tools 动态生成)

### 6.1 Capabilities

探测协议版本与能力。**集成方必须先调用**,不得假设能力存在。

```
rpc Capabilities(Empty) returns (CapabilitiesReply)
```

| CapabilitiesReply 字段 | 类型 | 值 |
|---|---|---|
| protocol_version | string | `"1"` |
| capabilities | uint32 位图 | bit3 = resume(0x8) |
| fts_version | string | 如 `"0.1.0"` |

### 6.2 ReserveInbox

```
rpc ReserveInbox(ReserveInboxRequest) returns (InboxToken)
```

| 请求字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| out_dir | string | ✅ | 接收目录(daemon 侧本地路径) |
| file_name | string | — | 空 = 目录模式;否则文件绑定模式 |

| 响应字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| token | string | UUID;放入 TransferRequest.ticket |
| expires_in | uint64 | 600(秒) |

错误:`INVALID_ARGUMENT`(out_dir 空)。

### 6.3 Submit

提交传输任务(异步,立即返回 task_id)。

```
rpc Submit(TransferRequest) returns (TransferHandle)
```

| TransferRequest 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| paths | repeated string | ✅(与旧字段二选一) | 文件/目录列表;目录**递归展开**(保留相对结构);相对路径重复 → INVALID_ARGUMENT |
| dst_addr | string | ✅ | 对端 `host:port`(接收端 daemon/recv 监听地址) |
| fingerprint | string | 与 insecure 二选一 | 对端证书 BLAKE3 指纹(64 hex) |
| insecure | bool | — | true = 跳过证书校验(仅测试);与 fingerprint 互斥 |
| streams | uint32 | — | 并行流数,0 = 4,上限 64 |
| chunk_size | uint64 | — | 分块字节,0 = 8 MiB |
| transport | string | — | `""`/`auto`/`quic`/`tcp` |
| ticket | string | — | inbox token |

| 响应字段 | 类型 |
|---|---|
| task_id | string(UUID) |

错误:`INVALID_ARGUMENT`(参数问题);提交成功后传输失败**不**走 gRPC 错误,通过 Status/Observe 观察。

### 6.4 Observe(server-streaming)

```
rpc Observe(ObserveRequest{task_id}) returns (stream TransferEvent{raw_json})
```

- `raw_json` 为[第 4 节](#4-事件模型ndjson)事件的 NDJSON 原文;解析失败的事件跳过。
- 流结束条件:收到 `result` 事件后调用方主动结束;服务端在任务终态后仍可能保持流(靠 result 判断)。
- 错误:`NOT_FOUND`(任务不存在)。

### 6.5 Status

```
rpc Status(TaskRef{task_id}) returns (TransferStatus)
```

| TransferStatus 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| task_id | string | |
| state | string | `RUNNING` / `COMPLETED` / `FAILED` / `CANCELLED` |
| checksum_ok | bool | |
| error_code | int32 | 契约错误码(见[第 10 节](#10-错误码总表));无错误为 0 |
| error / error_message | string | 错误名 / 可读详情 |

错误:`NOT_FOUND`。

### 6.6 Cancel

```
rpc Cancel(TaskRef{task_id}) returns (Ack{ok})
```

幂等;对已结束任务返回 `ok=true` 无副作用。取消后任务进 `CANCELLED`,接收端半成品保留 checkpoint(重发即续传)。

### 6.7 调用示例(Python)

完整可运行脚本:`tests/grpc_smoke.py`。骨架:

```python
import grpc, fts_pb2, fts_pb2_grpc
ch = grpc.insecure_channel("127.0.0.1:50051")
stub = fts_pb2_grpc.FtsStub(ch)

tk  = stub.ReserveInbox(fts_pb2.ReserveInboxRequest(out_dir=r"D:\fromA"))
h   = stub.Submit(fts_pb2.TransferRequest(
        paths=["C:\\data\\a.bin", "C:\\data\\b.bin"],
        dst_addr="100.64.0.5:4433", fingerprint=FP, ticket=tk.token))
for ev in stub.Observe(fts_pb2.ObserveRequest(task_id=h.task_id)):
    import json; e = json.loads(ev.raw_json)
    if e.get("type") == "result": break
st  = stub.Status(fts_pb2.TaskRef(task_id=h.task_id))
assert st.state == "COMPLETED" and st.checksum_ok
```

---

## 7. REST 接口(HTTP/JSON + SSE)

- 端点:`127.0.0.1:5050`;所有请求/响应 `application/json`;错误统一 `{"error": "<原因>"}`。

| # | 方法 | 路径 | 对应 gRPC |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | GET | `/v1/capabilities` | Capabilities |
| 2 | POST | `/v1/inbox` | ReserveInbox(可带 credential) |
| 3 | DELETE | `/v1/inbox/{token}` | —(撤销) |
| 3b | POST | `/v1/inbox/{token}/purge` | PurgeInbox(危险,见 §5.4) |
| 4 | POST | `/v1/transfers` | Submit |
| 5 | GET | `/v1/transfers` | 任务列表(gRPC 无对应) |
| 6 | GET | `/v1/transfers/{id}` | Status |
| 7 | POST | `/v1/transfers/{id}/cancel` | Cancel |
| 8 | GET | `/v1/transfers/{id}/events` | Observe(SSE) |

### 7.1 GET /v1/capabilities

```jsonc
// 200
{"protocol_version":"1","fts_version":"0.1.0","capabilities":8,
 "rest_endpoints":["GET /v1/capabilities", "..."]}
```

### 7.2 POST /v1/inbox

```jsonc
// 请求
{"out_dir": "D:\\fromA", "file_name": ""}        // file_name 空 = 目录模式
// 200
{"token": "7dc85a06-...", "expires_in": 600}
```

### 7.3 DELETE /v1/inbox/{token}

```jsonc
// 200
{"ok": true}      // token 不存在也返回 ok:false(200)
```

### 7.4 POST /v1/transfers

```jsonc
// 请求(202)
{"paths": ["C:\\data\\a.bin", "C:\\data\\dirB"],   // 或 "src_path": 单文件(旧兼容)
 "dst_addr": "100.64.0.5:4433",
 "fingerprint": "<64hex>",                          // 或 "insecure": true
 "streams": 4, "chunk_size": 0,
 "transport": "auto", "ticket": "<token>"}
// 202 Accepted
{"task_id": "3f2b8c1a-..."}
// 400 Bad Request
{"error": "必须提供 fingerprint 或 insecure=true"}
```

### 7.5 GET /v1/transfers

```jsonc
// 200
{"tasks": [{"task_id": "...", "state": "RUNNING"}, ...]}
```

### 7.6 GET /v1/transfers/{id}

```jsonc
// 200
{"task_id":"...","state":"COMPLETED","checksum_ok":true}
// FAILED 时附加:
{"task_id":"...","state":"FAILED","checksum_ok":false,"error_code":4,"error":"CHECKSUM_FAILED","error_message":"..."}
// 404
{"error": "任务不存在"}
```

### 7.7 POST /v1/transfers/{id}/cancel

```jsonc
// 200(幂等)
{"ok": true}          // 404:任务不存在
```

### 7.8 GET /v1/transfers/{id}/events(SSE)

```
data: {"type":"task","task_id":"...","state":"RUNNING"}
data: {"type":"progress","bytes_done":...,"bytes_total":...,...}
data: {"type":"result","state":"COMPLETED","checksum_ok":true,...}
```

事件模型同[第 4 节](#4-事件模型ndjson);`404` 任务不存在。

### 7.9 调用示例(PowerShell)

```powershell
$r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5050/v1/inbox `
     -ContentType application/json -Body '{"out_dir":"D:\\fromA"}'
$body = @{ paths=@("C:\data\a.bin","C:\data\b.bin"); dst_addr="100.64.0.5:4433";
           fingerprint=$fp; ticket=$r.token } | ConvertTo-Json
$t = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri http://127.0.0.1:5050/v1/transfers `
     -ContentType application/json -Body $body
curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:5050/v1/transfers/$($t.task_id)/events     # SSE
```

## 8. CLI 参考

```text
fts send <PATH>... --to <ADDR> [--fingerprint <HEX> | --insecure]
        [--chunk-size <B>=8MiB] [--streams <N>=4] [--ticket <T>]
        [--transport auto|quic|tcp] [--json] [-v]
    PATH  文件或目录(可多个;目录展开直接文件,不递归;展开后重名 → 退出码 2)

fts recv --listen <ADDR> [--out <DIR>=.] [--transport auto|quic|tcp]
        [--cert-cache <DIR>=.fts] [--json] [-v]
    处理一个会话后退出(面向人);常驻用 daemon

fts daemon [--rest 127.0.0.1:5050] [--listen 0.0.0.0:4433] [--out <DIR>=.]
        [--cert-cache .fts] [--max-sessions 3] [--grpc 127.0.0.1:50051|""](禁用)
```

**`--json` 模式**:stdout 只输出[事件](#4-事件模型ndjson) NDJSON;人类日志走 stderr。**脚本必须检查退出码**:

| 退出码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 0 | 成功且校验通过 |
| 1 | 通用 / I/O 错误 |
| 2 | 参数错误(clap 或重名检测) |
| 3 | 连接失败 / 协议版本不匹配 |
| **4** | **校验失败 —— 数据不可信,必须处理** |
| 5 | 传输中断(接收端保留 checkpoint,重发即续传) |
| 6 | 被取消 |
| 7 | 认证失败(指纹不匹配 / ticket 拒绝) |

---

## 9. C ABI(fts.dll)

头文件 `include/fts.h`;P3 最小集成面(阻塞式一体)。**ABI 版本**:`fts_abi_version() == 1`,结构变化时递增。

```c
const char* fts_version(void);          // 静态字符串,勿释放
uint32_t    fts_abi_version(void);
const char* fts_last_error(void);       // 下一次任何 fts_* 调用前有效;需保留必须拷贝
int32_t     fts_send_file(const char* src_path, const char* dst_addr,
                          const char* fingerprint_hex,   /* NULL + insecure!=0 */
                          int32_t insecure, uint32_t streams,   /* 0 = 4 */
                          uint32_t chunk_size,           /* 0 = 8 MiB */
                          const char* transport);        /* NULL/"auto"/"quic"/"tcp" */
```

- 返回值:0 成功;否则[错误码](#10-错误码总表)(与 CLI 退出码一致)。
- **内存规则**:所有返回字符串由 fts 托管,宿主**不得释放** —— 无跨边界 free。
- 线程安全:各函数可任意线程调用;`fts_last_error` 为全局单槽(多线程宿主建议调用后立即拷贝)。
- 不支持:多文件(逐次调用)、ticket、事件回调(P3 面最小;需要时升级 ABI v2)。
- 验证脚本:`python tests\ffi_smoke.py <指纹>`。

---

## 10. 错误码总表

错误码跨接口统一(CLI 退出码 = REST `error_code` = gRPC `TransferStatus.error_code` = C ABI 返回值):

| 码 | 名称 | 含义 | REST HTTP |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | OK | 成功 | 200 |
| 1 | IO_ERROR | 本地 I/O / 其他 | 200(任务态) |
| 2 | INVALID_ARG | 参数错误(含重名文件) | 400 |
| 3 | CONNECT_FAILED | 连接失败 | 200(任务态) |
| 3 | INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION | 协议版本不匹配 | 200(任务态) |
| **4** | **CHECKSUM_FAILED** | **校验失败,数据不可信** | 200(任务态) |
| 5 | INTERRUPTED | 中断(接收端有 checkpoint,可续传) | 200(任务态) |
| 6 | CANCELLED | 被取消 | 200(任务态) |
| 7 | AUTH_FAILED | 指纹不匹配 / ticket 拒绝 | 200(任务态) |

- 传输类错误(3/4/5/6/7)发生在**任务运行期**,REST/gRPC 提交仍返回成功;通过 Status/Observe 观察。gRPC 请求级错误只有 `INVALID_ARGUMENT` 与 `NOT_FOUND`。
- 错误码 v1 内不复用、不改语义;新增用新码。

---

## 11. 安全模型

| 层 | 机制 | 边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 传输加密 | QUIC = TLS 1.3(ring);TCP 回退**无 TLS**(仅建议测试环境) | — |
| 端到端完整性 | BLAKE3 逐块 + Merkle 根,不可关闭 | 中间人无法篡改内容 |
| 身份 | 自签证书 + 指纹固定(TOFU);`--insecure` 仅测试 | 首次连接务必抄录指纹 |
| 落盘授权 | inbox ticket;无 token → 默认目录 | token = 授权凭证,泄露即可向该目录写文件 |
| 网络暴露 | REST/gRPC 强制 localhost | **不得**加反向代理暴露公网(无鉴权) |

### 11.1 网络路径(SMB / UNC)接收目录

接收目录可以是 UNC 路径(如 `\\NAS\share\fts`),用于把文件直接落到 SMB 共享:

- **凭据由 Windows 会话负责,fts 不弹凭据框**(CLI/服务程序没有 UI)。接收端 daemon 的 Windows 账号必须已能访问该共享:域环境通常自动;工作组用 `cmdkey /add:<主机> /user:<用户> /pass:<密码>`(存凭据管理器,一次即可)或 `net use \\NAS\share /user:<用户> <密码>`。
- daemon **启动时**与 **inbox 注册时**都会做目录可写预检(建临时文件探测),凭据/权限问题在提交传输**之前**暴露,错误信息附带可操作提示(如 1326 → 给出 cmdkey 命令)。
- 传输速率受 SMB 带宽限制;fts 内部吞吐不受影响。

```powershell
# 一次性建立凭据后,UNC 直接作为接收目录
cmdkey /add:nas01 /user:svc_fts /pass:***
fts daemon -c config.json          # config.json: "out_dir": "\\\\nas01\\share\\fts"
```

常见 OS 错误映射(自动附带提示):5 拒绝访问(权限)、1326 登录失败(凭据)、53/67 路径不存在(主机/共享名)、1219 凭据会话冲突(`net use * /delete`)。

---

## 12. 版本与兼容性承诺

| 维度 | 当前 | 承诺(v1.x) |
|---|---|---|
| gRPC 包 | `fts.v1` | 字段只增不改/不删;新 RPC 新增 |
| REST 路径 | `/v1/...` | 路径与已发布字段稳定;新增字段向后兼容 |
| 线协议 | fts-protocol v1(Hello 协商) | 版本不匹配即拒绝(INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION) |
| C ABI | `fts_abi_version()==1` | 变更递增版本号 |
| 事件 | 未知 type 必须忽略 | 新事件类型不破坏旧消费方 |
| 错误码 | 0-7 已分配 | 不复用;新增用新码 |

破坏性变更(删字段/改语义)将提升主版本(REST `/v2`、gRPC `fts.v2`、ABI v2)。

---

## 附录 A:典型集成流程

**force 级干净部署(多客户端 → 同一接收端,每客户端独立目录):**

```
0. Z:   fts daemon -c config.json --max-sessions 3           (记录启动日志中的证书指纹)
1. A:   POST /v1/inbox {"out_dir":"D:\\fromA"}               → tokenA(目录模式)
2. A:   POST /v1/inbox/{tokenA}/purge {"force":true}         ← 可选:干净复制(危险,集成端自行确认)
3. A:   POST /v1/transfers {paths:[...], dst_addr, fingerprint, ticket:tokenA} → task_id
4. A:   GET /v1/transfers/{task_id}/events                   → file/progress/file_done/result
5. B、C:重复 1-4(各自 token;Z 端最多 max_sessions 个会话并发,其余排队)
失败处理:error_code=5 → 原样重发(续传);error_code=4 → 数据不可信,人工介入;
          网络路径凭据失效 → ReserveInbox 重带 credential。
```

**单文件快速通道(CLI):**

```powershell
fts send .\big.bin --to 100.64.0.5:4433 --fingerprint <FP> --json
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "exit=$LASTEXITCODE" }
```

## 附录 B:已知限制

- 回环基准 ≠ 真实网络(两台物理机数字待测)。
- 无 Nack 级块重传:单块损坏 → 整个文件失败(重发续传)。
- 无 FEC/BBR(设计见 `plan/fts-design.md` 第 9 节)。
- TCP 回退会话全局互斥(QUIC 会话并发);TCP 回退无 TLS。
- REST/gRPC 无用户鉴权;daemon 重启后任务表与 inbox token 清空。
- `fts_last_error` 为全局单槽(多线程 C 宿主需立即拷贝)。
````

## File: File-Transfer/build.ps1
````powershell
# fts one-shot build script.
# Usage:
#   .\build.ps1              # build release + collect artifacts to dist\
#   .\build.ps1 -Test        # build + run unit tests
#   .\build.ps1 -SkipBuild   # only re-collect dist\
#   .\build.ps1 -Updater     # additionally build the updater GUI (Tauri, dev machine only)
param(
    [switch]$Test,
    [switch]$SkipBuild,
    [switch]$Updater
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
Set-Location $PSScriptRoot

if (-not $SkipBuild) {
    Write-Host "==> cargo build --release"
    cargo build --release
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cargo build failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }

    if ($Test) {
        Write-Host "==> cargo test --release"
        cargo test --release
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cargo test failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)" }
    }
}

# Collect distributable artifacts (everything needed to run, copy-and-use) into dist\
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist | Out-Null
Copy-Item target\release\fts.exe dist\ -Force
Copy-Item target\release\fts.dll dist\ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Copy-Item include\fts.h dist\ -Force
Copy-Item config.json dist\ -Force
Copy-Item fts-daemon.ps1 dist\ -Force
Copy-Item fts-daemon.cmd dist\ -Force
Copy-Item DEPLOY.txt dist\ -Force

# W9:dist 版本号(更新器 GUI 比对目标机 Capabilities.fts_version 用)
$version = (Select-String -Path Cargo.toml -Pattern '^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"').Matches[0].Groups[1].Value
Set-Content -Path dist\VERSION -Value $version -NoNewline -Encoding ascii

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "==> artifacts in dist\:"
Get-ChildItem dist | Format-Table Name, Length -AutoSize
Write-Host "done. Deploy = copy the whole dist\ folder to the target machine."

if ($Updater) {
    Write-Host ""
    Write-Host "==> building updater GUI (updater\, dev machine only) ..."
    Push-Location updater
    npm install
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Pop-Location; throw "npm install failed" }
    npx tauri build
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Pop-Location; throw "tauri build failed" }
    Pop-Location
    Write-Host "updater exe: updater\src-tauri\target\release\fts-updater.exe (安装包在 target\release\bundle\nsis\)"
}
````

## File: File-Transfer/build.rs
````rust
// gRPC 代码生成:protox(纯 Rust protoc 替代)编译 → tonic-build 生成代码。
// 不依赖系统 protoc。
// 注:build-dep 有两份 prost(0.13 由 tonic-build 链引入、0.14 由 protox 链引入),
// protox 返回的类型实现的是 prost 0.14 的 Message —— 显式用 0.14 编码。

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let descriptor = protox::compile(["proto/fts.proto"], ["proto/"])?;
    let out_dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("OUT_DIR")?);
    let descriptor_path = out_dir.join("fts_descriptor.bin");
    let bytes: Vec<u8> = protox::prost::Message::encode_to_vec(&descriptor);
    std::fs::write(&descriptor_path, bytes)?;

    let protos: [std::path::PathBuf; 1] = [descriptor_path.clone()];
    let includes: [std::path::PathBuf; 0] = [];
    tonic_build::configure()
        .skip_protoc_run()
        .file_descriptor_set_path(&descriptor_path)
        .compile_protos(&protos, &includes)?;
    Ok(())
}
````
